description:
Welcome to a great stay at this fully equipped and chic 2-bedroom apartment in a newly renovated historical building furnished with new and high quality furniture for your comfort in Galata. This unit faces the historical tourist attraction of Galata Tower and very centrally located next to major tourist attractions.

It has every basic amenity you will need and is designed to make you feel "Your sweet home away from home" from the moment you step-in.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text: We had an amazing time here. It’s literally right across from Galata tower. The tower is visible from every window and balcony. It’s very clean and modern (many places in Istanbul are less so by comparison). It’s so close to the photogenic cobblestone streets of Galata and short walk to istiklal street. Clean bathroom and kitchen and comfy beds. Great value for price. We’re back in Istanbul in a couple of years and will want to stay here again!!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The place was exactly as described—spotlessly clean, beautifully maintained, and very comfortable. The location is perfect, making it easy to get around and enjoy the surroundings.
The host was exceptional—very kind, responsive, and supportive throughout our stay. Check-in and check-out were smooth and hassle-free, and the host was always available whenever we needed assistance.
The home felt safe and welcoming, with all the amenities required for a comfortable stay. It truly felt like a home away from home. We enjoyed every moment and would definitely choose this place again in the future.
Highly recommended to anyone looking for a peaceful, comfortable, and memorable stay. Thank you for such a lovely experience!

We had an absolutely wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The place was exactly as described—spotlessly clean, beautifully maintained, and very comfortable. The location is perfect, making it easy to get around and enjoy the surroundings.
The host was exceptional—very kind, responsive, and supportive throughout our stay. Check-in and check-out were smooth and hassle-free, and the host was always available whenever we needed assistance.
The home felt safe and welcoming, with all the amenities required for a comfortable stay. It truly felt like a home away from home. We enjoyed every moment and would definitely choose this place again in the future.
Highly recommended to anyone looking for a peaceful, comfortable, and memorable stay. Thank you for such a lovely experience!

This apartment is very beautiful and comfortable, and very well equipped - very complete kitchen, different kinds of shower gels, shampoo, etc, etc. It is so close to the Galata tower that you can almost touch it.
Check-in and communication was easy, but as a drawback also very impersonal since this apartment is part of a larger business running many apartments. It misses the personal AirBnB experience you sometimes have - but if you are just looking for a great place to stay at an amazing location, this is your spot.
Nihan, was wonderful and very responsive and easy to deal with. Her team was very nice and respectful. The location was amazing, I believe I stayed in an apartment that’s closest to the Galata tower.

description:
Sit back and relax in this quiet, stylish place. The right address for a good stay in a spacious home. It's a convenient apartment with a strong internet connection. It is a secure site and you can stay with peace of mind.

reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of staying at Ayşe's apartment in Maltepe, as listed on Airbnb, and I am delighted to share my experience. The apartment lived up to the description and photographs provided on the platform, offering a true reflection of what was advertised.
From the outset, Ayşe proved to be an exemplary host. Her responsiveness and willingness to assist with any inquiries were outstanding, ensuring smooth communication throughout my stay. She consistently demonstrated genuine care, making sure that my experience was as comfortable and hassle-free as possible.
The apartment itself was in good condition. Although there were minor issues during my stay, Ayşe was prompt and diligent in addressing them, often going above and beyond to ensure they were resolved quickly. This proactive approach in maintaining the quality of her property and the satisfaction of her guests was truly appreciated.
Ayşe hanım sıcakkanlı ve misafirperver bir ev sahibidir. Ev geniş ve rahattır. Evin konumu oldukça iyidir Hilton AVM’ye çok yakındır. Görüşmek üzere sevgiler

Alışveriş merkezi,metro gibi olanaklara yakın olması şehir dışından gelen biri olarak rahat bir şekilde İstanbul’u gezme ve yemek olanaklarına ulaşmaya kolaylık sağlıyordu ev sahibinin güler yüzlülüğü için ayrıca çok teşekkür ederiz kaldığımız süre boyunca çok güzel ilgilendi
the host is very kind and friendly. always helpful. it was a pleasure staying at ayşe's house. holidays are fun. affordable price with a very nice house 😊

Her şey harikaydı. Konum çok iyi. Ulaşım çok kolay. Ayşe hanım çok yardımsever ve canayakın. Ev sıcak, bir ailenin ihtiyacı olan her şey mevcut. Terastan istanbul manzarası harika. Mutlaka tavsiye ederim.

description: Experience vibrant city living in the heart of Beyoğlu, just steps away from art galleries, museums, theaters, concert halls, and cinemas. Enjoy the charm of Istanbul with Nişantaşı, Taksim, and Cihangir all within walking distance. This stylish residence features new, high-quality furniture, a city view, and top-notch amenities including an elevator, indoor parking, and 24/7 security. Discover your new home where culture meets comfort.

reviews.text: I had the most wonderful stay at this Airbnb! From the moment I walked in, it felt like home. The cozy decor, flexible check in, and all the amenities made me feel so comfortable and relaxed. The host was incredibly welcoming and went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed. I can't wait to come back and experience this home away from home again!

Accommodation was really easy to find. It was quite spacious, everything needed for short stay was there. It is quite easy to catch a taxi right outside the apartment. Few really good (for my taste) restaurants in walking distance. Friendly and helpful staff on reception.
Konum İstanbulun her noktasına yakın gezi rotalarına yakın . Temiz bir ev gayet kullanışlı. Tüm ihtıyaçlarımız kolaylıkla karşılandı.
We loved the place. Beautiful flat, amazing pool and sauna and gym, only sad thing is that is closed whole Monday for cleaning. Location very good. A bit loud though even through the night.
Selin Hanım çok ilgili ve nazik bir ev sahibi. Ev tertemiz, konforlu ve merkeziydi. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik, tekrar İstanbul’a gelirsem yine tercih ederim.

description: Our chic flat is located in Taksim and only 600 Meters away from fabulous İstiklal Street and 900 Meters away from Sishane Metro Station.. It is at the 2nd floor of a 4 Storey Bulding...It has also a balcony connected to bedroom... AC Unit is located in bedroom...You can sleep up to 3 Adults with a double bed and a sofa bed...Enjoy Your Stay and Istanbul Experience...

reviews.text: Apartment is on very good location. Roof terace has a really nice view. Its near masque so it can get noisey in the night. Its was clean and Recep was very responsive and did everything we asked during our stay. Apartment is not same as on photos. It has issues with mold in bathroom and also moisture in bedroom. Also during our stay bathroom fan literally exploded causing fuse to go off. If anyone was inside showering when this happened it could've ended badly. We didnt get any apology for this. In my opinion its too expensive for what its worth.

The flat absolutely matching all described here. Very clean, great location and friendly responsive host. We stayed there 3 people and were all absolutely satisfied. Definitely recommended if you’re looking for a place to stay in Istanbul!
Great location. Easy check-in. Same as the photos. Good value for money.

We really liked the location, quiet street, peace at night. Right next door is a very tasty kebab and bakery, where you can have breakfast for very reasonable prices (the staff in both places is very kind and friendly, we felt like we were at home). Istiklal Street is only a 10-minute walk away, public transport stop is 5-10 minutes away. The apartment in the photos certainly looked much fresher and a little more spacious, but overall we are satisfied with the price-quality ratio. The apartment was warm and equipped with everything we needed (fridge, washing machine, hair dryer, iron, etc.). Thank you!

Very clean and well-located apartment. I particularly liked the comfy bed and wooden floors. The communication with hosts was great. Also the calico cat that seems to live in the lobby area is very sweet and talkative 🧡

description: It offers our guests a pleasant experience with its central location and social opportunities in the heart of Kadıköy. Fenerbahçe Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadium, Yoğurtçu Park and Kadıköy's popular spots are only a few minutes' walk away. You can easily reach different parts of Istanbul as it is only a 7-8 minute walk to Söğütlüçeşme Metrobus and Marmaray stops

reviews.text: Konum olarak benim için çok iyi bir yerdeydi. Daire fotoğraflarda daha büyük geniş ve ferah gözüküyor ancak daire baya küçük. Yatak odasındaki yatak inanılmaz kötüydü, yatakta değilde yayların üzerinde yatıyormuş hissi veriyordu. Çok eski olmasından kaynaklı. Temizlik konusunda çok kötü değildi ancak yatak ve koltuk hiç temiz gibi değildi. Daire kalorifer sonuna kadar yansa bile yeterli sıcaklıkta değildi.

Fiyat performans idi. Eski bir ev ve müthiş temizlikten söz edilemez.Fotoğraflardaki enerji eve girince kayboldu. Sıcaklık iyiydi. Yedek battaniye yorgan gerekli. Banyonun durumu pek iyi değildi. Evin durumu genel olarak idare ederdi. Ev sahibi için her şey olumlu. Kendisine teşekkürler.

Thank you so much for being such a wonderful and attentive host! Your support and availability for any questions made our stay incredibly comfortable. The location couldn’t be better—everything we needed was just a short walk away. We truly appreciate all your help and will definitely recommend your place to others

Konumu oldukça iyi bir yerde, eve giriş ve çıkış kolay. Fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi ancak banyonun ışıkları düzgün çalışmıyordu, yatak odasındaki ışıkları da açıp kapatınca başka ışıklar da açılıp kapanıyordu. Onun dışında başka bir problemle karşılaşmadık.
Merkezi konumda ulaşımı gayet rahat. Ev sahibi gayet ilgili.

description: Everything you want to explore is right outside the door of this place.

reviews.text:
Great value for money!
For just £40, we got a smart TV, reliable Wi-Fi, hot water for showers, and even a free breakfast included. You really can’t beat the price for what’s offered! Also the host lent me their mobile charger for the night.
However, there were a couple of downsides. The toilet could have been cleaner, as there were some dark brown stains inside. Also, the shower tray leaked. Lastly, it was a bit odd that there wasn’t a kettle in the room for tea or coffee, which is usually a standard amenity in most hotels.
Overall, good stay for the price—just a couple of things that could use improvement!

Great stay right in the heart of Sultanahmet! The location in Fatih is absolutely perfect for exploring all the major historical sights on foot. Mustafa was a fantastic and welcoming host, always quick to respond. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul

We had a great stay.
The accommodation is in a perfect location, with everything within walking distance, which is extremely convenient in Istanbul.
The apartment was exactly as described, clean and comfortable.
The staff was very friendly, welcoming, and always kind, which made us feel very at ease during our stay.
We would definitely recommend this place to friends and family, and we would not hesitate to stay here again if we have the opportunity

This is a very smoothly run hotel. Everything was always clean, the breakfast served was always diverse and delicious (with a great view too!) and arriving at the building is easy and welcoming. Mustafa was very helpful and responsive. Excellent location being a short walk to Sultanahmet and the Blue Mosque. The restaurant near my window played the same chill playlist on repeat - didn't bother me much but the songs got old lol. Overall, a very well-serviced stay!

Mustafa was a great host and the concierge at reception was very helpful. The photos provided on this listing were not the ones of the room I stayed in. Instead of a proper queen bed, it was 2 twin mattresses stuck together with a top sheet (not even a fitted sheet).

description:
Would you like a perfect stay at the heart of Istanbul's historic peninsula?

This booking offers a fully equipped luxury apartment on Bogazkesen, the Cultural Path connecting Galataport to the famous Istiklal Street. You will find historic monuments, galleries, antique stores, the best of local cuisine, vibrant nightlife and more just beside you.

With daily cleaning service, assistance for your concierge needs and dedicated parking space, this apartment is set to make your vacation memorable!

reviews.text:
We stayed here for a full month and truly enjoyed our stay. We’re very happy we chose this place and would absolutely stay here again.
The location is fantastic. Within a few minutes’ walk, you’ll find countless restaurants and cafés in Karaköy, Galataport, the waterfront, ferries, shops, exchange offices, and the Tophane T1 tram stop. The building is modern and beautifully designed, and our apartment was clean, comfortable, and functional.
A special thank you to our host, Gülşah, who was incredibly supportive and responsive. Whenever we had a question or small issue, she took care of it quickly.
One tip: although Şişhane is the closest metro station, walking there involves a significant uphill walk. Using the nearby T1 tram and planning your connections around it makes getting around much easier and avoids most of the hills.
Overall, a wonderful one-month stay, an excellent location, and a great host. Definitely 5 stars, and we would happily stay here again.

The apartment is modern with great city views and heated floors, making it extra comfortable in winter.
The bedroom is cozy, and the living room is a nice spot to relax.
The bathroom is clean, with good water pressure and fresh towels. The kitchen is well-equipped for basic cooking, and the fridge even had some complimentary soft drinks, which was a nice touch.
The location is convenient—near Tophane tram station and a short walk to Taksim. Plenty of cafes, restaurants, and a mosque nearby.
Hearing the adhan was very important to me, and I truly appreciated how clearly it could be heard.
The apartment is well-insulated from street noise, so it was peaceful.
One downside was dealing with a taxi scam, but the host stepped in and helped me out, which I really appreciated. That kind of support makes a big difference.
THANKS!!
Overall, a great stay with thoughtful details. Would recommend, especially for those who appreciate being near a mosque. Rating: 9/10

A perfect location to explore the city. Tram is a few mins walk away which makes me easy to go everywhere I wanted.
The apartment is very new, well equipped, towels and linens are super clean. There is a nespresso machine for those who miss your regular americano over Turkish coffee.
I recommend Kadee Market 2 mins away, they have clean products (small stores in Turkish were often dusty) with price tags (which means no tourist scams), the owner is nice and reliable.
After check out, you can leave the luggage at the basement floor located at the -3 floor. I had to wait for the host’s reply to get confirmation if I could leave the luggage which made me stuck for 1.5 hrs on my last day but the rest of the communication was smooth.
There is only sheer curtains and there was a noise from the constructions, so bring your eye masks and ear plugs.
Overall, a nice place to stay in Istanbul.

I had a lovely stay at this apartment. The location is excellent — very central and convenient for getting around. The neighborhood has a light and vibrant atmosphere, though it can be a bit noisy at times due to the surroundings.
The apartment itself is beautifully furnished with a lot of attention to detail. It’s clear that the host has a great sense of style and has put thought into the design and comfort of the space.
My only minor issues were that the bed was a bit too soft , and there was an occasional smell coming from the bathroom. Also, while most essentials were provided, body wash and shampoo were missing, which would have been a nice touch. Also, the Wi-Fi connection was a bit unstable at times.
Overall, I truly appreciated the thoughtful setup and ambiance of the place. I’d recommend it to others, especially those who enjoy being in the heart of the city.

The place was clean and as pictured; the location is great but just note there are steep hills to walk up to Taksim Square; i recommend wearing comfortable shoes when walking around the area. The parking on site for the building is in the back, and I believe it has a car elevator, but i parked in another lot around the corner that was easier to access.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Our place is located in a bustling area with a shopping mall, restaurants and cafes, beauty salons, and a mosque nearby. You'll be able to enjoy the convenience of having everything you need within walking distance. Our home is cozy and comfortable, with all the amenities you need for a relaxing stay. We look forward to hosting you!

reviews.text: Ulaşım, konaklama, konum güzel. Etrafta her imkan mevcut. Yalnız yerle ilgili sorunları yazayım. Mutfakta çay, kahve ya da en basitinden su dahi yoktu. Aşağıda market var temin etmek zorunda kaldım. Çay şeker su gibi temel ihtiyacları aşağıda marketten temin ettim. Gelelim diğer en önemli konuya, terlik yoktu evde. Banyoyu kullanmak için dahi terlik yoktu, aşağıdan inanın terlik temin ettim. Duşun kapısı kapanmıyor, sürgülü camın tekerleri kırık, açıp kapamak çok zor ve tehlikeli. Giderden ciddi kötü koku geliyordu. Yatak odası ve örtüler gayet temizdi ama aynı şeyi evde tek oturma imkanı olan L koltuk için söylemek imkansız. Ne olduğu belli olmayan bir sürü leke vardı. Temiz mi değil mi belli değil. Ama ev sahipleri kibar, ilgili yardım severdiler.

The most important thing for me is cleanliness, and the place was immaculately clean. The view is wonderful, and the location is far from tourist places, but it was not a problem for me. The apartment is quiet and comfortable, and the services are close. Overall, the place is very wonderful, and of course I will visit here again.
I extend my thanks to the owner of the apartment for his attention to the smallest details. I wish you a comfortable and enjoyable life
Mohammed

Everything was really good and satisfying. They were really responsible if there is a problem and the view is really nice. The bedroom was extremely clean and even the bathroom was really clean and the pool as well. Overall, they are really friendly and available to fix any issues and anything else you want. The amenities, pans and dishes of the kitchen are really new, a lot and easy to use. At the end, they give us a gift that was really good and perfect.
I had a pleasant stay. The apartment was comfortable, and well-equipped. The host was friendly and responsive.

Ev fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi çok düzenli ve temizdi kendi evinizde ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz tüm imkanlar mevcuttu her ihraç duyduğumuzda en kısa sürede net çözümlerle dönüş aldık güler yüzlü ve sıcak kanlı karşılandık çıkış yaptığımızda hoş ve tatlı sürprizleri mutlu etti 🫠

description: From this centrally located place, you can easily access everything as a group. Close to all historical sites

reviews.text: Just be aware. It isn't the cleanest. It smelled like cigarette smoke. We didn't have enough Toilet paper when we arrived. We saw ants inside. And at bed time there were noisy people in the alley which was annoying. Otherwise, the cost is good, and Firat was friendly and helpful. When we messaged him about some recommendations in the area for food, he gave us some excellent options. And the location was pretty good. Easy to travel to the majority of interesting sites in the city.

Hello, I stayed at firat's place for 11 nights. He is very responsive and communicates well. He always wanted to make sure I had everything I needed. His place is nicely situated in the Old Town area so it was very easy to walk to several tourist spots. Yes, there are some hills. It is a 10-20 minute walk to the Metro or tram so you can go anywhere you want. The apartment is basic, clean and well organized. I liked to easy access. It is close to supermarkets, shops, cafe's and restaurants. I cooked breakfast or dinner or when out on the town. In a hotel it is more difficult to cook. Laundry is just around the corner. He makes it easy to do what you want with your time. Thanks for everything and I recommend his place.

I stayed in Firat place for four days. The place is clean and located close to the blue mosque, and Haja Sophia and restaurants and coffee shops within walking distance. My checking in and checking out went smooth. Host very responsive. I arrived at 4:30 am. in the morning and texted the host to ask for early checking in, and I got a response right away on that time. I never met Firat but his brother received me welcome me and showed me around the neighborhood.
The area is safe and secure. Highly recommend.

This is a very great place. Don’t feel afraid when walking there. It’s REALLY safe. You can walk around without any problem. The place is great, they offer you a kitchen, bathroom. Also equipped with air conditioning or heating. I’d stay here again when I come back to Istanbul.
nice old street in a safe area, very walkable to public transport and major tourist destinations. Firat seems like a lovely fella and host.

description: You can relax as a family in this peaceful accommodation. It is in a magnificent location 5 minutes from the airport. A peaceful apartment in the Lens Yaşam Merkezi, which includes restaurants of the world's cuisines.

reviews.text: Had a really nice stay. Place was clean and just like in the photos. The host was very responsive. Allowed us to check in early. When we needed to find the AC remote, he came to the apartment to help. Lots of restauraunts in the same building complex. About 10mins from the airport. We enjoyed the stay. Thank you.

Ev sahibimiz Ediz Bey çok ilgili ve samimi biriydi. İletişimi hızlı ve her konuda yardımcı oldu. Ev ise oldukça temiz ve düzenliydi, fotoğraflarda gördüğümüzden farksızdı. Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık, gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederimm.
Erken giriş yapmamıza müsade ettiği içinde ayrıca buradan teşekkür etmek isterim

I stayed one night in this apartment. The host was very nice and she let me check in before scheduled which was very good for me. Communication with the host was very good and she was very helpful. The apartment was great, felt like home, very clean and comfortable, also with a beautiful balcony. I will definitely come back!

One of the nicest Airbnb's I've been to and one of the best hosts I've met.
We were stopping by Istanbul for 2 days before travelling ahead and wanted a place near the airport. This was perfect as it's in Lens which has a lot to do and explore. It's also not so far from the nearest metro station which makes getting around the city easier.
The best part was that the host also offered a private pick up and drop off service which helps you avoid any taxis (it's a pain to get a taxi when the distance is so short, so well worth the experience)
Would definitely recommend this to others and looking forward to staying here again :)

My guests (fiancé and his family) from the Gulf countries attended our engagement. Initially, the host was kind, but during the checkout process, my guests were falsely accused of stealing and damaging items. Additionally, some listed amenities were missing, leading to misinformation. The manner in which the host communicated was extremely disrespectful and degrading. Her words and tone were humiliating, and she even compared our guests to those from western countries, which was highly inappropriate.
I have already reported this to customer support because the situation was unacceptable and deeply offensive. Although we didn't make a big deal about the broken items and cleanliness due to our busy schedule with the engagement, the host became upset over our use of extra bed sheets, and iron despite an iron being listed as an available amenity.
However, the way she spoke to me and my fiancé during checkout was intolerable and cannot be excused.

description: We are Mayer Property Mngmnt company with over 100 apts in our portfolio. Spacious and family-friendly Triplex house in the center of Bosphorus. You can enjoy the breathtaking view from all floors, there are 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a 40 sqm private garden w/amazing Bosphorus view. The house has air conditioning in all bedrooms. All kitchen amenities such as coffee maker, blender, and dishwasher. The flat has ultra fast WiFi. You can access luxury shopping malls and Bosphorus in a few mins.

reviews.text:
After five years apart, my family and I chose this property for four nights together in Istanbul. Unfortunately, it was a very disappointing experience.
The listing does not clearly show the stairs or the extremely steep slope in front of the house. There is also a large pothole directly outside. A car became stuck in it and threw stones toward my sister and me while trying to get out, causing injuries and bruising.
The area was extremely noisy, especially on the weekend, with traffic, honking and shouting continuing until 3–4 AM.
Cleanliness was also disappointing. There was dirty, foul-smelling water collected under the sink, a bedroom blanket had what appeared to be dried blood stains, and the terrace furniture was covered with bird droppings. My brother had to wash both terraces himself before a cleaner was eventually sent.
We had no working Wi-Fi for approximately 24 hours, the coffee machine did not work, and the two loung

The location of the villa is very bad, it lays in the middle of an uphill, getting there is difficult and parking is a nightmare, cars pass by and their tires are noisy, it’s hard to sleep with all that noise. One of the bedrooms has two sunroofs without a cover which made the sleep uncomfortable. Also, the place has bugs due to the gardens around it, and the furniture has stains over the pillows and couches. However, the place is well set and aesthetically pleasing, it has nice views which we enjoyed, but unfortunately the downsides made us uncomfortable thoughout our stay.

Probably the worst experience I’ve ever had with airbnb. First, as others have noted, the house is right in front of a steep blind corner and there are extremely loud tire screeching, engine revving, and horn sounds all day and night. The noise made it impossible us to relax or get refreshing sleep.
Then, the house itself: we found flies and ants, stained and missing furniture, sagging floorboards, holes/scratches on the walls, messy/dusty patio areas, spider webs, and lights that didn’t work. The bathroom floor was also dirty.
When I brought these concerns up to the hosts and requested that they let me leave the place early to stay somewhere else (I was still willing to pay for 2 nights), they told me the best they could do was arrange for additional cleaning. Eventually airbnb forced them to refund me, but only after I spent hours of my time making my case. We found a much nicer place a few minutes away for the same price.
Avoid this place and these hosts at all costs.

The host was very good and very communicative. We did like the location of the place and how clean the house was. However service and add ons were not adequate for the money that was being charged. For example you can not drink the water from the tab and as a tourist it is impossible to know where to get the water from we stayed for 2 weeks and there was enough water for 1 days. I think for the amount of money that is being paid the service is not there. I think the host is well intentioned however the lack of attention to detail makes the experience a bit difficult.

Amazing view and 5 min walking from the sea side , the apartment is clean with unique style … the only things is the noise of the cars as the home located on the corna of the hill .
The host is very fast in communication and helpful.

description: Next to the Süleymaniye Mosque, it is within walking distance of historical buildings such as the Grand Bazaar, Sultan Ahmet Mosque, Eminönü, Hagia Sophia Mosque and Galata Tower. You can easily get around Istanbul as it is within walking distance of the tram and metro stations.

reviews.text: Ibrahim’s apartment was spotless and very comfortable. It’s located in a calm and lovely neighborhood, just a 3 minute walk from the beautiful Süleymaniye Mosque. The apartment is exactly as described, very clean, neat, and well-maintained. It’s also very quiet at night, so we slept really well. The check-in and check-out process was smooth and easy, with no waiting time at all. Ibrahim was extremely responsive and friendly, always ready to help whenever we needed something. We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back!

I highly recommend this apartment. The location is central between the University and the Grand Mosque of Suleiman the Magnificent, in a vibrant yet beautifully restored historic neighborhood, close to all transportation. The apartment is exactly as described, comfortable, clean, and has everything you need. The owner is quick to respond to messages and responsive to all requests.

Great stay! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
The location is perfect for exploring the city, and communication with Ibrahim was fast and helpful.
Everything went smoothly, I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended!

The apartment was just like in the photos – beautiful, clean, and tidy. Communication with Ibrahim was great, everything went smoothly. The location of the apartment is excellent as well, with many attractions and public transport options within walking distance. We will definitely return.

You'll find this flat in a strategically good location: the main tourist attractions are within easy walking distance, and public transport points are near also. Small grocery stores and cafés are just around the corner. Most importantly, the wonderful mosque is just a few minutes' walk away.
The apartment itself is not very big, but the bedroom is spacious and comfortable, and the living and dining areas are quite cosy. The kitchen has everything you need to prepare meals.
The apartment is quite warm in the winter season, the heating works well, the environment is tidy and the neighbourhood is quite quiet.
The bathroom is a bit chilly, and there is no thought and preparation on how to dry towels, so this is a nuance that the owner could improve.
Also, the street in front of the apartments is not accessible by car, so you can only reach your transport (transfer, taxi) by a short walk to it.
Overall, I can only recommend this place, and I am satisfied with my stay.

reviews.text: Nice and clean apartment. Apartment had airco and ventilator in the living room and a ceiling fan in the bedroom. Kitchen good accessible with basic needs for daily use. You go to the next street and you can find stores to for groceries and personal care. Restaurants and breakfast places around in the area, easy walk to taksim and back. Overall a area and location to stay with everything in around for basic needs. Ordering food is also easy and a lots of options. Owners are responsive and very helpful.

We enjoyed our stay in the apartment. Everything listed in the description was available. The apartment has everything needed for a comfortable stay.
The check-in instructions were clear, and we had no problems with the arrival process.
Communication with Indigo Homes was excellent — the representatives responded quickly and also checked in with us to make sure everything was fine.
The apartment is located on the 4th floor, as stated in the listing, but this was not a problem, as the stairs are quite convenient. The building itself is in a good area, with many places nearby where you can eat or buy everything you need to cook at home.
It takes about 7–10 minutes to walk from the Tophane tram stop, but the road goes steeply uphill. There is an easier route from Taksim Square, which also takes about 10 minutes, but mostly downhill.
We felt comfortable walking around the area at night. Overall, we were satisfied with our stay.

The apartment has a very convenient location - there are shops and pharmacies nearby, and it’s also within walking distance of Istiklal Street, which made getting around very easy. We did experience some issues with the internet, but the host was very responsive, replied quickly, and genuinely tried to resolve the problem. The building has quite good sound transmission, however we were lucky and the neighbors were quiet at night, so it didn’t affect our stay. We also really appreciated the self check-in and check-out option, it was very convenient and stress-free. Overall, a pleasant stay with a great location

Had a great stay! The flat is in an amazing quiet neighborhood with tons of restaurants and bars. The couch is massive! We had an issue with the pillows in the bedroom and the property managers were able to replace them for us. The room is on the 4th floor with no elevator just a heads up.

description:
Welcome to a great stay at this fully equipped and stylish 1-bedroom apartment in a newly renovated historical building, which faces the historical tourist attraction of Galata Tower. This building is very centrally located next to major tourist attractions, right in the center of Istanbul.

It has every basic amenity you will need and is designed to make you feel "Your sweet home away from home" from the moment you step-in.

Wish you experience a wonderful stay HERE !

reviews.text:
I had an excellent stay at this Airbnb near Galata Tower! The apartment was spotless, well-maintained, and equipped with all the necessary amenities for a comfortable stay. The location is unbeatable — just a 2-minute walk to the iconic Galata Tower and surrounded by charming cafés, shops, and local attractions.
Our host, Nihan, was incredibly cooperative, responsive, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our stay. Her hospitality truly added to the experience.
Highly recommended for anyone looking to stay in the heart of Istanbul with comfort, cleanliness, and a welcoming atmosphere!

Right in front of Galata, which gives you life as soon as you walk out of the building. The area is filled with energy, and it felt very refreshing for me. .
In terms of the apartment itself, it was described exactly like the pictures. Just what we were looking for, and given the location, it was well worth the price.
The best part of the whole experience is how Teori treated her guests. Always making sure everything is good, very professional.
Overall, I think the best way to sum up is to say I will definitely stay here again.

Great value, super responsive host who was able to accommodate on very short notice (booked on the way to the location due to a different booking being cancelled).
Glad I found this as it was super clean, spacious, felt very homely and had everything needed for a short trip!
In a perfect location at an iconic landmark and fun, lively area.
Will definitely remember for when I come back to Istanbul.
Excellent location and great value for the price. The room was clean, comfortable, and well organized. I really enjoyed my stay.

The property is located just in front of Galata tower, surrounded by restaurants and shops. Get ready for crazy crowds outside 24/7 as Galata is very popular. Metro, tram and ferry are in the walking distance as well as major attractions of Istanbul.

description:
This 1BR apartment is located at the heart of city’s coolest neighbourhood ''Moda'' walking distance to Kalamış Coast, shops, restaurants, famous bars, markets and all transportation. Just a 5 minutes walk to the famous “Boğa Heykeli”.

- Designed with taste, this apartment will be ideal for anyone who is seeking comfort, a “home like” atmosphere, accessibility to major tourist attractions.

-Self check-in is also available using the password.

reviews.text:
We had a perfect stay in this apartment. Everything was spotless, from the comfort of the space to the quality of the service. The host was exceptional, always available and attentive, making our experience even more enjoyable.
The apartment is ideally located, very well maintained, and the cleaning service during our stay was flawless. The staff is professional and serious, ensuring a top-notch experience.
The value for money is simply incredible! We highly recommend it and will gladly return.
Thank you again for this perfect experience!

I have stayed here for two months, September-October 2024.
I highly recommend this place.
The place:
The place is clean and everything you need are provided. There are ample space in the room.
The location:
It’s located in an ideal place. It’s away from busy and noisy area. And yet, you are close to everything such as park, promenada, shops and restaurants. Boats or Metro to the European side are located 15 minute walking distance.
The host:
During business hours, there are people in the office. I mostly spoke with Deniz and Mona. They are friendly, knowledgeable and always eager to assist. During off hours, my emails were always promptly responded.
Having explored everywhere in Istanbul for two months, I can confidently state that the place I have stayed was the best choice. Next year, when I revisit this fascinating city, I will stay at the same place.
Hint: Always walk from Taksim Squre to Galatea Tower. If walk in reverse, you will be climbing steep hill.

The apartment is excellent located, 12-15 min walk from Kadikoy Pier, bus station, metro station and Kadikoy Havaist which is convenient if you are traveling with big suitcases.
Iclal was very responsive, clear instructions and good advice on where to eat around.
The lady at the main desk was nice and helpful, so was Deniz when I met him just at the end.
Definitely will stay here again If coming back to Istanbul. The park close by is beautiful; I was so lucky to be able to see +15 dolphins the morning when I went for a walk!
Mu only complain is that even though smoking is not allowed in the building, if other people is smoking in other apartments you can get the smell through the bathroom vents and nearly impossible to get rid of the smell.

This was my second time staying in a listing hosted by Deniz, in the same building. My first stay was one of the best experiences I’ve had in Istanbul, but the comfort of this one was disappointing. The bed is quite uncomfortable and uneven, and the apartment heats up very quickly because of the south-facing windows. The AC unfortunately isn’t strong enough to keep it cool, so at night you’re left choosing between the heat inside or the noise from the Kadıköy streets outside. The wifi also cut out from time to time.
That said, Deniz is a great host, and I’d still highly recommend him — if not this apartment, then definitely one of his other listings.

5 stars ★★★★★
This was our third time staying at D&D Suit, and once again, it was a fantastic experience! The location is unbeatable just a short walk to the beautiful Moda Coast Park, where you can relax by the sea and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere. The apartment is always clean, cozy. The neighborhood has such a great vibe with lots of nice cafes and local shops. It really feels like a home away from home. Highly recommended.

reviews.text:
We wanted to escape the noise of Sultanahmet area for a few days until the flight out, and got exactly that in Buğra's apartment.
The apartment had all the amenities listed, was very comfortable; we had a peaceful night of sleep. Cooking was also possible, there was a small refrigerator, shower was very clean with all the usuals provided. I appreciated the view from the terrace – rooftops of the houses nearby, a minaret of a nearby mosque, and huge high-rise buildings in the distance, it was just beautiful.
The apartment was reachable comfortably on foot from the Gayrettepe M2 station which was perfect for getting to the airport on time with no traffic jams and the accompanying worries.
Buğra communicated very clearly, proactively and in a friendly manner; he helped us with the later check-out and keeping our luggage while we were getting something to eat before catching the flight.
Oh, and there is a bakery across the street – get your daily simit there :) Will gladly come back!

description:
Hello
This studio apartment in the Sultanahmet area is operated by the Maniz tourism company. It is located within a 10-15 minute walk to tram stops, Topkapı Palace, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, Hagia Sophia and many other historical buildings. There are also many markets, laundries, restaurants, pharmacies, taxi stops, etc. around our building. Our building has 4 floors and there is one unit on each floor. This studio is located on the ground floor of our building.
We'd be delighted to host you.

reviews.text:
This super clean, quiet, and comfortable mini-apartment has everything the single traveler needs to enjoy a vacation in Istanbul. The location is convenient for access to sightseeing and public transportation (including IST airport via M11, M2, and T1 which now connect). The Maniz hosts are very friendly, helpful, and responsive. I enjoyed my 5 night stay there very much.
The apartment has been nicely modernized (see photos) with an en-suite bathroom, well-equipped kitchenette, good heat (and A/C), good wi-fi, comfortable single bed, 4k TV, and other amenities.
It is on a side street 6 minutes walk south (down the steep side street) from the Cemberlitas T1 tram stop (it is near the bottom of the street).
From the apartment it is a 10 minute walk north to the Grand Bazaar; 20 minute east to the Blue Mosque; 5 minute southeast to convenient restaurants, bakeries, and a supermarket ("A101") on nearby Kadirga Limani Street.
Very highly recommended. I will be happy to stay there again.

I had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Sultanahmet, Istanbul. Communication with the host was excellent—very responsive and helpful throughout the entire stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The staff were incredibly kind and accommodating, which made the experience even better.
The location is perfect—just a short walk to all the major attractions, shops, restaurants, and public transportation. If you're visiting Istanbul and want to stay in the heart of everything, this place is a fantastic choice. Highly recommended!

Great value for money. Maniz was very responsive, quick in helping and kind.
The apartment is a room with small kitchen and bathroom, just what you need for few days in Istanbul. It was clean and tidy. Location is probably the highlight: you are literally 9 mins away walking distance from Blue Mosque and St Sophia. Great restaurants down the main street. Recommended.

The place was great and comfortable;
The AC, fridge and shower worked perfectly, the place is extremely conveniently situated (less then 10 minute walk from the Hagia Sophia), amazing restaurants in the surrounding streets, check-in was super easy and Maniz was extremely proactive in communication regarding questions, check-in, etc.
Definitely to book for solo travellers looking for a convenient place to stay in the heart of Istanbul!
Thank you Maniz!

I had a truly perfect Airbnb experience staying here. Everything went smoothly from check-in to check-out, and the entire process was easy and stress-free. The place was exactly as described: clean, comfortable, and very well maintained, which made my stay even more enjoyable.
Maniz was an amazing host, very helpful, friendly, and always quick to respond to any questions or needs I had. Communication was clear and efficient throughout my stay, which I really appreciated.
Overall, I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Highly recommended!

reviews.text:
Batur is a great host, very responsive and helpful, he specifically came to handover keys and explained each and every thing in house and even allowed to send message if I need any help.
The house is located at prime location just 15 minutes walk from Galata Bridge, 10 minutes walk from Taksim square and all Turkish and even Indian restaurants are around.
The inside the house is beautifully decorated as if some interior designer planned it.
Kitchen has all the requisite items for cooking food and having drinks at home and has fridge too.
Both bedrooms are adequately equipped with neat and clean bedsheets, bedcovers, pillow covers and curtains etc
The washroom has all toiletries, enough towels etc.
There is lift in the building and the flat is at 5th floor
The roof top is beautifully decorated with sea view and has table n chairs to relax in evening with drinks.
OverallI would strongly recommend this property and it’s a superb value for money and super host is a bonus.

Batur's place is an absolute gem in every way. Located in the heart of Cihangir (on a flat, non-hilly street), steps from thriving cafes, restaurants and nightlife and a 5 min walk to Istiklal. It's a 2 bed/ 1 bath flat on the 5th floor of a charming old building with a small elevator (a rarity in Istanbul). Rooftop access (one flight of stairs) with magical views of the Golden Horn. It's surreal to savour wine/ raki here while listening to the evening prayer echo across the city from multiple mosques lit up in golden hues. The flat itself is cosy, comfortable and spotlessly clean. Batur is SUCH a kind and thoughtful host. He received us in person, gave us an orientation, and recommendations. Hair dryer, iron and board, plenty of hand and bath towels, well-stocked kitchen with espresso machine and coffee pods, and a large canister of bottled water to start us out with. Thank you Batur for all of this (none of which we got in other AirBnBs in Turkey!). This was a 15/10 experience!

I cannot recommend the place enough. It looks just like in the photos, a beautiful apartment on the 5th floor of a building located near the Taxim square. The place was spacious and very very clean. Berkay was there to let us in, three hours before the scheduled time, something we really appreciated, since we had a very early flight.
The view is magnificent, the kitchen is equipped with anything one needs, there is also plenty of space if one needs to check the emails.
Berkay sent us many suggestions for food and sightseeing. I personally loved Journey for breakfast, among others.
All in all, a great place, clean, central and comfortable (we are a family of 3).
Berkay, thank you very much for your kindness.

We have had a great stay at Batur's place.
The views from the flat and upper terrace are amazing.
The apartment is very clean, nice living room, equiped kitchen and comfortable rooms
Cihangir keeps being a very nice neighborhood, central, and quiet and lively at the same time.
Lovely stay in a comfortable place, in a lovely neighborhood in an amazing city.
Çok memnun olduk, teşekkür ederiz

When we come to Istanbul we always stay in this area for its great restaurants, cafes, supermarkets and location. It’s quite different to the Eminonu area which tends to be more touristy. That said, this area can get pretty noisy at night. We chose to leave the windows open for the air and to stay cool - so it was noisy, but there is air conditioning if you opt to close the windows to keep the noise out.
The apartment itself is spacious and airy with great views. The dining/living area is large, open and comfortable. The two bedrooms are a good size, likewise the bathroom and kitchen. There is also a washing machine. Everything works!
Batur was an excellent host and responded quickly to messages.
We really enjoyed our stay Batur. This is definitely one of our favourite apartments so far! Thanks again!

description:
✨ YOU ARE RENTING THE ENTIRE APARTMENT
A comfortable private apartment in the heart of Kadıköy, within walking distance of the metro and metrobus. Ideal for digital nomads, Erasmus students, and remote workers. There is a double bed and an L-shaped sofa in the 1st bedroom, and there are 2 armchairs in the living room. It can accommodate up to 8 people🌼 There is a cold air blower✨Guests can use the study, the living room, and the fully equipped kitchen with a kettle, stove, oven, and refrigerator.

reviews.text: Nevin (Gamze) is a very kind and helpful host. She carried my bags up the stairs, and offered to help with making appointments or finding places to go. The bedroom is very bright and comfortable. The other residents are nice people too. The street and the area are really vibrant. Nevin's place is ideal for sightseeing as it's close to the ferry, metro and Marmaray train. I recommend it to visitors to Istanbul.

I've stayed at Gamze's place for a few nights, although we didn't spend time together she was nice when we met (I had all the apartment for myself). The place is as described in the photos. There was some issue with the keys in check-in and check-out, also some with planning, apparently there was an error at Airbnb system and I booked a period she wasn't available to host.. It's a bit difficult to get into the building due to stores in front and the building felt a bit sketchy, but the location is close to everything. It's a bit mixed review.. , but I'm sure you'll have a great stay when she figures out the issue with Airbnb :)
Place was clean and perfect, and was at very central location. Also, Gamze was very helpful and responsive. Would definitely consider this place for my next visit.
Cansu was very friendly and helpful in any situation. Location is perfect. I would recommend this place for sure.
The host accommodated my requests and translated everything perfectly. The house is well located, and Istanbul has a long history.

description:
The facility is located in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, and Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service to keep your comfort at the top, where they can stay like their own home.

reviews.text:
The host was very polite and responded promptly to my inquiries. They were able to store my luggage for me before check-in, which was very helpful. The location was great, with many tourist attractions within walking distance.
However, the room had a slight cigarette smell, the Wi-Fi was weak, no soap to wash hands and there were spider webs on the bathroom window. Also, curtains on the pillow-side window of the main bed didn't close all the way, so it was impossible to sleep in complete darkness. I believe that these problems will be solve by the host after my complains because I felt he was a warm person trying to improve the environment for us.
But, music and voices from the club next door doesn't make a quiet night, however my children and I slept well.
This is a great place for people who prioritize convenience and could sleep well even with music.

It was a nice stay and we had a good host.
The personnel were very friendly as well!
It’s an old building, so you can hear some noise sometimes from the outside (music), and inside from the neighbor upstairs (when they walk on heels).
Overall it was cheap and you can get to Hagia Sophia within half an hour or so.

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb. The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The location was excellent—right in the heart of town, making it very easy to explore the area and visit nearby attractions, restaurants, and shops.
The service was also outstanding. Our host was very friendly, helpful, and responsive throughout our stay, which made us feel welcome and well taken care of.

Exactly located apartment for your Istanbul stay. the restaurant next to the apartment is also amazing. The apartment was serviced daily and it was nice to come back to a clean place daily with beds made. all in all highly recommended! btw the ceiling in my bedroom was amazing

Fatih’s place is very clean and just as shown in pictures. It is a great location for some fun, restaurants and shops are steps away from your door. Fatih was very helpful and made sure we arrived safely. Teşekkürler!

description:
Enjoy your stay in a spacious 3-bedroom apartment just steps from the iconic Galata Tower. Perfect for families or groups, the home offers a fully equipped kitchen, cozy living area, and modern comfort in a historic neighborhood. Walk to cafés, shops, and major attractions with ease. A true Istanbul experience in the heart of the city!

Note : Our flat is on the 3rd floor and there is no elevator access, access is provided by stairs.

reviews.text:
I definitely recommend this place! It’s clean, spacious, and very comfortable. Most rooms had air conditioning, which was a big plus during the hot July weather in Istanbul. The apartment had everything we needed and more. We really enjoyed our stay and would be happy to come back. Special thanks for letting us check out a bit later.
The location is great - just a 3-minute walk from Galata Tower, but the street itself is quiet, without too much noise. There are many bars and cafes nearby, so we had plenty of breakfast options and tried a different place every day - that was great!
The only downside was the lack of clear check-in instructions. Most communication happens via WhаtsАрр, and check-in info came there. I tried to figure it out myself, took the wrong keys, and had to go up and down the steep stairs with my suitcase. Later, host sent a photo of the correct key and door - it would be better to send this earlier. Also, note that the apartment is on the 3rd floor with no elevator.

The price is good, and location is good. Host is responsive. However the shower is very painful to use. There is no consistent hot water, even with the host’s instruction to tweak the water heater, there is still no hot water. The temperature changes between cold and like warm constantly. So some of us who cannot take cold showers couldn’t shower for the entire stay. We were also left with only half a roll of toilet paper for 6 people for 2 nights of stay.

The apartment is very spacious, has three bedrooms, and an excellent location near Galata Tower. The bed in the main bedroom is very comfortable; however, we had difficulty getting proper rest. None of the rooms have blackout curtains, and they all suffer from street light coming in at night. The main bedroom, specifically, is directly in front of a street lamp and stays very bright all night, making it hard to sleep for anyone sensitive to light.
Additionally, the property needs some basic maintenance: the bathroom had an unpleasant odor and signs of water damage (leaks) on the ceiling. In the hallway, there was an exposed power outlet, which we found dangerous, especially since we were traveling with children. Finally, please note that the building is old and access is via three flights of stairs. With a few maintenance repairs and the installation of blackout curtains, the stay would be much better

The location was perfect, a solid 10/10. The apartment was clean, nicely furnished, spacious and perfectly located. From the living room you could see the tourists enjoying the view on top of the Galata Tower. With the metro station Sishane and the port of Karaköy both in walking distance the whole city is accessible. Lastly, the wonderful host was nice enough to let us check in later since the apartment was free after us. That was highly appreciated and made our life that day much easier. Thanks for providing the perfect apartment to enjoy a beautiful weekend in marvellous Istanbul :)

How special to stay in Recep’s apartment during New Year’s Eve and have a view of Galata Tower at all times from the living room window! This apartment could not be more centrally located, right in the hub of things. We loved the location and the apartment itself is beautiful with a fantastic kitchen, dining and lounge area. 3 bedrooms, a spacious bathroom catered to our family very well.
Recep was an amazing host, very responsive and nothing was too much trouble - when I messaged to ask about some amenities he had some ordered and delivered to the apartment within 30 minutes. Thank you so much Recep! Highly recommend to anyone!

description:
Bosphorus View, Spacious and Comfortable 3+1 Apartment

Are you ready to wake up to a unique Bosphorus view, in the heart of nature? Our spacious 3+1 apartment offers both a comfortable and private accommodation experience with its private entrance, fully equipped kitchen and free Wi-Fi. reviews.text: My husband and I went for our honeymoon, and it was such a cool place! Looks exactly like the photos, and they had so many things available—from the pans in the kitchen to a handheld steamer. Housekeeping was very punctual and always left the place looking like we were never there. I was able to reach the hosts very easily to ask for housekeeping or any other questions and get a response within a reasonable time. Our only small "complaint" was that after the first evening, our shower water was always cool or fully cold😅 Otherwise, no real problems! It's in a bit of an awkward spot on the road, but the surrounding area has lots to offer and within a several minutes walk. The intersection outside is always busy, so if you don't mind a little noise, this is a great place to stay. Should you need, you can easily take a yellow taxi anywhere as well. Overall, a neat place to stay if you plan on being indoors more or in a smaller city😊

Host was very attentive and helpful, even let us extend our check-out time to help with our time of departure. They answered questions quickly. The only issue we ran into was the address and map location are about a block and a half away from the actual location and we had to stop and ask for directions. The place was very clean and looked exactly as described. Would definitely stay again.

We stayed here for a week. The apartment is per the photos and overall a very nice place to stay. Only criticism is the outdoor furniture cushions were dirty so couldn’t really sit outside and the kitchen could also benefit from a toaster and a microwave. Views were fantastic and the host was extremely respondent.

Staying at Berker’s Airbnb was an absolute dream from start to finish. The apartment is exactly as described—modern, stylish, and beautifully designed down to the smallest detail. Everything was spotless and perfectly maintained, making it feel more like a luxury boutique hotel than an Airbnb.
The location was perfect—close to everything yet peaceful enough to relax after a day of exploring. Berker was the perfect host: warm, welcoming, and always quick to respond to any questions. He truly went above and beyond to make sure my stay was comfortable, from offering local tips to checking in to see if I needed anything.
You can tell Berker takes pride in hosting, and it shows in every aspect of the experience. I left feeling so refreshed and happy, and I wouldn’t hesitate for a second to stay here again. If you’re looking for a beautiful, modern home with an amazing host, this is the place. Thank you, Berker, for making my trip unforgettable! 🌟
The house has everything that you need, nice terrace and view, fully equipment kitchen, a comfy bed, smart tv… You have all the local shops downstairs, cool neighborhood with nice restaurants.

description:
Nest Apart Ortaköy | Comfortable and Stylish Apartments Close to the Bosphorus

Located in Ortaköy, one of Istanbul's most popular and historic districts, just a few minutes' walk from the Bosphorus, Nest Apart offers its guests an unforgettable accommodation experience with its modern apartments that combine stylish design and home comfort.

In our apartments, where every detail is meticulously considered:
✅ Comfortable beds
✅ Air conditioning and heating system
✅ Fast and free Wi-Fi
✅ Smart TV
✅ A quiet and safe environment awaits you.

reviews.text:
The house was clean, looked exactly like the pictures, and was generally as described. Unfortunately, our experience with the host was very disappointing. Check-in was difficult due to poor communication, and once we arrived, there was no toilet paper or hairdryer despite these being listed as amenities.
My wife ended up getting sick during our stay due to having wet hair, which made the lack of basic amenities even more frustrating. We tried reaching out to the host several times, but he remained unresponsive throughout our entire stay.
The place itself is fine and as pictured, but communication with the host was practically nonexistent. Because of this, I unfortunately cannot recommend staying here.

Erkan çok ilgili ve yardımsever bir hosttu. Ev gayet temiz ve düzenliydi, konumu da oldukça iyiydi. Giriş-çıkış süreci çok kolaydı, hiçbir sorun yaşamadık. Kısa süreli konaklamamız için her şey yeterliydi, rahat ettik. Gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edilebilir
Very comfortable location. Right next to Ortakoy mosque but also peaceful surroundings. Host also nice, self check in which I really liked.

Gayet güzel bir konaklamaydı oda gayet temizdi yatak rahattı banyo temizdi ve yeterliydi tek ve çift kişilik konaklamalar için kesinlikle fiyat performans olarak çok iyi

The apartment offered an incredible view, comparable to a seven-star experience overlooking the Bosphorus and the Golden Horn, both day and night. The host team was exceptionally helpful. Ahmet assisted us from our arrival until checkout, managing our luggage and fulfilling all our requests. Osman and Resul were also fantastic, especially when our lost luggage was delivered from the airport at 11:30 PM; Osman coordinated with Rasul to ensure it was picked up, even though they weren't on-site at that time.
The apartment's location was fantastic, just a short walk to the Şişhane bus and metro and hop-on-hop-off tour bus stations, and only about five minutes from Istiklal Street. There was a grocery store right next to the building and a small sandwich shop just steps away. The main avenue leads directly to Istiklal Street, passing by numerous coffee shops and restaurants. I hope you can book your stay and enjoy your trip here!

This is a mixed review.
Pros: 1. The View, 2. Very quiet and peaceful mainly residential area and 3. It’s a good sized apartment.
Cons.:1. We arrived at around 9.15 pm, it was dark already and the taxi driver was confused about the exact address. 2. Used empty bottles of shampoo and soap left lying in the shower. Washed dishes still lying on the kitchen rack from previous guests.

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place in the heart of Kadıköy/ Moda. Just a minute walk to cafes and restaurants.

Before each reservation, our apartment is cleaned by a professional cleaning company and clean towels, bed linen are provided.

The flat and all the equipment has been completely renovated on August 2025.

reviews.text:
Canberk is a very hospitable, attentive, and helpful host — communication was easy, and he’s clearly put real effort into making the place comfortable. The apartment is renovated and thoughtfully set up: new furniture/electronics, a pristine bathroom, a great shower, a very comfortable bed, plenty of artificial light, and reliable Wi-Fi for working.
The location is the standout: quiet street, yet ~5 minutes to the lively center of Kadıköy with tons of cafes, bars, restaurants, and groceries.
That said, the apartment is tiny and feels noticeably smaller than the photos suggest. It’s basement-level, so there’s very limited daylight. And the bedroom can be noisy at night—light sleepers may want earplugs.
Overall, it’s a solid choice for a solo traveler or a couple if you mainly need a clean, functional place to sleep for a few nights and spend most of your time out exploring. If you plan to hang out inside a lot (or you’re a bigger group), it may not be the best fit.

Great stay, highly recommend!
Canberk was very helpful and quick to reply. Check-in was smooth, the apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly like the photos. The location is excellent-close to everything we needed. Communication was easy throughout the stay. Thank you for hosting us, we’d gladly come back.

The apartment is just as described - clean, cozy, well equipped and in a great location close to many restaurants and the sea. Canberk is an amazing host, always ready to help and quickly to respond. I recommend this places and would happily stay again :)

Çok keyifli bir tatildi, öneririm herkese.

The location is just awesome: hidden in a quiet corner of the Moda district, far from the madding crowds in the streets, yet only a short walk from the bustling atmosphere of Kadıköy.
The flat itself has everything required: a fully equipped kitchen, a nice shower area, and a comfortable workspace. The living area feels a bit smaller than it appears in the photos, but the bedroom is actually more spacious and offers plenty of storage.
Canberk provides clear instructions and responds quickly to any questions or requests. It was a pleasure staying at his place and communicating with him.

description:

reviews.text: Yasin was great and helpful. The place is well located and accessible. Close to a bus station which is really helpful if you are using public transport. The downside is that when people smoke inside the hotel you can smell all over the place. Other than that, all good.

Yasin is great host and the place is as described, location is perfect.

For the price compared to other places in the area on this website I can’t complain. Room is small which was not a bother and the wifi is inconsistent so I got a data plan. Staff was friendly and helpful.
Great stay for the price. Extremely good location in my opinion near Kadiköy's ferry port/bus terminal/metro.
