reviews.text: The stay was excellent in every way. The host was extremely kind, helpful, and responsive from the moment of booking until check-out. Communication was smooth and clear, and the host truly cared about guest comfort. The apartment was spotless, very clean, and well maintained, which made the stay feel comfortable and relaxing from the first moment. The location is also excellent, easy to access, and close to everything needed. A truly professional host — highly recommended, and I would definitely stay here again.

We stayed in a very modern and clean apartment.
Everything was new. The air conditioning was new, we had a smart TV, a large kitchen, and the Wi-Fi was very fast and worked perfectly. Our large family of eight stayed here comfortably. What we saw in the Airbnb photos matched what we saw in reality. That was the most important thing. Best regards.

We stay for 6 nights as a family of 8. The room is spacious, toilets are clean, kitchen with utensils and we had a comfortable stay.
Very close to Galata tower, Tophane station with restaurants and grocery close by.
Recommended for anyone who visit Istanbul.

Our stay was absolutely wonderful. The room was spotless and very comfortable, and the location was perfect - central, convenient, and ideal for exploring Istanbul. Ulvi was an exceptional host! kind, friendly, and always ready to help, especially with my elderly grandmother, which meant so much to us.
He also arranged a very reasonably priced airport transfer and gave us incredible support when our flights were cancelled last minute. We felt genuinely cared for throughout our stay. It was a pleasure staying here, and we would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Excellent apartment. Large and spacious. Easily accommodated our large group even though it was a last minute booking. Host went above and beyond and upgraded us to a larger apartment. Even offered us a discounted taxi to the airport (half price).

description: Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun.

reviews.text:
The apartment looks exactly like in the photos. The building is not new, but everything was clean. Fresh sheets and towels were provided, along with basic amenities like shampoo and slippers. There was heating in the room, and it was warm and comfortable, which I did not expect in Istanbul in December.
The host was extremely responsive and helpful. It was also possible to leave luggage after checkout.
The location is great! Just a 5 min walk to Galata Port, Galata Tower and Istiklal Street. The area is quiet at night, with no noisy bars or car traffic.

We stayed as a family of five and were extremely pleased with every aspect of our stay. The house was spotlessly clean, spacious, and even more comfortable than it appeared in the photos. The location was perfect; it was very convenient for transportation, and everything we needed, including markets and cafes, was within walking distance.
Our host was incredibly kind, attentive, and hospitable. Their warm welcome made us feel safe and comfortable from the moment we arrived. They responded very quickly to all our questions and were very kind and thoughtful in helping us with every need.
In short, we had a wonderful experience, both thanks to the comfort of the house and the host's warmth. We would definitely choose this place again without hesitation. I highly recommend it!
thanks Ulvi

We had a great stay!
The studio is in a perfect location in the heart of Galata and is very comfortable for up to 5 guests. The apartment was very clean and well equipped. Having a washing machine, dryer, a fully equipped kitchen, and daily free cleaning service made our stay extra comfortable.
The host Ulvi, was very friendly, helpful, and easy to communicate with. Everything went smoothly.
Highly recommended we’d happily stay here again!

We stayed in this apartment as a family of five and had a truly wonderful experience. The place was extremely clean, well-organized, spacious, and fully equipped with everything we needed. It was even more comfortable than it appeared in the photos.
The location was very central and convenient, with easy access to markets, restaurants, and public transportation. It was also a very comfortable place for families traveling with children.
Our host Mr. Ulvi was incredibly kind, attentive, and welcoming. From check-in to check-out, they were always in touch with us and responded quickly to all our questions. Thanks to their hospitality, we felt completely at home.
We highly recommend this place and would definitely choose to stay here again if we visit the area in the future.
Thank you so much ulvi

Spacious, clean and pretty stay a short walk from Galata Tower. Everything about this place is 10/10. Surrounded by pretty buildings and cafes straight out of a Pinterest board. The beds are very comfortable and the bathroom very clean.
I must mention the water pressure and temperature in the bathroom was wonderful, nothing like any Airbnb I’ve been to before!
Our host was great and very responsive, anything we needed he brought within 5 minutes.
I would 100% come again and recommend to family and friends.

description:
A Dreamy Stay with Unique Comfort and Istanbul View at Ottomare

Get ready to stay in the Ottomare residence, which embraces the fascinating blue of the Sea of Marmara in the heart of Istanbul. Combining modern architecture, luxurious details and holiday comfort with everyday life, this private apartment is designed to offer its guests a unique experience for both short-term visits and long stays.

One of the most attractive features of the apartment is its balcony with sea views.

24/7 security

reviews.text: Her İstanbul ziyaretimde kalmak isteyeceğim bir yer oldu. Deniz manzarası gerçekten fotoğraflardan daha güzel görünüyor. Ev çok sıcak bir atmosfere sahipti ve insan kendini yabancı hissetmiyor. Konumu da oldukça avantajlı.

İstanbul’da kaldığım en rahat yerlerden biri oldu diyebilirim. Balkon manzarası harikaydı ve evin içinde ihtiyaç duyulan her şey vardı. Özellikle temizliği ve düzeni beni çok memnun etti. Uzun süre kalınabilecek konforlu bir yer.

Resul Bey harika bir ev sahibi. Ev fotogtaflarda gosterildigi gibi, hic bir eksik yok. Temizlik mukemmeldi. Kendisi her soruma usenmeden oncesinde ve sonrasinda cevap verdi. Dusunmeden kiralama yapabilirsiniz.
Tertemiz ferah ve güzel daire, herşey yolundaydı.

Konaklamam boyunca hiçbir sorun yaşamadım. Ev hem çok ferah hem de oldukça kullanışlıydı. Deniz manzarası özellikle akşamları inanılmaz güzel oluyor. Sessiz, huzurlu ve güven veren bir ortamı vardı. Ev sahibi de her konuda çok ilgiliydi.

description: Experience the charm of Galata in this cozy and elegant 1-bedroom flat designed for two. Just steps away from Galata Tower, cafés, boutiques, and the metro. Enjoy a stylish living space, a comfortable double bed, fully equipped kitchen, fast WiFi, and a peaceful atmosphere in the heart of Beyoğlu. Perfect for couples seeking a romantic and central stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
We had a great stay, Burak was extremely helpful and always available. The location is simply perfect, walking distance from tram station, Galata, and has great crowd and cafes around the areas. The kitchen could have been cleaner but other than that, it was definitely worth the money.
Again I would like to emphasize on how helpful the entire team was, they helped us out with local recommendations.
Even when we had a slight issue at the apartment, Burak came to help is out at 1 am to make sure we were comfortable, Simply amazing host. thankyou.

The apartment is new and well-equipped for longer stays with a dishwasher, a washing machine, a microwave, cleaning supplies, dishes and cutlery (be careful: there is no smart TV, but you can borrow an HDMI cable or a projector from the host ^^). The interior design is very pleasant, with appealing colours and decorations, and beautiful wooden floors add to the overall charm of the apartment. There is definitely enough space for two people, especially considering a separate bedroom. The location is fantastic, with plenty of cafes and restaurants just round the corner, and multiple attractions, shops or public transport hubs within walking distance. Highly recommended accommodation!

Ev tertemizdi fotoğraflarda gözüktüğü gibiydi her şey, nevresimler havlular temizdi evimizde gibi hissettik, ev konum olarak çok güzeldi toplu taşıma restorant ve marketler yürüme mesafesindeydi, evde bir kusur yoktu Mücahid bey konaklamamda bana çok yardımcı oldu geri dönüşler çok hızlı ve yapıcıydı evin temizliği beni mest etti tekrardan Avrupa yakasında konaklarsam kesinlikle ilk tercihim burası olacak gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edebilirsiniz.

Good location. Walking distance to Tram.
Is a hilly area so expect a good cardiac workout when going to the accommodation.
Good restaurants nearby.
Good airconditioning in Lounge

The Visit was nice and the communication was very friendly. The apartment was very clean and we had a super easy and flexibel check-in and check-out.
The apartment was overall good and we liked the stay, even if it sometimes smelled a bit weird.
Perfekt stay for the Visit in Istanbul. Would recommend :-)

description:
This luxury apartment with an architectural design is located in Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu, within easy walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, which are among the most vibrant areas of Istanbul.

You can reach all parts of Istanbul with 24/7 transportation, you can reach many social areas in minutes, from shopping to entertainment, coastal walks in the Bosphorus, to places with a view of the Bosphorus

I offer a place to stay where my guests can feel at home, and I provide 24/7 reception support for their comfort.

reviews.text:
We had the best stay at Fatih’s place! The apartment was exactly as pictured-spotlessly clean, comfortable, and in a fantastic central location. Despite being in a busy area, it was always peaceful and quiet inside. Fatih was also incredibly responsive and always quick to help whenever we had a question.
Although climbing the four flights of stairs was a bit of a workout, the apartment was absolutely worth it. We’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it!

We had a great stay, the place is really well located and quiet. We really appreciated the decoration decorated . We slept well, the bed was comfortable, the linens clean. Would definitely come back! The place is new and very clean and the team is very responsive and helpful. The person at the reception helped us carry our big suitcase up the stairs.

The flat is exactly as shown and genuinely easy to live in. You come in to a neat entrance with built-in storage, coat hooks and, then a short run of light stone steps takes you up into a calm, well-finished main space.
The kitchenette is cleverly set into a wood-lined niche with clean white cabinets, a full-height fridge, and the living area is properly comfortable with a large sofa, soft textiles and a TV on a long low console. The bathroom is compact but modern and spotless, with a heated towel rail and a practical shower set-up. Wifi and heating, and A/C available.
Mr Fatih was extremely responsive from start to finish, which made everything effortless. Communication was quick, clear and helpful, and it felt like someone was actually paying attention. I’d happily stay again and will definitely be back.

The apartment is everything you need for a stay in Istanbul be it for work or pleasure. The place is stylish, comfortable, clean and has all the amenities one needs. It’s on the fifth floor so do consider this if you have mobility issues. You are literally steps away from Istiklal street but the side street is not too noisy. With windows closed the excellent restaurant downstairs (among the best in this area) is not going to bother you. You are minutes away from sights and public transport so it’s a great place to stay if you want to visit Istanbul. Be it your first time or the hundredth time in Istanbul you will enjoy this place. Fatih is an excellent host and will be of help for your needs during your stay. The place si fairly large and two people will not feel crammed here. Plenty of storage space will keep the beautiful room clear of clutter. At times you will just want to enjoy the confort and take a break with a glass of wine on the balcony away from the rhythm of the city.

After having a bad experience with our first accommodation in Istanbul’s historic center, we decided to move to Beyoğlu and found a place that was exactly our style! The apartment was lovely, and our host, Fatih, was very responsive and helpful. Even though the apartment is on the 5th floor, it was totally worth it!
Another big plus was Mornings in Pera, right downstairs. The coffee and breakfast were some of the best we had in Istanbul! ☕️
We highly recommend this apartment and would definitely stay here again!

description:
From our building, located in the center of the SULTANAHMET area, you can easily access many historical buildings (SULTANAHMET MOSQUE, HAGIA SOPHIA, TOPKAPI PALACE, BASILICA CISTERN, etc.).
etc.) You can easily get to tram stops, restaurants, and shopping stores, which are just a short walk away.
In the area where our building is located, there are a park, grocery stores, a taxi stand, restaurants, and cafes.
We will be delighted to have you as our guest.

reviews.text: Helpful communicative host, good centrally located flat
Gayet temizdi tüm sorunlarımıza hızlı bir şekilde çözüm sundu gönül rahatlığı ile kalabileceğiniz yerlerden biri
Yavuz Bey’e gerçekten çok teşekkür ederim, temiz konforlu bir daire, ilgisi ve alakası çok güzeldi, konumu çok iyi merkezi, her şey için teşekkür ederim.
Temiz ve düzenliydi
Gayet temiz ve güzeldi , hızlıca mesajlarıma geri dönüş sağladı

description:
Set in the dynamic neighborhood of Moda on Istanbul’s Asian side, this luxurious two-floor apartment is a sumptuous yet calming space that offers everything one could need, whether in Istanbul for business or pleasure.
The apartment's patio is located on the downstairs of the apartment, at the rear of the building.

reviews.text:
Really enjoyed our stay, right on one of my favorite streets in the area with lots of lively cafes, shops, and markets nearby. Yet the back patio area was so peaceful and quiet.
Amenities were great, spacious apartment (felt bigger than in pictures), very comfortable beds as well.
Check in & out process super easy, hosts were always available and responsive, consistently asking if we needed anything else!

This was the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. Everything was just perfect from start to finish. The place had everything we could possibly need, and you can tell a lot of thought went into making it comfortable and easy to stay in.
What I loved most was how quiet and relaxing it was even while being in the heart of the ciry. It felt peaceful the moment we walked in, and it is the kind of place you look forward to coming back to after being out all day. Everything was clean, comfortable, well equipped, and exactly as it should be.
I honestly can’t think of a single complaint. There’s nothing I would want to change. Absolutely perfect, and I would stay here again without hesitation.

The place is perfectly located in the heart of Kadikoy. It's newly renovated, chic, spacious, and comfortable. The 2.5 bathrooms make life easy for group stays. The building is also very modern and convenient overall, which is not always what you get in Kadikoy. I'd definitely book again!
Small caveat that doesn't take any stars away from my review: the kitchen equipment is very nice but a bit minimal, and some basics (such as shampoo or soap) were not provided for us. I'm sure if we had asked for it the host would've provided; but we already bought some at the store. The WiFi was not great if you plan to work. But I had the same issue at another place; I wonder if it's a common problem.
We had an excellent stay!

The location is great and it's quiet - that's the best I can say. The apartment is tired and badly needs renovation. There's a strong smell of damp and sewage that the incense sticks placed around the rooms did nothing to fix; I wasn't sure it was even safe to breathe. The "terrace" is just a dark, gloomy backyard - hardly a perk unless you need a spot to smoke. One shower head is broken, the toilet has black mould under the seat hinge, and the bed is hard and squeaky.
~460 символов.

Very nice, brand new airbnb in a street full of the coolest spots of the Asian side of Istanbul.
Even though it’s on a busy street, once you’re in the apartment it’s very calm.
The place was very clean and the host was very friendly and professional.
The only small downside of this place was that it didn’t let so much daylight in, which was not a bad thing on hot summer days.
I can only recommend this place!

description: If you stay at this place, which is in a central location, you will be close to everywhere as a family. I am sure you will be happy to stay in our apartment, which is located right in the heart of Istanbul, and we will always be nearby to meet all your needs. Welcome in advance :)

reviews.text:
I had a great stay here. The location is 10/10 very convenient and perfect for exploring the city.
I really appreciated being personally welcomed on arrival and shown around the apartment. It made the check-in process easy and comfortable. The host was always available and responsive whenever I had a question or needed anything.
The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The bed was especially comfortable, which made my stay even more enjoyable.
Very friendly and welcoming people. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would be happy to stay here again.

I had an absolutely wonderful stay at Bekir’s place and couldn’t recommend it more! The location is fantastic, just a short walk from Taksim Metro Station, with easy access to the Tophane tram and bus stops, making it incredibly convenient to explore Istanbul. Bekir is one of the friendliest and kindest Airbnb hosts I’ve ever met. He was always happy to help and shared recommendations for places that ordinary tourists would probably never discover. The room was exactly as shown in the photos: spotless, with a comfortable bed, working AC, and everything I needed. I also loved the view from the window, you can see the Galata Tower, and there are several lovely neighborhood cats around. My favorite was the adorable cat sleeping in the basket by the front door. 😊 Thank you, Bekir, for your amazing hospitality. I would happily stay here again!

This was my second stay at Bekir’s place, and I can honestly say it was just as great as the first. I chose to come back because I knew I could count on a clean, comfortable room, a perfect location, and an incredibly welcoming host ❤️

We had such a lovely stay! Our host was very kind, welcoming, and helpful. He made us feel comfortable from the very beginning and was always happy to help with anything we needed.
The place was great and the location was perfect for exploring Istanbul. We really enjoyed our stay and would definitely come back. Highly recommend! ❤️

Bekir was super responsive and helpful, he gave great recommendations for where to go and what to do. The location of the airbnb is perfect, close to lots of attractions, restaurants and bars. It is on a quiet main street, I felt very safe walking around the area after midnight solo. The room is a good size for two people, it has all the amenities needed and very clean. Just need to be mindful that the area is quite hilly so can be a bit of a trek dragging luggage around.

description: Stay in a historic high-ceilinged building with subtle Ottoman touches in the heart of Beyoğlu few minutes walk from Galata Tower. Our Taksim Suite offers handcrafted wooden beds, anti-allergenic linens, a spacious 1+1 layout, and a private balcony. Enjoy city views, a fully equipped kitchen, and the comfort of feeling at home while experiencing the spirit of Central Istanbul

reviews.text:
I stayed for one night.
There is an elevator, which is quite rare for buildings in the city center.
The check-in was very easy and smooth, and the host was always available and responded right away 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼.
I absolutely loved the design — the carved wooden furniture is beautiful and totally my style.
The balcony is wonderful.
After my flight, it was especially nice to find some water that the host had kindly left for me. It was exactly what I needed. Also there was tea and instant coffee provided in the apartment.
The balcony overlooks a quiet little street.
The location is very convenient. You can easily walk to Galata, the waterfront, and Galataport along lovely streets.
The bed linen and towels were clean and smelled fresh.
The bed was very comfortable!
The only downside was that there seemed to be some issues with the shower enclosure which didn’t close properly.
Other than that, I would definitely recommend this place to everyone.

The place is great as shown in the pictures, turkish style.
Location is quiet and a few minutes walk from the tourist area.
The host was responsive and allowed also an easy early check in.

Great place to stay near the Galata tower and Istiklal street. It is located on a quiet street, so there is not any noise at night. There were some minor issues but the host was very helpful and quickly resolved them.

We had an amazing stay at Türkans apartment, he was an amazing host, always very proactive, quick und friendly responses - very welcoming and lovely. Really nice little supermarket around the corner and the lovely Center of Istanbul in minutes. Thanks for your hospitality!
ilgi ve alakaso çok güzeldi. ev tamamen göründüğü gibi temiz ve keyifli bi yerdi

description: Rooms located in Taksim, city centre of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Location of this accommodation was excellent, check in was smooth although we arrived late in the night.
Breakfast was reasonably good and better than expected.
The staff were extremely understanding and helpful and responsive.
The room that I have stayed in was unfortunately nothing like photos old furniture and so small for two, old tiling and carpet although it was cleaned it looked dirty.
When I have decided to check out after only one night staff were so cooperative and I could refund my payment for the rest of reservation from Airbnb.

walking distance to the famous istikal street. A great place to stay for a family. Host made us feel so welcomed. Amenities were clean & comfortable 😍 Definitely a thumbs up & rated 5 stars! Will go back here on our next trip!

This is a very good hotel room. It is spacious, clean and the staff are extremely polite and helpful. The location is the best you can get. It is located in the main area Taksim Square. We really enjoyed our stay here and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul.

The room is nice, and clean.
The alley where the hotel located is narrow, but the location is very good near taksim square and istiklal street

Aston hotel is the near to all the accommodations :
5min walking to the Havaist - the bus to to the airport )
1min walking to Taksim square
It’s calm, clean with kind staff, they will guided you, organised you a PCR test if needed..

description:
The apartment has a superb location, 4 minutes from Taksim Square. Located in Cihangir, one of the coolest, artisan, hip neighborhood in Istanbul. At the heart of cool cafes, bars, pubs, fine-dine, traditional, fast-food restaurants, Istiklal street, Taksim Square, Market Places, Bosphorus, green areas, hospitals, public transportation, anything you need in metropolis. Despite all, the flat is very calm and quiet.

Kitchen is fully equipped for cooking. Has fastest wifi you can get in Turkey.

reviews.text:
Thank you for the amazing stay. The house was very cozy and accessible. Taxi could come to the door and walking distance to Cihangir and Taksim square was very pleasant. The neighborhood is full of stairs so if you like hiking it is very fun to walk in the neighborhood.
The kitchenware was very comfortable. Special thanks to the Tupperwares since they were very handy for one day trips. The dishwasher was also very handy so were the paper towels. The basic stuff for cooking was efficient. We had a nice time with the kitchen.
The bathroom was very clean and complete. The water was nicely hot and pleasant. The cupboard in the big bedroom was spacious and amazing.
The house was very clean and had a nice airing and the fans were enough even in some of the hot days we had. No need for air-conditioning.
The hosts were nice and responsive.
overall a very pleasant stay for us.
Thank you

Excellent host. Clear and useful instructions including airport money and travel. A bottle of Rosé in the fridge. Helped carry bags up and down stairs.
The apartment is basic: it works but no frills. It's 2 steep floors up. There's a peaceful cat outside the neighbour (Turks love cats and they are all over the streets). There are some convenience stores close by, a Carrefour about 10 minutes walk away.
The area is hilly. Steep walk up from the coast (Karakoy) and then ups and downs as you go from the main streets to the apartment. The apartment street is residential although you can hear a rooftop hotel disco nearby (not too late). You can go up to Taksim by funicular or metro/bus if you dont want to walk (get an Istanbulcard at the airport which you re-charge as needed - really cheap trips on everything including ferries).
Best breakfast place Se Va Anatolian. Breakfast is a big meal in Turkey and this place is generous and relaxed.

The apartment is nice and comfortable. One of the best neighborhoods in Istanbul, even though I prefer it a couple streets to the southwest. But be ready to up and down the hills a lot.
Hosts were very friendly: they tell us EVERYTHING about this area and also helped us to fix a problem with wifi connection.
The place seemed clean, but we encountered some problems telling us it’s not perfectly clean. I hope will check those things — and it will be a perfect apartment to stay for a couple of nights in Cihangir!

That’s the first trip where I fully understood that “super host” is not just an airbnb expression.
Can’s and Rida’s hospitality is absolutely enormous. Before the trip Can sent me a list of cafes, pharmacies and groceries in the apartment’s proximity that made my trip easy and tasty :)
Though Can wasn’t physically in Istanbul when I arrived, all my days in the city I felt like I had a person who cares about me during all my stay. Can welcomed me to ask any questions at all: and I felt free to ask his recommendations for anything from local designers’ list to taxi prices.
The location of the apartment is fantastic - 3 minutes by foot from Taksim square in a very lovely neighbourhood with lots of trees and flowers. The apartment itself is very cosy, clean and has everything that a traveler will need to - from extra bedsheets to washing machine.
Definitely recommend! Would love to come back - hope it will happen soon :) And again thank you so much, Rida and Can, for your care! 🧡
Amazing location! Host was very helpful. The apartment is nice, spacious and amazing value. The kitchen didn’t seem like it was cleaned when we checked in but nothing a quick wipe didn’t fix.

description:
I’d be happy to host you in my centrally located apartment!
Your private room is very spacious — about 40m² — so you’ll have plenty of comfort and privacy.

You’ll be sharing the home only with me; there are no other guests.

The apartment sits right at the intersection of Taksim, Beşiktaş, and Nişantaşı, making it easy to reach all key areas by walking.

There are also four supermarkets and a local bakery just steps from the apartment, so everything you need is within reach.

reviews.text: Stayed at Omer's place for approximately 17 nights. Omer is a great guy and a great host! Big clean bedroom and a comfortable bed. A very clean apartment that you can use. Plenty of clean towels, a full kitchen, a washing machine, clothes rack, and a balcony off of the bedroom, all at a very reasonable price. You have privacy and basically the whole place to yourself. Also, the apartment is in a very good and safe location. What more could you ask for... I would highly recommend Omer's place!

We had a great time at Omer's place! He was very kind and helpful and the house was great, clean and organized. Omer gave us a lot of privacy and since he was working most of the day, we had the apartment for ourselves. Nevertheless, he was always available to chat and help us. We used the kitchen everyday and it had all necessary commodities. The area of the apartment is great, with supermarkets and restaurants near by, apart from the fact that it's central to visit monuments snd tourist places. It's close to the metro station, although to reach the house you have to go down a steep slope and to go to the metro climb the steep slope again. For most days it was fine, but with luggage it was quite uncomfortable. Overall, we enjoyed very much our stay and recommend it! Great price, great stay! Thanks for everything, Omer!

I'm a regular Airbnb travelers and would rate Omer’s place as one of the nicest, best located, and real value of all the places I have stayed. The place was very clean, modern, had everything I needed to feel at home, The flat is just perfect! Kitchen is compact and contains everything one needs.
The bed is comfortable, bathroom and balcony are excellent. Location is incredible,And was an easy walk to all the sites and in center of Istanbul ,
Omer is a great host,respectful,friendly and was also very helpful since the beginning, available at all times whenever I had any questions.
I extended my stay in Omer's place and would like to come again.
Totally recommend it.

I stayed at Omer's place wity my wife for 4 nights. The place is sparkling clean, we didn't find a spec of dust. The room is very spacious and bed is very comfortable. The room has a balcony with good views. The place is centrally located, Osmanbey metro station is 10 min walk. Omer gave us full privacy and allowed us to use kitchen and living room. He deserves to be superhost.

Everything went on so well for the ten days I stayed at Omer's place. My bedroom is spacious and the balcony is the best part of it particularly on sunny days to enjoy the warmth. All the sharing spaces including kitchen, living room and bathroom are super clean. It takes 15min to walk to Osmanbey metro station. While only by walking around, there are also plenty restaurants and places to go. Thank you Omer for all these :)

description: Breathtaking Bosphorus views: A stylish apartment in Beyoglu: Discover the allure of Istanbul in our 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom flat, where the entire apartment is yours to savor. Accommodating up to 7 guests, this spotless, spacious, and modernly decorated haven offers a stunning view of the Bosphorus from its balcony, setting the stage for an unforgettable stay.

reviews.text:
Best Air B&B I've ever had.
We are a family of 4 (two girls 11 and 9) staying at Missy's for 9 days. I just wan to say, the FYI's (at the end) are not negatives at all, at least not for us but I think are worth mentioning. The apartment was very clean. My wife is a big stickler for cleanliness and has OCD but it passed with flying colors. We are from the States and the AC which we needed was perfect. The kitchen is great and had everything we needed to make breakfast and some meals for our daughters. It didn't have any forks and one knife but we totally managed :-) The balcony was amazing for a morning coffee and do some work on the laptop and look at the million dollar view as shown in the pictures. The queen size bed is comfy. My daughters didn't complain about the second bedroom, beds or anything. I usually bring my own blankets when I stay in hotels but the blankets this apartment has look like the ones that get washed so that helped in having a good night sleep. the living room was comfy and both chair and couch pull out into a bed. No carpet which is perfect, hardwood floor and tile everywhere. The bathrooms were excellent and the showers prefect. Hot water on demand. We did buy our own drinking water as recommended but used the tap water for coffee and tea.
The location. The building is on a steep hill but maybe 5 minute walk to Isteklal street where all the action is. It's a 10 minute from Galata tower too which we visited multiple times. There are a few cute coffee shops/ bars on the street and 3 small markets for your groceries and baguettes. We felt it was quiet and we had no complaints at all.
We felt the building and the area were super safe and the people living on the street are nice and kind.
Check in was easy. we arrived 10 minutes before 2pm and Missy had no issues with that, she sent us the code and left the key on the door.
Check out was easy, key on the door.
Missy is responsive and helpful. We communicated via Whatsapp and Air B&B
We were able to get a big van to get us from the airport right to the door and pick up from the door to the airport.
There is a Metro station nearby 10 minute walk by Galata Tower. It's called Shishane I think.
All in all, no complaints, our favorite air b&b yet and of course, it's beautiful Istanbul :-)
Book with confidence and enjoy.
FYI's
1- To get to the elevator you have to climb 13 steps to the first landing, then 9 steps to the elevator. Once you're on floor 3, you have to climb 8 steps to the apartment.
2- The second bedroom with two beds does not have the AC but it has a door to the living room which does have the AC. My daughters did not complain so it's just an FYI.

The place is much smaller than it looks in the pictures. Not that great an option for a group of 6 or more as it is Tiny and better cheaper options are available in a great location. We faced issues related to power cut , dysfunctional elevator (not great when you come back in heels after partying / with shopping bags ) . The uphill walk killed us all. It’s tough to find taxis around too. Even if you end up staying - please make sure that you speak to the cabs called by the host . They charged us double the meter fares and was called by the host . Since we don’t speak Turkish , we couldn’t understand what happened with us .
The apartment is clean and decent for four people otherwise .

Missy’s apartment is an ideal and a perfect choice to stay in for a family and couple. It is cosy, clean and comfortable. Nice lounge area provided with all needed amenities and kitchen appliances. Bedrooms are comfortable and luxurious. It’s perfectly located and has a stunning view over the Bosphorus. It is close to Isteklal street and Taksim Miydan. Missy is so friendly and helpful host. She is incredibly warm and welcoming.
It’s highly recommended and if we come to Istanbul again, we will absolutely stay in Missy’s apartment.

Istanbul Airbnb perfection! Ideal for families, this home offered stunning Bosphorus views & a charming street lined with art & shops (groceries, gift shops, restaurants) . The famous Istiklal St. just up the road with plenty of shops and restaurants! Easy and interesting walk to tram, subway, Galata Tower & Galataport - perfect for exploring. We were also able to Uber from the door. Our kids under 10 had no complaints. Superhost Missy was amazing - kind & quick to address any issues. We felt so well taken care of. The house was really clean and beautiful, lots of storage, its only on the 3rd floor and has an elevator. We stayed for 7 nights - we were very comfortable. We were sad to leave, it was an unforgettable experience. I would not hesitate to book, I can't imagine a more ideal home and location for experiencing Istanbul.

My family and I stayed at Missy’s place for 5 nights. The apartment is exactly as in the photos...clean, comfy and stylish.
Missy arranged our transport from the airport and met us at the apartment.
Missy had snacks, some toiletries and drinks for us to start our day.
It was convenient that there were 2 bathrooms among the 6 of us, especially since we have 4 adult daughter’s getting ready at one time.
The kitchen was well equipped so we managed to prepare breakfast on some days.
The washing machine and dryer was put to good use too.
It was easy to get around Istanbul from the apartment.
The main street, Istiklal street is about 3 minutes uphill.
The Metro...trains, busses and trams are within walking distance and will take you to other parts of the city easily.
Thanks again to Missy and team for making our stay enjoyable. Will visit again someday.

description:
The entire apartment floor is furnished with laminate flooring. There is a mini living room in the common area and a very comfortable red sofa bed and 2 chairs in the living room. The kitchen is ready to use with all its equipment. Refrigerator, stove, dishwasher, toaster, kettle, etc.
In the Guest Room, there is a cute carpet that will cover the middle, a double bed, a wardrobe, a dresser with a mirror, a bookcase, etc.

reviews.text:
My stay had cons and pros: I didn't meet Abdurrahim, but he was communicative and responsive, his brother Ahmet did the check-in and he was nice and helpful and accommodating. They don't live there themselves.
The place is 25min (1.7km) by foot from Taksim's airport bus station and from Taksim is mostly flat/downhill but to get back to the main street it has very steep uphill. Their brother Barat was living in the living room, which I wasn't aware of. Another guest living in the other room. The front door needs to be banged to close and it's hard to open, so leaving early or coming back specially when people are sleeping makes it inconvenient for others. The toilet was constantly leaking and making sounds. The kitchen had dirty dishes left for a couple of days (Barat said they were his friend's) . You need to have your own lock for the room door. WiFi was weak inside the room but ok outside.
Two days there was strong smoking smell in the house, and from what I understood Barat smokes. I wanted a taxi to get to Taksim as it was steep and I had a suitcase, so Ahmed helped to get a taxi for me for 80TKY (I was told taxis don't go short distances), but I cancelled and when I myself got the first one from the street, it cost only 30TKY. Someone also had eaten my breakfast sandwich in the fridge that I wanted to have on the way to the airport. The room itself was spacious and quiet. I've tried to leave an honest review for improvements and future guest expectations.

Mr. Abdurrahim was very interested and kind. The room was very clean, everything I needed was available at the apartment, a good price and a good location, very close to Istiklal street, Taksim square and the metro.
Very easy to find the location, only 230 meters walking from Euro Plaza Hotel if you turn left onto Aynali Çeşme Cd, then turn onto Emin Cami Sk, then turn left onto Çatıkkaş Sk, in front of you you'll see Şahin Apartment.17.
Abdurrahim is not just a AirBNB host to provide a space for you to lay your head, he becomes a tour guide, he will join you in showing you bars, clubs, restaurants and more,very helpful and always replies immediately should you need his assistance.
I highly recommend Abdurrahim’s place if you want to stay in Beyoglu and don’t want to overextend your budget.

It was a good 6 days at Abdurakhim's place. The room corresponds to the description, the location is very convenient, in the center of Istanbul in the Beyoglu district, at an affordable price, Abdurahim and his family are very good people, very helpful, they helped me with everything, I highly recommend, I will return if possible.

Host is very nice and friendly. But it might be difficult to find a location in all side streets.
Anyway it’s almost a city center, walking distance to all main tourist locations.
Nice and simple room.

AirBnB with a nice location and view, the room was ok, the hosts were very friendly. We had some issues with the door (pretty hard to open), the check-in (location was not exact) and the bathroom but overall everything was ok

description:
Located in the center of Istanbul, in Beyoğlu Cihangir, just 1.1 km from Taksim Square and Taksim Metro Station, Amazing Rooftop View & Central Location overlooks the sea and historical Istanbul from the terrace.
The apartment has 1 bedroom, 1 living room and a fully equipped kitchen. Popular tourist attractions nearby include Istiklal Street, popular restaurants, Dolmabahçe, Eminönü, Sultan Ahmet Mosque, Topkapı Palace, Galata Port, Shopping malls, Galata Tower and others.

reviews.text:
konul's place was lovely and clean.
the view on tbe terrace is breathtaking and worth climbing the stairs to enjoy a drink.
The best thing about Knoul is her friendly attitude and wolcoming heart. actually she is one of the few hosts I became friend with.

Konul is probably the BEST host I have ever encountered in all of my AirBnB experiences. She will welcome you with open arms and provide any and all recommendations on how to navigate Istanbul. Her apartment is situated in the central location of Beyoğlu which is literally the hotspot center point for all attractions and activities. Highly recommend any traveller coming to Istanbul to book with her.
A nice place, well located, clean and comfortable. Thank you Konul, see you.

Konul is the loveliest host I have ever met. Her house is cozy, clean and super well located. The roof has the most amazing view and set up to sit and enjoy it. All in all it was a huge pleasure and I definitely recommend!

Konul is a great host who will always do her best to comfort her guest. You will leave in Beyoğlu – one of the areas in Istanbul that are safe for women (I went outside alone at night and did not have any issues). It is warm and neat in the house, WiFi is stable. I hope you also get a great conversation with Konul in the evening with a cup of tea like I did :) Recommend!

description:
My apartment is in the center of Istanbul, on Istiklal Street. The roof is completely wooden, on the top floor, which makes it earthquake safe. A true house of work, thought and production. If you want to have a wonderful experience in culture, art and history, let's meet.
Historical hotels and neighboring buildings. Walking distance to the city's most important historical and cultural monuments. You can also walk to most of the city's most famous restaurants, taverns and concert venues.

reviews.text:
Selcan is a lovely host, and fascinating person. We didn’t get to meet as she was traveling, but I thoroughly enjoyed looking through her extensive book collection. (If you ever want to provide her with a thank you gift, a book would be the thing!) She keeps very good care of her space, is a good communicator, and all of her instructions were clear and helpful.
The location was very walkable, the apartment was charming and clean, and the bed and pull out bed were quite comfortable!
For future guests, just keep in mind that the apt is on the top floor (lots of stairs), and music from the neighboring restaurants and bars are audible into the early morning hours.

The apartment are located almost in the very center of Istanbul, so all establishments and activities are within walking distance. It was clean and comfortable, equipped with everything necessary. If you have a lot of luggage, then you need to take into account that the apartment is on the top floor with a long staircase leading to it. Selkan was very pleasant and responsive in communication, helped with flexible check-in, and gave many interesting recommendations for local places. If I were to travel to Istanbul again, I would be happy book her apartment.

Derin's place is so beautiful, I absolutely fell in love with it the moment we arrived. It's so stylish and cute. I accidentally gave the wrong check in date and she ended up waiting for us for ages and regardless she was very nice to us and everything went well with check in the next day. The place is super clean and exactly like the photo's (even better). Bed is really comfortable, there's a coffee machine, washing machine and all the kitchen appliances are available. Everything was great I really recommend this place.

Derin is a responsive & pleasant hostess. Her place is very roomy considering the location - in the heart of the action!
Big comfy bed, strong shower, reasonably sized bathroom.
Nice workspace too.
You need strong legs to get to the top...but defo worth it!
Diolch yn fawr Derin.

We really enjoyed staying at Derins house. The flat is super nice and cozy and exactly like the pictures. The location is perfect, in the middle of Beyoglu, near Galata tower and really amazing little shopping streets with plenty of cafés, restaurants and bars , and everything in walking distance. We definetly recommend it, although it is a 6th floor without elevator and it's a little bit noisy at night. Derin is a super nice host, thank you!

description: internet Fiber 500 mps, TV, Netflix, Digiturk, 2 bedrooms, Metro, Bus, Minibus, Taxi within walking distance. All food and tea and coffee in the house are free. If you want, the kitchen fridge can be used for meals. Next to the house, there are Pizzeria, Restaurant, Shopping Center and Banks.

reviews.text:
I must say this was the best Airbnb place I stayed all time. Ali is such a great person I felt like home.
The house was really clean and modern. Clean bedding clean towel. He has hair dryer, washing machine, dishes machine and all the accessories needed for cooking.
Ali took food for me and my partner during our stay for lunch and dinner.
The rest room is really nice, it is equipped with air conditioning, fiber internet, 4k TV with Netflix that you can enjoy from his Confortable and huge sofa and you got access to a small but great balcony with great view.
It is in a 7th floor accessible with elevator. About noises you can't hear anything from neighbours just little from cars outside that won't bother your sleep.
To ali I want to say that he is a really great host and person. He doesn't speak fluently English but that isn't problem since he try his best to communicate. I must say that he gave me a nice present that I loved and thank him so much.
Place is close to emaar mall wich is really fancy and new place. It is close to some places for eat and bakery and coffee places. Metro or bus are 10 min from place, from there you have good access to Istambul center.
Please, if you go to Istambul check ali's place, you won't regret anything. I would give 10 stars if possible 😉

Ali’s house very clean, convenience, has the completed amenities, and easy to go to anywhere, just walk few minute, u can find alot of supermarket, restaurant, and alot of bus and a metro station.
The room has a beautiful views, The beautiful sunrise and sunset are always greeting me everyday. (Wow, super!!)
& also Ali is a great Host that i ever met.
He is very hospitality, friendly, cheerfull, caring and helpfull person.
He always try to make me feel like home.
Really amazing to stay in here, then i extended my stay for a month now. So lucky i can know and stay with Ali.
Dont pass the chance guys to stay with Ali. U will find something more than you expected!!
A Super great host, great location, convenience, great view, clean place to stay, convenience, local life and the qualities experience. More than Complete!!

I stayed here for 3 months, it was a fantastic stay. The host is the nicest I've ever had and is a very good, genuine person. He was super helpful whenever I had problems or questions, and went above and beyond to make sure I was confortable and had everything I needed. The house is beautiful, very clean, and all appliances are modern and easy to use. The location is very convenient, there are grocery stores and a big mall within a 10 minutes walk and lots of bus stops, however it does take a little while to get to the more touristy parts. But having the buses close to the house was very convenient and easy to use.

Ali is a wonderful caring host, very helpful and accommodating. The room is clean & welcoming. Kitchen and Bathroom are shared with a few people, but both are quite specious and have all the necessities. Recommend it to anybody who like to socialise a bit while at home and getting tips about local places.
I enjoyed my stay and will be coming back!
Ali is a great host, very hospitable and nice person. Apartment is very clean and comfortable. I had great stay!

description:
Modern & central flat just 1 min from Osmanbey Metro. 5-min walk to Nişantaşı. Stylish new furniture, elevator, fast Wi-Fi, two A/Cs, always clean linens & towels. Close to cafés, Lotus Mall & all essentials. Perfect for city exploring or remote work!
✨ Brand-new furniture & modern design
🛏️ Always fresh, clean linens and towels
❄️ Two air conditioners for year-round comfort
📶 Fast Wi-Fi – ideal for remote work
☕ A relaxing vibe after a day in the city
We speak English & Turkish & Russian

reviews.text: The location of the apartment was excellent and very central, there was a metro station very close by and it was also easy to go sightseeing on foot. There were plenty of supermarkets, other shops, cafes and restaurants all around the house. The apartment was in a modern, clean and secure building, the building was located on a smaller street between some bigger and busier streets. The apartment itself was wonderful, luminous, clean and well equipped. WiFi worked well the whole time. Murat was very helpful host, it was very easy to communicate with him. There was a small mixup with the check-in process, but otherwise the check-in and check-out was very easy. I had very interesting time while staying in this apartment.

I really want to thank murat for letting me check in early since there was no one in the apartment. Because a lot of people don’t let you check in early even when there’s no one in the apartment which is very dumb.
The apartment was very clean, simple and beautiful.
The location is actually one of the best location every!!!
Check in is very easy!
Murat friend that works in the bottom corner of the street also helps you if there’s anything wrong
I stayed there for about 15 days and it was very perfect!
Murat is kindly and honest host. The apartment is very clean and cozy. The location is very central . Metro station next to the apartment. I'll stay again here next time.

The apartment was great, clean and fully occupied with everything we needed. It is located in a nice and quite area in Osmanbey which is near to all transportation sevices, supermarkets, cafes and restaurnts. Our host Murat was very helpful and helped us with everything we needed during our stay.
Murat is an exceptional host, location is near to all commodities, the house is clean and well arranged

description:
Perfect for Young Travelers!
This stylish 22m² attic studio makes smart use of space and offers everything you need for a comfortable stay.
Kitchen: Small but fully equipped with a 2-burner electric stove, refrigerator and some essential cookware.
Living & Dining: Cozy sofa, dining table, TV, Wi-Fi.
Bathroom: Cool hammam-style vibe. Fresh towels, linens, and laundry facilities are included.
Special Feature: Being an attic studio, three sides are windows, offering a stunning sea view.

reviews.text:
There are 3 good things about this apartment:
1. It’s near some main attractions.
2. Really good price.
3. The host speaks good english, he’s also friendly and nice.
But still there are still something not convenient about this place:
1. It’s on 5th floor, the steps are quite narrow and high.
2. It was already 10:30 pm when we showed up but the room was still not done. His wife started to go clean but it didnt help much. We had to tell the host and he sent her again the next day.
3. I read a comment in 7/2023 abt the bathroom cabin door was broken but when we came it was still same, we told him then he finally fixed it.
4. The room is quite old comparing to photos and lots of dusts from the curtain. Water leaked from shower. And a really stinky filthy smell from the toilet (or the bathroom sink).

Great location: 15 minutes to metro station, 10 to tram stop, 15 to the Sultanahmed square.
The district is nice. It is lively and a bit chaotic, but never once we felt threatened outside, day or night. While at the apartments, sometimes you hear sounds of the night life in the distance - at a volume so low, that it didn't bother us, but it is there.
3 of 4 walls are literaly windows, hence the nice view of neighborhood roofs and even the sea.
Apartments are on the 4th floor and there is no elevator. Someone may find this uncomfortable.
The host is great. He speaks english perfectly well and is happy to help with any info you'll need. Also he has a restaurant in the same building - the best of all we've tried in walking distance.
For the price asked, this apartments are perfect.

The most important location, accurate address, and easy check-in. Best value for money. The downside is that it's on the 5th floor and the kitchen is small, but the nice view makes up for it. There is a restaurant run by the owner in the corner on the first floor, and the prices are reasonable and the food is delicious. About 15% off.

Fantastic room, location and host- what more do you want?
The room is super cosy and clean with amazing views of the waters and the streets. Great bathroom. Place is well designed and maintened.
In terms of location, you will find everything nearby and at much better prices than Taksim, for example.
Lastly, Barbaros- thanks for your hospitality and games of chess ;)

This apartment in in Kumkapı, where you can find many immigrants and expat workers especially from Central and South Asia, East Europe, the Caucasus and Russia. I loved the area as it is so diverse and I personally enjoy the lively atmosphere. Nice old hamams are around and it is a walking distance to Sultanahmet.
The apartment itself has minimum kitchen equipment, good shower, good internet, great security and beautiful view. It could be loud at night, no lift, no washer in the room. It is suitable for a solo traveler or maybe a couple. The hosts are all very kind and helpful.
Overall, I would be super happy to come back and stay again!

description:
Welcome to Grisverde Suites in vibrant Ataşehir, Istanbul.
Our modern suites are ideal for business travelers, medical visitors, and tourists.

Enjoy a separate living and bedroom, a comfortable sofa bed, and a luxurious bathroom with a walk-in shower and hairdryer.

The stylish workspace and fast Wi-Fi keep you connected. Experience the comfort of home with hotel luxury. Book your stay at Grisverde Suites today!

reviews.text: Modest apartment with heated floor, but it looks much bigger on the photos. Note that there is no kitchen and it’s too far from the center (took 1 hour by taxi to get anywhere), however the neighborhood is full of good cafes. Working place was too small and the bar chairs are too tall so they don’t suite the table. We liked the bed, the view and the cleaning each three days. Also the host was quite nice.

I had a great stay at Gris’s place. Communication was excellent quick and clear responses throughout. The space itself was spotless, very clean and neatly organized, which made it feel super comfortable. It’s also located in a nice, quiet area that felt safe and welcoming. I’d definitely recommend staying here and would happily come back!
Great price and amazing location ! The bed was comfy , room was bigger than I expected and everything was super clean , I would stay here again :))

I stayed here for a week and overall had a good experience. Check-in was easy, even arriving around 2 a.m., and the apartment was clean with no unpleasant smells. The internet was generally fast, although I had some connection issues with my laptop that the landlord quickly helped resolve.
A few things could be improved: the plates and forks were old and not very clean, there was no dishwashing liquid, the bathroom fan didn’t work, and the locker worked intermittently. The workspace was also not very suitable for using a laptop, and the pillows needed better cleaning.
Overall, the landlord was very responsive and fixed the issues I reported quickly.

Gris Verde neredeyse İstanbuldaki evimiz gibi oldu. Yine temizlik konusunda harikaydı. Geç giriş olanağı sunuluyor. Odalardaki klimalar bu sıcak günlerde hiç problem yaşatmıyor. Odalarda sigara içilmediğinden dolayı yastığa, havluya, koltuğa sinmiş kötü bir koku hiçbir zaman olmuyor. Sessiz, konforlu, temiz ve güvenli bir ev arıyorsanız fazla düşünmenize gerek yok. Ayrıca bu sefer odada değerli eşyalarımızı unutmuşuz. Hemen bizimle iletişime geçtiler ve teslimat için sözleştik. Tekrar tekrar teşekkür ederim.

description: Designer loft with stunning Bosphorus views and spacious terrace in the center of Nisantasi, the shopping capital of Istanbul. Only 50 metres away from Worldwide Brands and high quality restaurants.

reviews.text:
Irem's Appartment offers everything you need for a perfect stay in Istanbul. The apartment is clean and not only stylishly furnished, but the furniture is also of good quality, cosy and comfortable. The masterroom bed was perfect - not too hard and not too soft (there were only two of us, we didn't use the sofa bed). The kitchen is well equipped. The balcony is to die for. It runs along the entire apartment for about 20 meters and offers quality furniture for dining and relaxing. The balcony is exposed to the sun all day (parasol available) and the view is stunning.
Irem is a good hostess. She answered our questions promptly and checked whether we were missing anything. Easy check-in/check-out and times were very flexible.
The neighborhood outside the apartment had a lot of life within walking distance. We highly recommend this apartment and we will definitely book there again.

Irem’s Nisantasi apartment is a great place to spend vacation in a very pleasant neighborhood. The apartment is exactly as advertised, beautiful and stylish, with great attention to details and wonderful terrace. All 3 sleeping places are very comfortable and isolated enough to share the apartment. Bathrooms are very modern and beautiful. Re location - lots of bustling cafes and restaurants nearby, great vibe, convenient shopping, beautiful streets… Loved it! Taxi ride to the Old Town is about 25-30 min and inexpensive (be mindful of the afternoon traffic when coming back from the Old Town). We walked to the Old Town too once.
Irem is a great host, responded to all our questions without a delay and made great recommendations. No problems with checking in/out.
I highly recommend the place, and hope to come back there one day…

Very nice place with beautiful view and perfect location if you want to go shopping. Very quiet too! It was very spacious.
However the access to it is not that good if you have two children and two strollers like I did. First you have stairs to the elevator and after that you have to carry everything again one floor up because the elevator is not going to the top.
The two bedrooms are really away from each other which I really liked.
The other thing I didn’t really like is that almost all the drawers and spaces for clothes and luggage was used and we had to leave ours in the suitcases on the floor because there was no space for it. That made me feel a bit like the owners will come back soon home.
The host is super positive and fast responding. Very good communication through the stay. We had to leave the place at 10:00AM but she understood me that with two kids is almost impossible and extended the checkout at 12:00-thank you again for that!
The Wi-Fi is very good and fast.

We'll never regret the decision to book Irem's apartment. Istanbul can be a rather exhausting city. Therefore, it was extra valuable to come home to this place. The apartment is beautiful, comfortable, spacious and lacks nothing. Falling asleep and waking up with a view of the Bosphorus and the Marmara Sea was really something extra. The view from the apartment and from the terrace are so much more magnificent than pictures can show. Otherwise, the pictures correspond to reality and the apartment is exactly as described. Irem is a friendly and accommodating host and answered our questions quickly. She also recommended places to eat in the neighborhood which we really appreciated, especially the café Cesme Bazlama where we had a fantastic breakfast. I hope that we can return to Istanbul soon and that we get the chance to stay here again. Thanks for this time!

I love Irem’s Airbnb in Istanbul! Fantastic location. Safe neighborhood. Delicious cafes & restaurants nearby. The apartment itself is exactly as pictured. Very nice view of the Bosphorus! The balcony was very nice at night. Very good value! Fast communication with Irem. I highly recommend staying here!

description: Istanbul Suite is newly refurbished and features 6 unique suite rooms to match your style and budget.Located at ground floor. Our spacious New York, Tokyo, Nairobi and Oslo suites ,Paris Suites are each fully equipped with free WiFi, a TV, a safe box, fresh towels, slippers, a refrigerator and air conditioning, for your convenience.

reviews.text:
Excellent location, super responsive host, easy and flexible check-in/-out. Nice spacious apartment, neat, clean, new furniture. Everything as on pictures. Great for travellers who won't need a fully fledged kitchen. Great amenities, shampoo, soap, even slippers and bath robes.
Important items to know: one bedroom doesn't have air condition and both bedrooms don't have any windows/natural light as the apartment is subsol/partially basement. Most importantly, the apartment has only 1 bathroom.
There were a few basic kitchen items items that were missing (glasses, bottle opener, etc.) and the automatic light switches in the bedrooms were uncontrollable - all things I believe Coskun will fix shortly. Other than this, due to all of the pros, we recommend this apartment. Also, we had friends staying in other apartments in the same building and they were also satisfied. Thanks, Coskun for the pleasant and easy stay.

We enjoyed our stay overall - enough space for the 4 of us and the location is perfect - 5 minutes walk to Galata tower, 5 min - to Istiklal street, 30 minutes - to Sultanahmet. Coksun was very responsive and we appreciated the flexibility with check-in.
However, I wish the description stated the apartment is in the semi-basement, with windows at the ground level in the living room and no windows at all in downstairs bedrooms. Also, there is AC upstairs and in one of the bedrooms, but master bedroom did not have one and it was warmer than I would like.
Overall, the apartment is a goof value for a family if you know what to expect.

Ev gayet temiz ve resimlerde görüldüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibi kolaylıklar sağladı Ev çok sessiz asla sesten rahatsızlık duymadık gayet mutlu olarak kaldım tekrar bu muhitte kalırsam adresim yine aynısı olur hiç bilmeyen biri için bile ilk tercih olacak bir yerde konumda gönül rahatlığıyla tercih edilir

Amazing location, amazing place, communication with Coskun was easy and he was very helpful, i didn't like only that he let me stay in the basement as it was exposed that people in street can see inside and the water heater and when someone use the bathroom upstairs it makes noise in the basement.

The apartment matches the photos. The location is gorgeous, it takes less than 5 minutes to walk to the metro. There are a lot of attractions around. There is a large walking street nearby. It is worth taking into account that the apartment is located in the basement, only the feet of pedestrians can be seen from the windows. It also blows strongly from the windows and the apartment can be cold in winter. It was quiet enough, no one bothered to sleep.

reviews.text:
The photos are indeed correct. Everything you see will be at the place, except sun in the April. There will be no sun and that is completely not host’s bad.
For some reason I thought that this is separate flat, not a hotel-like room.
The building itself is some kind of hotel, so there are some pluses like service that helps with towels and gives water for free.
Though we felt a little insecure when new neighbors messed up with our door at night. Also not host’s fault.
In our case also it was sorta cold due to April’s 0-5 Celcius, AC helped us considerably, though still take into consideration.
Generally, very good location, clean enough and comfortable apartments.
The waiter boy at Papadoupolos nearby is speaking good English.

Nice spot, short walk to alot of good parts. Lift made things easy. A little cold but its winter after all. Tidy lil room, clean towels and bedding. Shower pretty good, tiny bit of mold but difficult to make perfect without airflow. Nothing wrong with this one, good lil base to venture out into Istanbul. Away from traffic! Uber Taxi found me just fine, narrow street still okay. Suits price, and good access.

Bad experience. The photos looked better than the actual place (the bedspread was changed out to a single thin sheet, no matching, with a dated flower pattern that made it look like a combo of a child's bedroom and a trying-to-be-hipster airbnb. False advertising: despite advertised AC, heat, and wifi none of these worked for me. Host was hardly around. Host was not polite. Host was belittling and difficult in WhatsApp communications. The room was very hot in the evening when I returned, unbearable to sleep properly, and the host said the only option was to "open the window"--but it gets cold in Istanbul at night and the location is in a dark alleyway nearby a main road, so the noises are distracting. Host did nothing to resolve WiFi issue and nothing to resolve AC or heat issue. When I started considering finding a different place to stay for the night because it was unbearably hot but also late at night, I asked the host to simply please help resolve my internet and AC issues that way I could either 1) have better experience booking a place online rather than walking around at night alone as a female not feeling safe, or 2) resolve the issue so I don't have the leave. The host did neither of these and sent a belittling text that I am "in a safe area"--not recognizing my concerns, fear, or problems. Horrible experience would not recommend and ended up not staying there. DO NOT STAY HERE.

I recommend this place. Great location and everything is close. There is tram station nearby that’s connected to everything. Room was clean and everything was prepared. I arrived before check-in and he let me stay earlier. That’s big plus. Room was similar to photos and it was cozy.

Kemal's place is in a refurbished historical building nicely located near Galata Tower down a quiet little nook of a road. He has several units to rent, some with balconies, but all nicely furnished. There is an elevator, so no carrying suitcases upstairs. It was hot when I stayed with him and the AC was welcomed. I would definitely stay again.

description: Our hotel is 10-15 minutes walking distance to Sultanahmet Square. It is a cute and stylish place in the historical peninsula. Hagia Sophia museum, Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Basilica Palace, Topkapi Palace and many other historical places are within walking distance. We will be proud to welcome you.

reviews.text:
3 çocuğumuz ile kaldık çok rahat ettik. Hem ev rahatlığı hem de otel temizliği vardı. Havlular çarşaflar tertemizdi. Hergün odadaki çöpler alındı. Mikrodalga fırın, ocak, buzdolabı, bulaşık deterjanı ve süngere kadar vardı. Güvenilir ve sıcak bir ortamdı. Gece çok rahat uyuduk rahatsız edici bir durum yaşamadık. Bebek için bebek yatağı bile koymuşlardı.
Ayrıca otel konum olarak Ayasofya, Sultanahmet, Nuri Osmaniye, Şerefiye Sarnıcı, Küçük Ayasofya gibi tarihi yerlere yürüme mesafesinde. Tabiiki yine oraların konumu olarak yokuşta. . Sürekli çay ikramları da çok güzeldi. Herşey için teşekkürler Vefa beye de ilgisi için ayrıca teşekkürler

We enjoyed our stay there. Vefa was so helpful and a nice person. I would highly recommend this place if you are tourist, historical places are at walking distance if like bit of walk, plenty of food and restaurants are just within 2 min. plenty of variety available down the road.
Very communicative and helpful hosts. Place is super cozy and in a perfect location. Everything went perfect, for sure we will come back there in case of another Istanbul trip!

The flat is a decent size for a small family, with everything you need and a few thoughtful extras. The location is great, close to the main attractions and convenient for exploring the area.
The host was also very understanding and accommodating when my wife and child’s flight was delayed. They needed to stay a couple of extra hours while waiting for the airport taxi to pick them up, and the host was very kind and flexible about it, which we really appreciated.
Overall, a very good stay and we would happily recommend it.
Good and safe place for stay with the family. Good match for price and service. Friendly hosts.

description: The house is completely redesigned and has art in it. It also has a garden where you can sit with pleasure. 5-min walk to the area where cafes are busy to Icadiye street.

reviews.text: The space was even better than the pictures. I felt comfortable and cosy during my 3 week stay. When I walked in the door there were fresh flowers and chocolates, I felt completely welcomed. I loved the off-the-beaten-path neighborhood and the locals were so friendly and helpful. Günsel the co-host was amazing! She was super sweet, promptly answered all of my questions, and gave me great neighborhood recommendations. Thank you for a fabulous stay!

The hosts are nice and responsive.
The flat is small, but it has mostly everything to live in a good way. Just quite humid and the bedroom is very minimal.
Wifi is fast and stable.
Many shops + a mall are reachable on foot and there is good transportation around: bus stops and metro station are close, metrobüs and marmaray are at 25 min walking.
You'll also like this place if
- you love cats: lovely friends are visiting in the backyard
- you love nature: beautiful parks are very close

Samet and Günşıl we're incredibly kind and helpful, and quick to respond. The apartment was exactly as described, and was fitting for a long stay - adorned with great book selection and art. Lots of grocery stores and restaurants around - great, non-touristy location that still allows you to get to the European side of the city fairly easily.

I stayed nearly 5 months at the apartment and it was everything I wished for. The apartment has everything you need, from a washing machine to a dish washer. The neighborhood is good and bus stops and metro stations are really close by. All in all it was a very comfortable stay. Thanks again to Samet Abi for being so invested and kind, and being so helpful.

A fantastic place which has everything for living. Very cozy and peaceful. A lot of artwork, books, and even a blackboard to write on. A comfortable space for working at home, good wifi, and TV with Netflix. Günşıl helped us so much with every request! We are very thankful. We stayed with a small dog, which was very welcomed here. And we've already booked this place for the next time :)))

description: Nestled in the heat of Istanbul, minutes walk from Taksim Sq. and it's metro station, Istiklal Ave., Istanbul Conference Centre. It offers budget accomodation where comfort and warmth meets vibrant energy.

reviews.text: Very nice clean place to stay near the Taksim square, kind and helpful staff, good quality/price ratio, recommend!
Great hostel - will stay again. Nice people, clean rooms, central and safe location
It’s beyond my expect. It’s near the taksim square and the room is safe,clean and private. I will choose again next time
Çok güzel bir konumda, sıcakkanlı insanlarla dolu bir yer. Rahat şekilde konakladım ve her konuda yardımcı oldular. Bu taraflara yolum düşerse yeniden, kalmak için bir sebebim var artık.
It's near with taksim metro station, about 5-7 minutes. Owner is very frendly, but if you want to sleep during the day you'd rather use an earplugs.

description:
High ceilings, second floor & ideal location.
This two bedroom apartment is on the second floor of a historic building, located on one of the most desirable streets in all of Galata.

reviews.text:
This was already my second time in Kadir's apartment - just because I love it so much. Not only is it exactly as shown in the pictures but it has a lovely vibe that makes you feel at home instantly: spotless clean but with the charm of an old building, huge windows with lots of light and a phantastic view of the Bosphorus. Besides the place is very well maintained and everything works really well (think water pressure, hot water supply, internet).
The location is perfect - in the middle of Galata but in a nice and quiet little street with all the public transport nearby.
And Kadir is the nicest host you can wish for - quick to respond and always friendly. We only had a small issue with the gas boiler, gave him a call and it was fixed immediately. I am sure, I will return a third time to this wonderful place.

Firstly the neighbourhood, Beyoglu, is terrific and highly recommended (with conditions, however, which I'll mention below). Its filled with character, lovely old buildings, cobbled small streets, cute, artsy shops and small cafes and eateries. It feels really good to be part of it. The apartment is excellently situated, near the landmark Galata Tower (but distant enough to entirely avoid the noise and congestion generated by hundreds of locals and tourists who congregate around it day and night), and within walking distance of important points like the characterful Karakoy neighbourhood, the ferryboat pier, the tram stops, the lovely old hamam, famous Istiklal high street, and magnificent Galataport. But you'll have to be fit enough to walk steep cobbled streets (though relatively short distances) and climb stairs everywhere including the apartment building. Forget those high heels ladies!
The apartment is on the 3rd floor (no elevator) and the entrance foyer is a bit odd in appearance but that's okay. The building feels very secure and the neighbourhood very safe.The amenities and furnishings are very good, with a fully fitted kitchen including quality washing machine, tumble dryer and dishwasher. The shower is a bit small and the mixer a bit erratic but there's always hot water and the pressure is great. There is a separate toilet and basin, all modern and good quality. The lounge is furnished with two couches large and comfortable enough to nap on and there are two bedrooms with good quality mattresses and pillows. The balcony is long and narrow with decent views and a nice place to enjoy your breakfast coffee or afternoon drinks. Plenty hand and bath towels are provided. The five times a day amplified call to prayer (beginning 04:30 in summer and the last at 22:30) is haunting and melodic and you'll certainly be aware of it. Personally, I loved the exotic flavour it lent to an otherwise very European feel to the area.
The small criticisms are these: The curtaining is not good quality (too thin) and the dawn light arrives early in summer. The overhead lighting in the bedrooms and lounge is quite harsh and only one bedroom side light was provided which was not working in any case. The TV offers only one channel in English that was mostly concerned with the Russian war and not much else. The host needs to subscribe to Netflix or similar because the rent justifies it and the guests expect better TV entertainment if they don't speak Turkish. Otherwise all was good with the apartment and I can safely recommend it.
My suggestions to the host were these:
1. Better communication with guests in needed. In my experience, Airbnb hosts usually welcome guests on arrival and make them feel comfortable by showing them around the apartment, offering advice about local amenities and being available to solve problems with the apartment or simply answer questions about tourist-related information. The information booklet provided was helpful but it would be better to be more in direct contact with guests, especially those arriving from abroad in unfamiliar surroundings.. The host's agent opened for us and showed us into the apartment but that was about all. We stayed for five nights and it would have been nice if the host had checked up only once, just to see if we were okay.
2. When we had some small complaints the host promised to solve them but never did so, for example the curtain rails for the net curtains came loose and fell down when we first we drew the curtains and remained unusuable throughout our stay because we could not reattach them ourselves; there were no English language TV stations as mentioned above; we requested bedside lamps but none were forthcoming.
Overall, this apartment is a good choice and sufficienly large and well equipped to support a small family enjoying a vacation in this truly magnificent city. You'll get a good idea of how exciting it is by getting out and about, and I recommend to take the two hour, or all day ferry trip to appreciate its true beauty from the water.

Exceptional location, in the heart of the European district, just near the Galata tower. Very walkable and a lot of very good restaurants / café are near.
The flat is looking exactly like the photos, it's really comfy and has a great atmosphere. We liked spending time on the balcony as well.
The host is managing multiple properties, so don't expect a quick response.
Very good value for money, go for it!

nice location with fantastic view.
someone greeted us and took us upstairs.
few flights up. beautiful view of the tower.
very old apartment- careful with the floorboards.
the shower in particular is very finnicky. one inch to the left, the water comes out extremely hot, one inch to the right, it comes out extremely cold.
difficult to shower our baby with this issue.
a binder was left with great instructions.
there was no crib- which we specifically booked this place for.
host offered to help arrange transport to airport- then suddenly stopped responding. very unprofessional if i have to be honest.

Excellent location nearby lots of restaurants and shops. Walking distance to Subway and T1 train, very helpful. Awesome natural lighting and spacious bedrooms and living room. No lift, but not a big deal, just at the 2nd floor. There are 2 separated bath rooms: one just toilet and sink, another one with shower and sink, for me it was a advantage.
I loved staying there and recommend it.

description:
Best location in Beyoğlu.Well designed home in the centre of Cihangir, 5 min to Taksim Square and Metro by walk. 1+1 40m2, fridge, washing machine, 42 inch LCD full HD TV, heating system, 1x double-bed, 1 single bed.

The apartment was renewed at the beginning of 2023. It has been redesigned according to old comments and suggestions.

I have apartments to suit all budgets. Please visit my profile for more details.

reviews.text:
The area is very pleasant, walkable and close to everything you might need, coffee, restaurants, groceries and shops.
However, there was a big difference from the sparkling clean and good looking photos to how the apartment is in reality.
The bathroom tiles were dirty and require a deep cleaning, the ceiling was falling, the toilet seat was missing, but there was shower gel, shampoo, soap.
