The kitchen&living area also felt old and had patched furniture, the dispenser area of the washing machine was also dirty :(.
The fact that the owner considers this place a renewed apartment is disappointing.
The value for money is good in case you can ignore all above details.

Pros:
Conveniently located near Taksim Square, restaurants, and shops.
Full kitchen, fridge, TV, and good internet.
Helpful host.
Cons:
Poor soundproofing; can hear neighbors' footsteps, conversations, etc.
Strong smell of smoke from neighbors (common in Istanbul)
Photos on listing not entirely accurate.
Small room and narrow ladder leading to second-floor apartment.
Unattractive street where apartment is located.

Perfect location for tourists. 5 min walk to Taksim metro, 7 min to T1 tram (takes you directly to most of popular tourist destinations), 4 min to Istiklal. A lot of supermarkets, fruit stalls, cafés and restaurants just nerby. The apartment is absolutely functional, the furniture isn't new but clean and hygienic. The bed is just Perfect! Better than in any 5 star hotel. Strong (adjustable) heating. The flat is a bit shady but if you aren't going to work or read it's fine. Behlül is a polite and helpful host, ready to help you in anything you need. A good stay for 1 or 2 people.

We had a pleasant stay at Behlul's place, and he was extremely responsive. He helped us with early check-in and local recommendations.
There are some pros and cons about the place.
Pros:
Close to Taksim
Close to really good caffes at Cihangir
Behlul was very helpful and understanding. He helped us a lot.
It was fairly a quiet place.
TV with Firestick, Netflix, etc
Fridge, that Behlul made sure we had bottled water and all of the other amenities.
Cons:
The place, although it is really close to all of those, is a bit sketchy during the night.
The cleanliness in general nedded some attention.
The apartment is smaller than the photos.
The furniture is a bit worn and needs updates.
And lastly, I think this is general in Istanbul, but the soundproofing is horrible. You could hear everything from the apartments above us, so at times we didn't feel very safe at some times from all the yelling and footsteps, doors being opened, we had to always check that it wasn't our door.

First time I stayed at Behlül's place, I chose it because the location (earlier used to stay at another place close to it it , but that is closed now). The location is great, close to Taksim/Istiklal, but on a quiet street so there isn't much noise. Check in was easy, and the apartment exactly like in the pictures. I worked from the apartment, the wifi was really good, online meetings working well.
Communication with Behlül was great, he even helped me with something not directly stay related. Really appreciated.
All in all, a good stay, definitely recommended, I have already booked another stay.

description:
Our apartment has a modern and elegant look in the very center of Istanbul. You will discover the comfort of walking to all the city's major tourist attractions and centers of interest.

The interiors were furnished with your comfort and luxury in mind. Enjoy relaxing with comfortable bedrooms and a spacious living area.

Watch the breathtaking view of Istanbul from the large terrace of our apartment. You will be fascinated by the view illuminated by lights, especially in the evening. Make unforgettable memories.

reviews.text:
Firstly, the communication with the host was perfect and we were picked up promptly from the airport (chargeable) and the check in was very smooth. The ladies at the reception and security were very helpful.
The location of the apartment is really good, around 10mins walk to main Taksim square. The walk is a very steep hill and not suitable for people with mobility issues.
The apartment is very tired looking and in need of some caring. The upstairs of the apartment smells very damp and there are signs of mould in the bathroom as well as many drain flies in the apartment. This was reported to the host and a maintenance was sent up at 10pm on a Friday night, when we were all asleep The stair railing leading upstairs is loose, the carpets on the stair needs re-doing.
Whoever cleans the apartment has not done a good job of it and there were dust under beds, sofa, table as well as dust balls in the corners of the apartment.
I did not make a fuss about it as I did not want it overshadowing or having someone coming in and out whilst I’m on my holiday.
I hope the host can rectify these issues. It’s a lovely apartment with so much potential.

Property was clean and just as pictured. Front desk is helpful if any issues arise (for example: I needed batteries for the tv remote and they replaced the batteries for me) property was easy to find and having a private parking is a major plus in the area. I was traveling with elder family members and two of them had heart problems and could not walk uphill so we ended up taking an uber taxi to Taksim Square a few times which was only 251 lira (under $6 one way). For the healthy it shouldn’t be an issue walking but the side streets are uphill. Uber easily found the location so did delivery companies to deliver food and groceries. Had all amenities stated and again if anything was needed the front desk was very helpful. We checked in late at night without an issue. Our whole family felt at home. We would stay here again.

We have been staying in this apartment for 1 week. It well furnished and clean, close to Taksim square but you need to walk up hill and with small baby it’s a little bit difficult. The heating works very good that was very important for my daughter. The reception is open 24h and it was very comfortable for us when we needed to fix something.
Anyway it’s good place to stay with family.
Thank you for all!

nice location, walk distance from Taksim square (metro/bus)
pool, gym, sauna, terrace.
kitchen is not perfect, but food delivery works so good in Instabul that we were ordering all the time.
host is very responsive.

Great place to stay and quick host The answer We didn't have any problems and the location is very close to Istiklal Street just steps and you are on Istiklal Street.
Comfortable space, friendly staff and great location...

description:
{ More Quality of Living }
Enjoy a stylish experience at centrally-located spacious flat.
taking our time to perfectly furnish this place to offer a unique memorable holiday to you, your family & friends
Living at this place will offer a cosmopolitan experience like no other!

We proudly hosted more than 1000 guests in the last 4 years in multiple central locations in Istanbul, therefore we are aware of your needs and expectations to make it a unique, unforgettable, and comfortable experience!

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay and were very happy with our choice. Everything was exactly as shown in the photos, and the apartment was very clean and comfortable.
The location was excellent — İstiklal Street and Taksim were both just a short walk away, which made it very easy to explore the area.
The host was always available, very responsive, and genuinely responsible, which made us feel well taken care of throughout our stay.
At first glance, the street may look a little intimidating, but we quickly realized that it was completely safe, and we had no issues at all.
There were just a couple of small maintenance issues: the bathroom sink leaked a little, and the shower drain was quite slow. These were minor things for us and did not affect our overall experience.
We stayed for 17 nights in June. There was one air conditioner in one bedroom and another in the living room, but the second bedroom did not have air conditioning, so it could sometimes feel a little warm.
Overall, we had a g

Be careful when booking this place, as the place is not worth staying at. I faced multiple issues, including a narrow lane and stairs to climb; smelly living and bedroom (cigarette smoke); a choked bathroom (the host tried to justify that water drains like this); the bathroom shower and washbasin taps were malfunctioning; the microwave plate was broken and was replaced the next day; and the overall kitchen was useless, including the gas stove orientation. I had to cut short my stay from six to three days due to the above issues, and the last host did not honor the refund policy.

Nael was an excellent host and made my stay very enjoyable. The communication was smooth and prompt, and he was always available to answer any questions. The space was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and in a great location. I truly appreciated the attention to detail and the warm hospitality. I would definitely recommend staying with Nael and would be happy to book again in the future.
Temizlik , konum , bina yapısı özelliklede eşyalar çok iyiydi. Ev sahibi çok ilgiliydi. Birdaha gelsem aynı evi tercih ederim. Tek sorunumuz park yeriydi onu da 5 dk mesafedeki otopark ile hallettik.

We had a great stay at Nael’s place! He was incredibly responsive and helpful from the start—gave us amazing tips on where to eat, shop, and explore. He even came by personally to check if we were comfortable and needed anything. Super friendly host! He also provided us with an IstanbulKart, which made getting around so easy. The apartment is on the 1st floor—15 stairs, a bit narrow at the top, but easy to walk up. The area is peaceful, with a bus stop just 5 mins away and Taksim Square around a 15–17 min walk. Grocery store is just down the street, barely a minute away. Inside, the place is comfortable with two ACs (one in the living room and one bedroom); the other bedroom has a fan which was fine since the weather wasn’t too hot. Overall, a really good experience—we felt well taken care of and would definitely stay again when visiting Istanbul!

description: Our place is 5 minutes from the sea and is located on the ground floor. It is in the form of a studio and has all kinds of kitchenware. There are 2 single beds and 1 sofa bed. Ideal for escaping the stress of the city and enjoying a barbecue in the garden.

reviews.text:
Perfect holiday! Everything was excellent!
The house: Very clean, has everything, kitchen, nice bathroom, wifi, we had to work remotely in the week, so it is suitable for that as well, and after work chill in the hammock in the garden, eat salad from tomatoes and cucumbers from the garden. Looks good in the pictures, but in reality is even better!
The host: Very nice and helpful, speaks perfect english, always available on watsap even if he is not in the house, his parents are and he communicated all our needs to them, so they could help. Thanks!
The location: Yalikoy is very very nice Black sea village, with laid back and slow living atmosphere. Locals are very friendly, we were invited to dinner to the neighbours, made friends in a restaurant on the beach. There are few nice places on the beach, we had dinner in the center as well, everything very close on foot. The purpose of our trip was kitesurfing and paragliding, Ormanli plaji is 30 minutes away from the house by car, very beautiful wild beach with nice waves, and one of the best soaring paragliding spots. In the village itself you have Yalikoy plaji, which is also very big and very beautiful, and is 5 minutes walking from the house.
Totally recommend both Yalicoy as destination if you want laid back village sea experience, paragliding or kiting (bring big kites, wind is not strong), and Alican's place to fully relax and have everything you need, and more! We extended our stay as much as we could, and will come back hopefully!

Very cozy place in the middle of nowhere!
If you hate noisy and over populated places, then this place is definitely for you.
Small village with unique flavor and hospitale people.
Don't shy to be opened for this little world, and it will open it's doors for you.
There is a couple very decent restourants at sea cost (Koru and Fafatara). Also it's worth to visit a butcher place in the villate centre.
And of course, the cherry on that pie, is an host! Supert host!
Alican was ready to help me in any of my crazy ideas and wishes.
Thank you Bro very much!

Alican's place is amazing! It offers a great garden and it is located just a few minutes from the beach. The apartment has everything you need. His mother welcomed us with a coffee and some sweats.
I wish we could have stayed longer. ☺️
Alican’s family was very welcoming and helpful during our 1-day stay. The house was clean with all the necessary utensils and it was great spending time in their garden!

Beklediğimizin kat kat üstünde çok güzel bir ev ve çok sıcakkanlı bir ev sahipliği ile karşılaştık. Sadece evin bahçesinde oturmak bile o kadar huzur verdi ki bazı günler denize dahi gitmek istemedik. Ev, denize beş dk yürüme mesafesinde oldukça güzel bir konuma sahip. Evin dekorasyonu öyle güzel yapılmış ki hangi bahçe köşesinde oturup dinlenelim seçemedik. Bir akşam mangal köşesinde mangal yapıp gece şezlongta ışıkları kapatıp yıldızların kaymasını izlemenizi kesinlikle tavsiye ederiz. Sabah hamakta keyif yapıp ev sahibi Meral hanımın bahçesinden yeni topladığı taze domates salatalık ikramıyla uyanabilirsiniz. Asma yapraklarının altındaki köşede akşam güneşinde kahvenizi içebilirsiniz. Aklımıza takılan herhangi bir şeyde veya bir ihtiyacımızda ev sahiplerinin ilgili tavırları ile karşılaştığımız için çok şanslıyız. Sadece bir kaç günlüğüne stres atmak için geldiğimiz tatilde Meral hanımın rehberliği eşliğinde ve üst kat misafirleri ile doya doya eğlenceli bir Çilingoz turu yapmaktan çok keyif aldık. Evden 20dk araba mesafesindeki Çilingoz sahiline uğrayıp, boyu çok geçmeyen kumlu denizine girip bu zamana kadar yiyebileceğiniz en iyi pideyi yiyebilirsiniz :) Yazın çok keyifli olanakları olan bu evin sonbaharda da ayrı güzel olacağını düşünüp tekrar gelmeyi dört gözle bekliyoruz. Her sabah ikram ettikleri ve birlikte keyifli sohbetler eşliğinde içtiğimiz kahveleri şimdiden özledik.

description:
Apartment is fully furnished and equipped with all stuff you need during your stay. Its located at the main street of Taksim Square. Taksim square is also common station for all public transports.

Our apartment is historical and we have ELEVATOR. Flat has Taksim Square view that you can enjoy taste of Istanbul.

Flat is luxury furnished as 2 bedrooms and 1 living room.

1st Bedroom has 1 King Size Bed
2nd Bedroom has 2 Separate Single Beds.
Living Room has 1 Sofabed

reviews.text: The host is very responsive and even brought a foldable bed for our need. Location is great, just next to Taksim metro station and there’s lots of restaurants and shops nearby. Has lift. The view from the master bedroom is divine, especially to enjoy breakfast or the sunset. Two bathrooms come very handy for big family like us. Towels are very clean and enough. Enough blankets. Shower water is ok. Only complain is the living room light is very dim for watching TV, reading or working on laptop. Asked the host to change to bigger watt bulbs. Responded ok but did not do it after we left on the fifth day. Great value for money and service overall. Would recommend

This place is very comfortable and convenient. The best aspect of it is a responsible host. Abdullah was very supportive and helpful in giving tips of where to go, how to get there and when . The place itself is very close to taksim square and lots of activities are a near by walking distance. The interior includes a huge bedroom with a three side wall and windows with the gorgeous city view. The other bedroom is a little small for a couple but still do the job. The kitchen is also nice. One of the great parts was also instruction that they sent me of how to check in or if i wanted airport pick up where to stand and how to proceed which is nice. We stayed for 2 weeks so we needed to work during and The workspace could get a little tight but the house internet is good for it. It also has one tiny bathroom and a huge renovated bathroom and a nice shower. Recommended to all of you if the price looks good to you. Thanks

Furkan's place was very reasonably priced and in a perfect location for exploring Istanbul. The apartment felt open and airy with a great view of the square from the master bedroom. It is an older apartment with a lived-in feel, but it was very clean the shower was hot, and the air conditioning was great (late May). Thank you Furkan for a great stay!

Spacious master bedroom overlooking the magnificent Taksim Square. Second bedroom is much smaller, with no AC. Cosy living room. Nice kitchen & bath. Clean modern apartment. The host is very friendly and helpful.

Beautiful place!! we enjoyed our stay so much! The host received us and helped with the luggage. He was communicative & friendly. Apartment is clean, has ac, wifi & elevator. The view is outstanding! Walkable distance to key restaurants, the harbour & the old town!

description:
Wireless internet. Located in the heart of Istanbul. Right next to art galleries, museum, theater, concert halls and movie theaters located at Beyoğlu, the heart of Istanbul, awaits to welcome its new residents. Walking distance to places such as Nişantaşı, Taksim and Cihangir.

Have elevator and garage. New and high quality furniture. Good for couples. Has a city view, please check photos for details.

reviews.text: Felt right at home! great communication with host, always ready to help. Place was clean and comfy. Do not hesitate to book.

The annoying thing about this place was that it was far from the Metro station and the person that I was communicating with was not the person that was listed in Airbnb. Otherwise I would give this place 5 stars for everything else. If you are willing to walk 20 minutes plus then this is your best option. Cagil is really mean, and rude person in case if you ended up communicating with her, I will give her zero for communication.
Nice and clean. The host is very responsive.

Duygu is a wonderful host who is quick and responsive to handling all the matters. The apartment was very nice and her staff is very accommodating as well. Overall a good experience. Thank you Duygu. 😊
Konaklamamdan genel olarak memnun kaldım, temizlik konusunda daha dikkatli olunabilirdi sadece 🙃

description: Welcome to our brand new modern 1st floor duplex in the heart of the city! Close to all tourist attractions and easily accessible to cafes, restaurants and public transportation! This home has a fully equipped kitchen with a cozy dining area. Comes with 1.5 bathrooms and a spacious bedroom upstairs and a pull out couch bed. Suitable for 4 guests this open space modern home is the perfect stay for guests looking to explore the beautiful city of Istanbul! Elevator available in our building.

reviews.text:
This airbnb is in great location, very close to Taksim Square and a lot of restaurants and the place itself is great, nice and clean.
However, communication with the host was not easy starting with check-in instructions. We did not receive any check-in instructions until we actually arrived at the door. The main entry door for the building is hard to use esp. once you put in the code, you have to immediately push the door otherwise, it will lock right after the voice information which we figured out eventually but we did not know at the time and thought we had unlocked the door using a separate key in the lockbox (that happened to match with building entry lock code) and we thought the key was for us but it was not which we did not know. This was clearly due to lack of proper check-in instruction. The host made us pay $40 for having to change the lock of that key which honestly was due to lack of communication so hopefully this is helpful for future guests.
If you are planning to work from this place and need internet, you may be out of luck. Connectivity was very slow for most of the time we were here. Also, AC was out while we were there but thankfully, we just had 3 hot days so it was not unbearable. The other thing is the washer and dryer take about 2 hours each for a load and we made a big mistake of doing laundry in the morning of the checkout. We asked for additional 20 minutes (11.20 checkout time and we were willing to pay extra to cover for the delay in checkout too) but were constantly pressured to leave the airbnb both by the host via airbnb messages and by the cleaning lady who was constantly ringing the bell and knocking the door while we were waiting for our washed clothes to be dry. When we opened the door for the cleaning lady, she was so angry at us and started throwing things around including the slippers we had bought which she threw from the upper floor with a great deal of force while we were loading our luggages in the elevator which was honestly such a bad hospitality.
Overall, nice airbnb place but communication and hospitality was such a bad experience for us.

Thank you for a very enjoyable stay in Istanbul! The check-in process was simple and clear instructions were provided for entering the property. The property was of high quality and all as described in the listing, with some nice touches to make us feel welcome on our arrival such as a bottle of water and tea/coffee. Overall we had a comfortable and relaxing experience - the air-con units downstairs and upstairs were effective at keeping the property cool, the bed and couch were comfortable and the downstairs area with TV/Netflix was a nice space to enjoy after long days of exploring the City. We really enjoyed the location too, it was a quieter neighbourhood whilst still being within walking distance of the popular Taksim area as well as the Tophane tram stop which provided very convenient access to the old town and other main sites. Close by were also a few corner stores and Cafes/restaurants. We would definitely stay here again.

The apartment was very clean, and had all the amenities described in the listing. The host was responsive and helpful. WiFi was fast, and there was a welcome bag with some snacks. Clean fresh bed sheets, and towels were provided. Apartment has 2 small balconies on each floor of the duplex and there was alot to do in the area.
A few minor drawbacks: While this is an excellent central location, in a quiet street, with amazing restaurants, art galleries, breakfast etc. around every corner; do keep in mind there is a serious amount of uphill walking towards Istiklal. It might not bother many people, but after a couple of days it becomes a bit tiring.
The shower water pressure can be improved, as well as adding a small shelf or rack to put things like soap, shampoo etc. in the shower.
Overall this was an excellent place, I would definitely recommend it and would stay here again in the future. Thank you!

The unit is centrally located in Beyoğlu, surrounded by cafés and restaurants. It's about a 15-minute walk to the metro, and within a 15–20-minute walk to both the Galata Tower and Taksim Square, including Istiklal Street. The apartment is a cozy mini loft with the bedroom located upstairs. There’s also a pull-out couch for additional sleeping space. The downstairs bathroom has only a toilet and sink, while the other bathroom upstairs includes a shower.
The hosts were very responsive. I had an early morning flight and paid an additional $50 for an early check-in, which made the day quite comfortable. However, I have a few suggestions for improvement:
The upstairs bathroom lacks shelf space, and the shower area is quite dimly lit, so if you have skincare or haircare products, there’s nowhere to place them. The bed was comfortable, but the bedframe is quite low.
The area is lovely, but be aware that it’s quite hilly, so those with mobility/disability concerns may find it difficult.

The loft is stylish and in an amazing location, making it a great base to explore Istanbul. Check-in was easy and straightforward. However, during my stay in December 2025, there was major construction right next door, with loud drilling throughout the day. Additionally, the bathroom upstairs had no counter space or storage in the shower, which was inconvenient. Despite these issues, the loft itself is a lovely space and I would stay again

description: Flat is located at the center of "Besiktas " - Misirli Bahce St. 5th floor with no Elevator. You can come to the door by taxi.

reviews.text: My experience in this apartment was lovely. It looks exactly like in the pictures. The apartment was very clean and there was everything necessary for a comfortable stay. The location was perfect. The bus stop was in like 5 minutes from the house and the ferry pier in 10-15 minutes. There are a bunch of cafes, bars and shops near the apartment. The Wi-Fi was very fast which was important for me since I’m working remotely. The apartment is definitely worth the money. I’m also very grateful to Aziz and Barış because they were always in touch and very helpful. I would definitely stay here again

The location is excellent, but unfortunately the stay was very disappointing. The apartment is on the 5th floor and the AC was broken during peak summer. What bothered us most is that the host apparently knew this beforehand but did not inform us before arrival.
There were two fans, but the one in the living room was already broken, with a broken piece left inside, making it potentially dangerous to use. After our stay, the host then accused us of breaking this fan and asked us to pay for it, which is completely unacceptable. It was clearly already damaged when we arrived, and the pictures he later referred to did not reflect the actual condition we found it in.
There was also a strange smell coming from the sink, and communication by phone was extremely rude and unprofessional.
We paid around €200 and expected much better. Great location, but definitely not worth the money considering the broken AC, broken fan, smell and the way we were treated afterward.

Perfect stay! Highly recommendable. The apartment is located centrally in the Heart of Besiktas, yet on a quiet road. It was super clean and with stylish furniture. The balcony is one of the highest up in the area and has a beautiful view. Our hosts were super helpful and kind - whenever needed, they responded quickly and had personal recommendations for restaurants etc. So were the neighbors e.g. from a Café beneath that we were fortunate enough to meet. An additional highlight was that the Apartment is located right around the corner of Besiktas' famous breakfast street (beşiktaş kahvaltıcılar sokağı), which offers all day Turkish breakfast/brunch. Besides, the ferry station 'Besiktas' is in 5-minute walking distance. From there, take a public ferry on beautiful Bosporus to the Station 'Eminönü' (for 15 TL currently) and you can walk to visit Hagia Sofia etc.
Besiktas itself is a lovely and lively place for eating, shopping, relaxing in the park, and going out and getting to know the hospitality of the turkish people. It is a great place to start exploring Istanbul, as commuting from here is easy by (cheap) taxis, busses, trams, ferries, or simply by foot. Enjoy you time at this apartment - we had a perfect time here!

Worth the price. The apartment is very nice and comfortable. It surrounds with a lot of shop and market. Toilet and all the rooms are clean. Downside is that the apartment is in the fifth floor and it has no elevator. But you get a nice view from the balcony

We stayed at the apartment for over 1 month and couldn't have picked a better place to stay. The apartment was very clean and had the perfect location for our "workation". Also the internet speed was very good for working from home. There are a lot of bars, restaurants and grocery stores nearby and the neighborhood is very safe. The hosts were extremely helpful and responded right away to every inquiry. Thanks for all and we will definitely come back!

description:
An open-plan boutique studio for two, with a private jacuzzi as its centrepiece — the room is designed as one flowing space rather than separate closed rooms.

You are in the middle of Nişantaşı: gourmet restaurants, cafes and designer shops on the surrounding streets, Osmanbey Metro a short walk away with a direct line to IST Airport, the Old City and the malls. The building has 24/7 security.

Sleeps up to 3. Fast WiFi, kitchen, baby bath and crib available. Flexible cancellation.

reviews.text: Although all of the staff was very good on communication I experienced a lot of issues with this booking. 1) I wasn’t able to move in to the unit and had to go to a different hotel because there was a flood in my room. Jemil was very kind and gracious and did his best for us but it was an inconvenience because the place we got for a day was not that great. 2) next day - I moved into a bigger unit which was spacious and all but this is a not a 5 star stay by my measure. Two mattresses put together don’t make a comfortable bed. Turkish hamam out there is causing dripping water into kitchen downstairs. I couldn’t use the shower for longer than 10 mins and electric wiring kept flicking in the hallway right where the work station is set up . Washroom are tiny and there is no place with mirror to wash your face and do a morning routine 3) it is very loud because there is no sound isolation - everything happening in the lobby is loud and clear in your room. I couldn’t work. Music, greetings of guests, all the social media browsing was loud and clear on my meetings at work. 4) I tried to move my work to the bedroom - internet doesn’t work in the bedroom due to weak signal. 5) no washer and dryer in the unit. I honestly think that 5 stars were given because the staff is very sweet and accommodating at their best but in the end it is about a property and it is 3 star unit for me. I don’t recommend. I had to move out for many reasons and just found a different hotel.

The place was easily located just opposite Redmont Hotel off the main road,its look a bit sketchy on the outside,but the room is just like in the photo ,its very private, hardly see any other person in this building.All the appliances are working just fine,wish there is an extra security at the door a latch on the inside would be nice for an extra sense of security.Its very quiet at night not even the street sound which is a pleasant thing to have to get a good rest.The lift in the building works but i did not use it as i was on the 2nd floor,there is a nearby Bakery and just further up the street there is cafe & a breakfast place that i would not recommend its pricey & the food its just so.Overall the location is good i got my money worth.

I had a great stay in the studio apartment. It was very helpful having staff on site daily. They were always very helpful and went out of their way to make my stay a comfortable one. The apartment was clean, updated and exactly what I needed. Air conditioning and wifi worked great and i was able to do laptop work without issue. I recommend and would gladly come back on a return visit.

Nice place in a great neighborhood, with a comfortable bed and plenty of natural light from the windows. Super spacious room!! With a nice interior
Communication could have been better, as the host sometimes came across a bit abrupt when answering questions. The towels and shower could have been a bit cleaner, as they didn’t feel completely fresh.

Banyo direkt yatağın yanında ve perdelerin tümünü indirseniz bile aradan ciddi şekilde açık kalan bir kısım var o nedenle yataktan klozet duş falan rahatlıkla gözüküyor. Bu bizi hiç rahat hissettirmedi, aynı zamanda ses yalıtımı da iyi değil yani banyodaki bütün sesler olduğu gibi odanın içinde duyuluyor. Ayrıca sabun, terlik vs. sağlansa çok daha iyi olurdu. Genel olarak konum güzel, eşyalar yeni, fiyat performans açısından tercih edilebilecek hoş bir yer ama bunları göz önünde bulundurarak gelin.

description: A unique apartment in a lively area surrounded by supermarkets ,restaurants,hospitals, and shopping malls. Next to Şişli with excellent public transport connections, you can easily reach Istanbul’s historic landmarks. Taksim is just 15 minutes, Sultanahmet 20 minutes, and Istanbul Airport 30 minutes away. You can also easily access Cevahir Shopping Mall within minutes. The building offers 24/7 security and free indoor car parking. A safe and welcoming place for both business and leisure stays.

reviews.text:
Mr Sinan is a great host. He responded fast to our queries and very helpful in providing information about the place and its surrounding. We arrived quite late at 12am. Mr Sinan was very accommodative and arranged for his friend to deliver the house key which enabled us to check-in to the apartment smoothly.
The apartment is exactly like the pictures and descriptions. It is new, clean, well-furnished, good size for 5 of us, comfortable beds, sufficient seats and strong wifi. The kitchen is well equipped and Mr Sinan bought a number of mineral water bottles for us to drink which made our first few days cozier.
The apt comes with smart TV which allowed us to connect to NETFLIX and YouTube, kids enjoyed it very much. It has heated floor and heater/air conditioner through the apartment. Shops are walking distance. We enjoyed our stay there. If I ever come back to Istanbul, I would definitely stay here again.
Do not miss this apartment if you visit Istanbul.

Sinan was an accommodating and helpful host.
He greeted my family with leaving sweets on the table.
He was available when we needed him.
I felt the living area was smaller that looked in the photos,otherwise was clean and nice unit,in a nice apartment, located at 9th floor.
The disadvantage was the highway noise if you open the windows, you better keep the windows closed and use the air conditioner.
Kitchen was equipped well.
Bed sheets and towels could be better, perhaps needs new ones.
Overall happy with our stay, thanks to Sinan

Our group of 7 had a pleasant and comfortable stay at Sinan's place. It had all the amenities that we needed for the two weeks, including a dryer and dishwasher. Each room has its own AC, which makes it comfortable for people with different preferences for room temperature. The apartment was clean and new with the most magnificent views of Istanbul. The location is south of Kagithane and north of Sisle neighborhoods, which makes it very convenient to travel to different areas of Istanbul. It's a ~15-minute car ride to most of the downtown attractions and ~10 minutes to tons of malls and shopping centers.
Sinan was very attentive and responsive. He made sure we had everything that we needed and always checked on us proactively. He was very helpful with resolving an issue with one of the neighbors who was noisy at some ungodly hours of the night.
Overall, highly recommended especially for larger groups.

We really enjoyed our stay at Sinan's place. He is an amazing host, always available to reply to any questions or doubts we had - about the BnB or even generic recommendations about Istanbul. The BnB itself is as described, and we had a comfortable stay. The rooms may feel a bit tight for big families with lot of luggage, but for our family of 4 adults and 3 kids - it was just perfect. The location is nice with grocery pharmacy etc nearby, just that with traffic, reaching Sultanahmet would need 30 minutes. However, Taksim qns Istiklal areas are quite near, and accessible by Uber. Of course Istanbul tram is pretty good as well. The building is super new and very well secured with nice lift and lobby!
Overall, highly recommended

Since the goal of our trip to Istanbul was a family reunion after years, my wife & I spent lots of time on Airbnb to find a good place, and I'm extremely happy that we finally selected Sinan's apt for 11 nights.
[1]: First of all, Sinan is exceptional host: 100% responsive (almost immediately), following with me every other day to make sure we are doing fine! He was so kind that greeted us with a pack of candies.
[2] The apartment is very very clean.
[3] The view: just awesome!
[4]We -always- prefer to not get Airbnb/hotel in very touristic areas! So Kagithane was just a perfect neighborhood for us! and let me tell you: we used taxi a lot, but you can use metro or bus!
[5] Whatever you might need: pharmacy, supermarket, bakery, local small restaurant are just few steps away.
[6] All three bedroom have beautiful windows and AC!
[7] Kitchen is a little bit small, but FULLY equipped.
[8] Tons of clean towels!
I HIGHLY recommend this apt & I'm sure you will love it, as we did.

description: FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION (Less than 1 minute distance) – FREE MINI BREAKFAST (Less than 1 minute distance) – 4MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – MARKETS & PATISSERIES VERY CLOSE – SAME FLAT IN THE PHOTO

reviews.text:
Good apartment type room to explore Istanbul and the staff is friendly and always responsible.
【Room】
Looks like photos. There are enough facilities for a short stay.
It is a little bit difficult to get stable hot water from the shower. You should make the water pressure as weak as possible before the water heater turns off, so you can get stable hot water :)
It's also good they have a cafe for free breakfast and a staff room where you can leave the luggage.
【Location】
If you take a public bus, it is easy to get to tourist attractions.
There are two supermarkets, SOK and Bonveno, nearby.
【Host】
The staffs of the host team are always responsible and it is very easy to ask questions.

It is the best option for anyone staying at center of Istanbul with all transport available within walking distance. The area is safe at night. As it is near to the main road adjacent to Taksim. There are police patrolling the area aswell. The room was the same as in pictures. It was in perfect clean condition. It had everything. All basic necessities with kitchen appliances and utensils were there in an excellent condition. Toilet was clean and everything was working.
They have a café which for free mini breakfast, their menu is diverse with excellent taste.
They also have a office which manned 24/7, it has all sort of basic stuff available on minimal market rate. The managers were amazing. They have a kind and humble attitude. They were very helpful with providing assistance as well as guidance. They were 24/7 available. They even help me in getting taxi and my luggage during check in and check out. They were like a family which made my stay memorable. Wil recc & stay the next time

Very professional service provided, room-apartments are professionally clean to a high standard & have many utensils provided. The building is located close / walking distance to Taksim Square , however you will need to deal with some steep hills (short distance), this is a common factor I found in Istanbul. The room apartment was within a renovated building in what I gathered was an older part of Istanbul, although you may initially feel apprehensive, but after staying you realise that everyone is friendly & the area is safe with a police station closeby, there are noises outside which you would find anywhere in a busy neighbourhood. But if you want a professional service at a reasonable price then I recommend Istanberry & the team are very helpful over & above, helping with suitcases in checkin & checkout as we would have struggled otherwise . The staff are available 24/7 which was very reassuring & there are various complementary services available definitely stay here again.

I had a great time during my stay! The apartment was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and in a perfect location. Everything met my expectations, and the host was very accommodating. Recommended!

+Konum olarak güzel bir yerdeydik, İstiklal, taksim, Galata gibi konumlara yakınlığı çok iş gördü. Etrafta çok fazla restaurant ve kafe var, yürüyüş mesafesinde hepsi. +Sabah kahvaltısını bir artı olarak koyuyorum çünkü, mekan ile ilgilenen Deniz hanım çok saygılı, özverili ve kesinlikle hayvansever bir insan, o küçücük mekanı güzlleştiren tek insan diyebilirim tabi bir de 5 yıldır orada olduğunu söyleyen kedisi ile beraber. Kahvaltı bence çok düşük bütçeli hazırlanmıştı, daha zengin ürünler ile taçlandırılması bence çok ucuza kapatılabilir. - Uzun konaklamalar için bence, bir elektrik süpürgesi, birden fazla tuvalet kağıtları, yeni çarşaflar bırakılabilir ( temiz havlu)bunlar insanlar için gerçekten önemli konular eksikliği çok derin bir şekilde hissediliyor. -Yatak çok kötü 5 gün boyunca gerçekten sırt ağrısı ile uyandım, kesinlikle yenilenmesi gerekiyor.
Tekrardan Deniz hanıma çok teşekkür ediyorum sadece bende değil arkadaşlarım da onu çok sevdiler. (Deniz'e⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Sağlıcakla.

description: Uniqe studio room with everything needed in. The place is in karakoy which is close to taksim, galata, eminonu, besiktas and galataport

reviews.text:
The apartment is small (studio) but functional, everything worked fine. Beds were comfortable and clean, as was the bathroom. AC and TV worked well. But by far the best is the location, which is great. Its within walking distance of many restaurants and stores, and close to the tram (Tophane). The neighborhood is bustling with activity, but the apartment itself is on a very quiet peaceful side street.
Check in was easy, but be advised that entering the address in gmaps may mislead you by 10-15 meters and miss the door, as happened to me. But no problem, we asked a local and he pointed us right to it.

The room was located is such a great area, close to galata tower to the ferry station where you can take the bosphore to the asian side of Istanbul, to taksim and to the tram that can take you to aghia sophia and to sultan ahmet mosque and surrounded by many coffee shops, bars and restaurants. location wise, it was perfect.
Regarding Yunus, our host, he was very friendly and helpful, he even asked us to text him in case we needed anything, we were looking for a place where to rent a car and he recommended us taksim wich was an area that is filled with trust worthy agencies.
The room is so specious, I would say that it was provided with all amenities mentioned in the description. it was also clean and original. We felt right at home.
thank you, yunus, for this experience... we'll come back for sure and we'll recommend your beautiful accommodation to friends and family.

Yunus is a welcoming and kind host, his assistant was very kind having helped us with the bags.
The room was clean, cozy and lofty, located in a historical district with lots of cafes and restaurants around.
We will definitely stay there again on our next visit over any hotel

Cozy studio in a very good location very close to, but just the right distance away from touristy streets. Lovely interior and lights. Plenty of shops and restaurants around with adequate non main touristbstreet prices.
Super easy check in and a responsive host!

Yunus was a very responsive host and kind. The place was fine for a short stay and in a super great location. The street below can be quite loud but I believe this is the case throughout the neighbourhood. Our only real complaint was the floors were oddly dirty. They supply disposable house slippers which were black on the bottom after wearing them for an hour, if the floors were properly cleaned I would consider returning.

description: You won’t forget your time in this romantic, memorable place.

reviews.text:
Evin konumu denize aracla 5 dk. bile surmuyor, yuruyerek de kolayca gidilebilir. Sitede havuz da bulunuyor. Cevrede alisveris yapabileceginiz market vs. var.
Aracla 5 dk da sehir merkezine gidip restoran eczane buyuk marketler vb. yerlere ulasabilirsiniz.
Bir eksiklik oldugunda ev sahibine yazarak kisa surede cozum saglayabilirsiniz.
Giriste beklememek icin ev sahibine giris saatinizi mutlaka belirtin.
Ev temizdi, mutfak banyo zemin temizlenmisti. Carsaflarin yenilenmesini rica ettigimizde hemen yenilediler.
Evde mutfak ekipmanlari gayet yeterliydi ailemiz icin. Camasir bulasik makinesi ve vantilator bulunuyor. Balkon kucuk ama cok serin ve havadar.
Sitede kucuk bir cocuk parki bulunuyor. Cocuklu aileler icin kurtarici oluyor.
Cevrede cok sayida gidilebilecek koylar, plajlar var.
Şile marinada cocuklu aileler icin lunapark , kiralanabilir bisikletler bulunuyor.
Ziyaretimizden memnun kaldik.

Evin konumu , merkeze ve her yere yakınlığı gerçekten çok güzel . Herhangi bi sorun olduğunda Arda Beye yazdığım an görevli arkadaşlar hızlıca yardımcı oldular . Ama ev çok pisti . Girdiğimiz gün halıda pislikler tuvaletteki faraşın içinde kuruyemiş çöpleri vardı . Eşyalarımızı yerleştirmek için olan dolaplardan tutun mutfak dolapları ve buz dolabının içi hep yağ ve pisti . İstek üzerine süpürge , vileda , su ısıtıcısı ve kahve makinesi gönderildi . Ancak tatile geldiğim evde devamlı elimde bezle bi yerleri sildim . Yatak çarşafları temizdi güzel kokuyordu . Havlularda istediğimizide getirildi . Ben evi 7 geceliğine 5 yetişkin olarak tutmuştum . Mutfak araç gereçleri asla yeterli değildi . Sadece 5 adet çatal , bardak vardı . Her yemekten sonra elimde bulaşık yıkamak zorunda kaldım . 4 lü ocağında sadece 1 gözü çalışıyordu 5 kişilik bi ailenin bişeyler pişirmesi için yeterli değil kesinlikle . Evin pisliğini ve eksiklerini sorun etmezseniz konumu ve çevresi gayet güzel .

Şilede kalınabilecek en ideal yerlerden. Tekrar gelirsem tekrar kalırım. Otopark imkanı olarak , güvenlik olarak sağladığı imkanlar olarak, evin içinde sizin için tahsil edilmiş ürünler tatmin ediciydi. Evin ısıtmasında veya sıcak suyunda herhangi bir sorun yok.
Ev sahibi sorularıma çok hızlı dönüş yaptı, normal çıkış saatimizden 2 saat geç çıkmamıza izin verdi

Doğan bey çok ilgiliydi fakat ev temizliği konusunda aynı şeyi soyleyemicem yataklar koltuklar aşırı batıktı yastık yorgan çarşaf vs. hicbirsey yoktu TV çalışmıyordu ama Doğan bey ertesi gün biz soyleyince hemen 2 adet yastık gönderdi ve tvyi yaptırdı kısacası evde küçük eşya diyebilecegimiz hicbirsey yok hazırlıklı gelirseniz yer güzel

Eşim ve ailemle 1 hafta doğayla iç içe havuz keyfi deneyimi yaşadık. İlk gün itibariyle Yıldız hanımla bağlantı içerisindeydik. Eksiklerimizi giderdi ve bize çok yardımcı oldu. Evin temizliği, havuzun ferahlığı, aile ortamı çevresi ve temiz havasıyla hiç bitmesini istemediğimiz bir tatildi. Ufak tefek eksiklikler olur böyle sürkilasyonu fazla olan yerlerde ama doğru iletişimle çözülmeyecek sorun değil bu yüzden kötü yorum yapanları anlayamıyorum. Doyasıya yüzdük ve çardakta mangal eşliğinde sofralarımızı kurduk. Çocuklu aileler için özellikle önerebileceğim bir yer. Seneye de orda olmak dileğiyle sevgiler 🌸

description: Hello everyone. Our room is in Kadıköy, 1 minute walk from the port. There is music at night as there is a bar under the building. Please be aware of this. Please feel free to ask all your questions and requests. I will be happy to answer.

reviews.text:
about this airbnb, let me break it down
I decided to book it last Minute because I only needed something for one night.
+ good location, easy to find
+ lots of things around
+ the bed was okay
+ the AC worked fine
+ host was always quick to answer me
- the music from the Bar was really loud (I didnt think it would be this bad but until 4-5 in the morning I wasnt able to sleep) so I wouldn't recommend it if you have a light sleep
- the TV didnt work (it had WiFi but something was broken ig?)
- one of the windows was blocked by metal.. that diesnt show in the pictures
- there was a big and bright exit-sign between the windows (which is also not shown in the pictures) it lights up the room day and night and there is no way to turn it off
- there were dirty wet and stained (maybe mold?) towels in the bathroom
Overall the stay could have been worse but i wouldnt come back & I wouldn't recommend this airbnb if you plan on spending some time indoors or stay for more than 3 days.

Birkaç kere gelip kaldığım bir yer, temizliği için tercih ediyorum. Sadece "temiz görünen" bir yer değil. Genelde oteller ve airbnb daireleri temiz görünüşlü oluyor, ancak gerçekten temiz olan bir yer bulmak kolay değil. Burası özellikle tuvalet banyo konusunda gerçekten temiz. Zemin temizliği de aynı şekilde. Müzik problemi var evet ama aşırı bir rahatsızlık duymadım ben, zaten ev sahibi de bu konuyla ilgili gerekli uyarıları yapmış. Genel olarak memnun kaldığım, iyi bir fiyat/performansa sahip bir oda.

Check-in was as described, no issue with flexible check-in. The location is very convenient as advertised and expected. There was no issue with cleanliness, the room is equipped with basic needs and has enough space for luggage etc. Late nights during the weekend were noticeably noisy but it came as no surprise knowing the neighborhood. I had my earplugs taking care of that expected issue :) I needed 15-20 min more time than what is written as latest check-out time and the host was flexible and friendly with this as well.

Ev sahibi sorularima hizli cevaplar vererek cok kisa surede rezervasyon yapip konaklayabilmeme imkan sagladi. Evet biraz ses oluyor, tam sessizlik isteyenler icin uygun degil. Guzel bir konumda, fiyat/performans konaklama icin oldukca uygun. Dus ve banyo gayet iyi. Yatak cok rahatti, oda ferahti. Internet kotu ve tv yayini yok ama benim icin cok onemli olmadigi icin ev sahibine ulasmadim, belki cozumu olan seylerdir. Ozetle ben kendi beklentilerim dogrultusunda faylasiyla memnun kaldim, tesekkurler.

3 minutes walk from Kadıkoy Port.
5 minutes from restaurants and shops. I was traveling alone and found the area very safe, even at night. Impeccable cleanliness.
Very helpful host. I had a small problem in the room and (although not resolved) he did what he could to help. Many have complained about the noise at night.. It's true.
There is a club nearby and music until late, especially on the weekend. Personally it wasn't a problem at all. Maybe because I was exhausted by the kilometers I had walked in Istanbul but I slept very well. I'll be back! Thank you!

description:
Only 1 minute to Osmanbey Metro Station
5 minutes to Citys shopping mall
Cevahir shopping mall is 10 minutes away
My apartment is centrally located, 4 minutes' walk from the center of Nişantaşı
It is on the 2nd floor and there is an elevator.
It's air-conditioned.
It has a balcony

reviews.text: The only good thing about this place was thd location. The host wasn’t as friendly as described in reviews. The place needed maintenance the walls of the bedroom was dirty. The fosset in the bathroom was brocken. The dishes were not completely clean. And there is only pillows for the third person to sleep no blankets, no towels. The price is rather low in comparison to other airbnbs in the area but I think that’s fair to expect the bare minimum.

Alper Bey'in evi kesinlikle parasının hakkını sonuna kadar hak ediyor. Ev oldukça temiz ve fotoğraflardan gözüktüğü gibi. Lokasyon olarak da Nişantaşı ve Bomonti'de her yere yürüyerek gidebiliyorsunuz. Evin yakınındaki hem açık hem de kapalı İspark otopark detayı da arabayla geldiğiniz de oldukça kolaylık sağlıyor. Evden çalışma ihtiyaçları için evin interneti de oldukça yeterli.

The appartment is very close to the main metro line (1 min to the lift), with lift (was very important for my mother with bad knees), ideal for 2 people and very practical (with laundry machine! hooray!). We find it rather cozy stay for 1 week and enjoyed our time there. Couple things to consider: we found matresses of the bed and also the couch are too hard, neither of us could have a great deep sleep. I would recomment this place, but not for 1 week long. The balcony is in inner courtyard, it didn't feel comfortable or sunny to drink morning tea outside a lot, there everyone will watch you. If you look for place with balcony to sit outside, it is not the place. The owner gives very fast response and action, the communication was very easy in case of some issues.
The area is also very vibrant, yet the appartment is on the quite street.
The host went above and beyond to make us feel like home. There were some issues with the hot water but it got fixed immediately. Great host. Great location.
Alper was very helpful from the time I made the reservation. Place is nice and clean. Very close to the Osmanbey Metro station. Lot of good restaurants in the area. I recommend

description: Artists’ Oasis is a cozy spacious 2-bedroom 1 bathroom apartment in the heart of Taksim, just steps from Taksim Square and İstiklal Avenue. This true "home away from home" is owned by an artist couple and filled with their personal artwork and handwoven carpets, creating a warm, bohemian atmosphere. The apartment offers an authentic, lived-in feel, perfect for those seeking a genuine, artistic experience in Istanbul—more like staying in a friend’s home than a typical tourist rental.

reviews.text:
The location is fantastic – walking around this part of Istanbul is a real pleasure. The host was very responsive and helped us out multiple times. The apartment has a unique charm and character, and although the furniture is old, it’s comfortable and makes for a cozy place to relax, have tea, and chat.
There were a few minor things to be aware of: the main bedroom isn’t very soundproof, so street noise can be noticeable – earplugs helped. There was a slight dusty smell at first, and the kitchen had a large number of old utensils, some of which weren’t very clean. Also, a few pieces of artwork made my girlfriend uncomfortable, but that’s more a matter of taste.
All in all, despite these small issues, we really enjoyed our stay. Considering the price and the great service, this place is a solid and memorable choice.

Azadeh and her husband were communicative, friendly and knowledgeable. We stayed at their charming apartment for about ten weeks, and felt right at home by the end of it. Istanbul is a fantastic city - I would recommend it to anyone.
PROS:
- Location. The biggest pro. Right in the centre of Beyoglu, but still quiet by local standards. Equidistant between Istiklal (main shopping street) and Cihangir (a more chilled neighbourhood). There are several great restaurants and cafes on this street alone. Taksim metro is easily walkable.
- Space. There's lots of it! High ceilings and large windows.
- Hosts! Azadeh and her husband were very kind. They checked in with us, gave recommendations, and speak great English. Easy communication over text.
CONS:
- Dust. The apartment was dusty when we arrived; we had to vacuum the first weekend.
- Condition of apartment. Consequence of a 100-year-old building: a slight smell of sewage from pipes (only really in kitchen). (Not hosts' fault!)

Azadeh is the most welcoming and helpful host I ever had. She will help you with everything from ordering water to suggesting how to navigate around the city.
The flat is full of her paintings, which is creating unique atmposphere – the is intuitively communicating with the viewer making him/her think.
The apartment is situated in most central part of Istanbul, few minutes walk from Taksim, thus being walking distance from the airport buses (Havaist) and well connected to all other parts of the city. It is on the verge of (for me) most interesting part of the city, with antique shops, restaurants and old hamamas, all of where you could meet both tourists and locals.
The day/night life in this part of town is bursting, which is great for going out and hanging around, but could be a bit of challenge to have a sound sleep on Saturday nights in middle of the tourist season, though :)
The flat is suitable for a couple with a child (or even another baby to put in the master bed, which is really big), good both for tourist and writing retreat.
Though the apartment did not have an airconditioning (which scared me, when staying from mid-July to mid-August), you realise it is reallly not needed. The flat has very good natural airflow and old thick walls that guard you from the outside heat. It is also equiped with ventilators which are more than enough.
The apartment has all virtues and challenges of a pretty old building, high ceilings and cracky floors are just some of them.
I am warmly recommending both host and her place.

Azadeh's home is very authentic as it lightens up your soul as soon as you open the door as it is spacious, has high ceiling, large windows. We stayed 3 nights and Azadeh was easy to communicate even though she was not in Istanbul that time.
Location is superb, close to infamous vibrant Istiklal Street and local shops and restaurant. We felt very safe during our stay even though we could hear noises during the night so you might need some ear plugs.
The bed was noisy but Azadeh was very helpful to resolve the situation. The sofa bed was short so if your height is more than 180cm your feet will be out of the bed. The house in particular shared corridor smells damp but I guess it is due to the age of the building. However this was a minor problem as we get used to it after the second day.
Overall, I would recommend Azadeh's accommodation if you want to stay close to heart of Istanbul.

Azadeh apartment is very comfortable and well decorated, there is everything you need, and the location is amazing. Only one-two minutes from Taksim and Istiklal street. We really enjoy our stay in her apartment which is bigger than the pictures show. Azadeh and her neighbor Didem were very nice and flexible, they were there to help us discover the city. (There are even Istanbul cards for you to use public transportation cheaper). Azadeh even accept to let me stay one more night for free because my flight was reschedule. I highly recommend this apartment and I thank Azadeh very much for her kindness.

description: Enjoy being at the center of the charming district of şile near to the best restaurant and coffe shops in town with sea view and a 5 minutes walk only to the beach and a short distance to all the attractions of the city, have a comfortable stay at our hotel at our city view rooms and an included daily breakfast. Our hotel staff are very proffesional and available to insure your comfort stay.

reviews.text: The staff were so friendly and wonderfully helpful at this hotel. We were just really disappointed with the dingyness of the place. Couches on lobby scratched up by cats, carpets stained in hallway, leatherette couch in room had holes in arms, bathroom smelled of sewage, tap broken on bathroom sink.....the place really needs a renovation and some new furniture. The photos looks better than it is.

Oda çok küçük ve dardı, perdeler, yatak, banyo her şey çok eskiydi ama bunların hiçbiri temizlik kadar büyük bir sorun değildi elbette. Akşam yatağa oturmak üzereyken çarşafların ve yastıkların kıl ve saçla dolu olduğunu görüp dehşete kapıldım. Yani bir tane olsa olabilir diyecektim ama yatılmaz derecede çoktu. Resepsiyonu arayıp çarşafları değiştirmelerini istedim, odaya gelen görevliye de gösterdim o da kabul etti ve özür dileyerek odamı değiştirdi. Diğer oda saç ve tüy açısından daha temizdi ama bu deneyimden sonra yatakta rahatça yatmak ve sabah kahvaltı etmek mümkün olmadı. Yani bir oda o kadar pis olabiliyorsa kahvaltı edilemez diye düşündüm. Neyse ki sadece bir gece kaldım. Fiyatı çevre otellere göre uygundu ama rahat etmek istiyorsanız daha fazla para ödemek gerekiyormuş, bunu anlamış oldum.
Hotel with really great views over the black sea. Upstairs terrace was amazing to sit and enjoy the views and also breakfast there was perfect.
good host nice city we enjoyed our time in this hotel. the host were very helpfull
Temizlik çok yetersizdi. Mobilyalar yıkılan bir okuldan çıkma olabilir. Tuvalet girdiğimde kokuyordu. Yatakta kıllar vardı.

description:
This bright 1-bedroom apartment on the 27th floor is ideal for holidays and business stays. Features include a double bed, spacious wardrobes, a fully equipped kitchen, washing machine, A/C, 50" TV and fast Wi-Fi.
Located in a secure residence in Esenyurt: 10 min to Marmara Park Mall, 5 min to E5 motorway, 4-8 min to the Metrobüs line. Free on-site parking. Children's play area and garden in the complex.
Travel cot available on request. Passport/ID copies required for all guests upon check-in.

reviews.text:
The apartment was very clean and exactly as shown in the photos and description. It had everything needed for a comfortable long stay. All home appliances, including the smart TV, washing machine, refrigerator, and microwave, were new and in excellent condition. The internet was also fast and reliable.
The building felt very safe, with entrance security that only allows known residents and guests to enter. There were plenty of good supermarkets nearby, which made daily shopping very convenient. Additionally, there was a nice park just down the street.
The neighborhood is far from major tourist attractions and the Metrobus station (Haramidere), but there is a minibus station within walking distance, which helps with transportation.
The host, Mr. Aykut, was very responsive and addressed any issues quickly and efficiently.
Overall, it was a very pleasant and comfortable stay, and I would definitely recommend this place.

We had an amazing stay at Dreamsvillas.
The apartment was very nicely cleaned, you. Could smell the freshness from the pillows and towels. All the facilities were provided. It was cheap and a comfortable stay. All the facilities I could want was provided. The instructions and guidance leaflet was very helpful and useful. I recommend staying at the place. It's worth the price.

We lived in this apartment for three months. The apartment was clean and cozy, we had a large comfortable bed, an excellent refrigerator, good washing machine and good electric stove. We would like to express our deep gratitude to Mr. Aykut and Mr. Hakan, they are wonderful persons, real professionals, nice people!!! Everything, what we asked for, was done quickly and efficiently. Just in front of the entrance of apartments building you can easily stop a little minibusses and they will bring you to Metrobus and to any part of the Istanbul.
We like our apartment, we like the people around us, we love turkish people!!! In this area you can see the real life of ordinary Turkish residents. Next time ,when we come back, we definitely will rent the apartment from the same people!
Thank you, guys, very, very much!!!!

I had an amazing experience staying at this place! The host was incredibly kind and helpful, always ready to answer our questions and provide guidance throughout our stay. The home was clean, comfortable, and everything met our expectations. We had a wonderful and relaxing stay and would definitely come back
Very clean apartment...just as shown in the picture..:responsive management.

description:
A luxurious, refurbished, spacious and well-lit flat offering a spectacular view of the Golden Horn with 2 bedrooms, 1.5 baths in a historical building next to Istanbul’s most famous tourist attraction – Galata Tower!

The flat is serene and restful, yet right in the heart of the hustle and bustle. Your flat is on the 5th floor – five flights of original marble stairs – of a grand and elegant historical 19th-century building 20 steps from Galata Tower & easy access to all public transport.

reviews.text: Everything was perfect! The apartment was clean, cozy, and just as described. The view was absolutely worth the walk up to the sixth floor! Communication with the host was smooth and friendly. I’d definitely stay here again and can highly recommend it.

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The house was exceptionally clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. It was well-equipped with everything we needed, making us feel at home throughout our stay.
The location was excellent(near to Galata Tower), miracles viewed and the neighbourhood was peaceful and convenient. Most importantly, the host was incredibly friendly, responsive, and helpful from check-in until check-out.
We truly enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area. Without a doubt, this is one of the best Airbnb experiences we’ve had. We would definitely love to stay here again in the future. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality!

The location of the place is good, near to metro station and next to Galata tower. Rooms are clean, comfortable and the flat looks exactly like the photos. Hosts are quick to response if you have enquiries.

We had a great stay at the apartment with Galata Tower view. Getting to the apartment from the airport was easy (the cab can drop you right outside the building gate). We did have to climb up 5 floors to get to the apartment each time, but we knew that beforehand, and thought it was a good way of burning off a few extra calories from all the baklava that we ate in Istanbul. Yagiz had also arranged for a person to help us with our bags when going up the stairs during check-in. The Airbnb was clean and had excellent location, just two buildings away from the Galata tower, which means it was in a touristy location with cafés, restaurants, and shops nearby. The Tophane T1 tram stop is just a short 4 minute walk from this Airbnb, so we had an easy time getting around with public transport. It was clean, well maintained, although it is of course not a brand new apartment. A small negative is that because of the lively area, it was loud until 1 AM every night and the beds were creaky.

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment is spacious, clean, and has everything you need. There are two bedrooms and two bathrooms, which is super convenient. The kitchen is great, and from the living room you get an incredible view of Istanbul – especially beautiful in the evening.
The location is perfect – just a few steps from Galata Tower, right in the heart of the city. Restaurants, cafés, and shops are all around.
The host was very responsive and helpful, always quick to reply.
Overall, everything was amazing and we really enjoyed our stay!

description:
The flat is located in one of the most popular areas of the city.
You’ll be directly enjoying the chic city center when you leave the apartment.
City's Mall is only 2 minutes away if you want to do some shopping or you can enjoy the fresh air by walking in Maçka Park.
The apartment is on the 4th floor and there is no elevator in the building.
The apartment is on a very secure street.
The street is quiet at night and very vibrant during the day.

reviews.text: The apartment was very clean and looked like the photos. But the apartment is on the last floor so over 70 steps up to the top. The kitchen lacked items for cooking properly but did have a microwave, but it wasn’t a big issue for me but could be for others. The tv is small and isn’t a smart tv so only Turkish channels are available. I had a nice stay apartment except the noise experienced from the people that live below and in the building next door. The owner is extremely friendly and helpful and these issues unfortunately can’t be controlled.

Baris and his Sister Cisel were very friendly and helpful. Cozy one bedroom flat in the middle of the city. You can walk anywhere in Nisantasi. But the building doesn’t have an elevator and the flat is on the 4th floor, keep that in mind if you mind taking the stairs. You have everything that you may need in the kitchen and the bathroom, i felt at home. Thank you 🥰🙏🫶

I had an amazing stay for four days. Barış and Çisel are incredibly friendly, kind, and attentive, always ready to share helpful information and ensure I had everything I needed. The room was super clean and quiet, providing a perfect retreat after exploring the area. The location was fantastic, with plenty of charming cafes, pubs, and restaurants within walking distance. I highly recommend staying here for anyone looking for a welcoming and comfortable experience.

Baris and Cisel I have no words how to thank u for my best experience on Airbnb. Your cozy lovely flat is too good to be true :) The flat is just perfect! Kitchen is compact and contains everything one needs. The bed is comfortable, bathroom excellent. Location is incredible. Cisel, u made me feel at home :) U went way beyond to make my long-weekend comfortable and memorable. I am waiting for u in Georgia.
Many thanks! I will be back :)

I used Airbnb during my travelling to many countries around the world but Baris and Cisel are by far the most amazing hosts I dealt with. They are very kind, responsive, and flexible when they can. The place is wonderful, clean and close to my attractions. The price is very good compared to the other places. I can’t say thank you enough to the amazing hosts. I will definitely choose to stay here again when I visit Istanbul next time.

description: Enjoy your holiday in our luxuriously furnished and comfortable apartment, located in the center of Beyoğlu, within walking distance of Istiklal and Taksim.

reviews.text: Host was amazing. Apartment exactly as listed couldn’t ask for anything more. Stayed here for 7 days. Would stay again. Very spacious, clean, nice location, walking distance to many locations.

Very nice apartment, everything was clean and the apartment was spacious. Nice view, and very easy to walk to Taxim. The interior was modern and comfortable. The front desk staff could have been friendlier, particularly the elderly gentleman was quite rude and unhelpful. Other than that, I would recommend staying here.
Its very similar to the photos and descriptions and very near to Istiklal street just 10 mins walking and Okan is very helpful and responsive, I’m recommended and I hope to go there again.

The host was very responsive and helpful to our needs - he was quick to respond.
The staff were also very friendly and were always there to lend a helping hand.
The flat was exactly as described and very clean. We enjoyed our stay.

The apartment located near the city center (Taksim) and was exactly same as photos. Okan is very friendly. 11.30 pm I messaged him and he answered me very fast., bed was comfortable. Also front of apartment have a mini market.

reviews.text: The location is good. The reception people are very cooperative and helpful. However, the apartment is dirty in general. The master bedroom lights were not working. The kitchen was empty, except couple of knifes and very dirty water heater. I cannot come to this place again.

Great communication before hand, place looked exactly as described, we booked the flat to host my elderly grandparents from abroad, to celebrate my birthday, they had to climb only 4 steps to get in the reception and rest had lift to take us to 7th floor, exactly as they promised.
The flat itself is spacious and tidy like in the pictures.
View and sunset from 7th floor is stunning. Staff are very nice and helpful and always available in reception.
My grandma got stuck inside the bathroom one night as the lock was extremely stiff/broken. It was after midnight but they sent someone with the drill to open it as soon as we asked them (thank you)
the only thing was lacking was basic utilities such as washing up liquid, tea pot, good cooking knife and cooking pan etc… we had to buy everything for few days stay and left them all there.
Rest of the things were great and we are very thankful my grandparents had a very comfortable, quiet and sweet stay with us.

An incredibly spacious suite of rooms and the ability to check in anytime. Hexa Suites is more like a hotel. It’s in a very nice, walkable area and is close to tons of restaurants and shops. There is a paid parking lot nearby.

it's like an apartment with reception and lobby the location was good, the surrounding are alive and full of shops, the view from 7th floor was nice and the living room was big and they provide us parking spot other wise it'll be a problem .. there was dust on the floors and one bathroom with shower and one without so it's hard in the morning for 6 ppl to shower to go out in the morning
overall i didn't regret to stay there, and if you have even an infant they'll calculate it as a person and you'll pay for it

Our group had a very nice stay at the apartment. The personnel works 24/4, everyone was very friendly and responsive - they helped us with additional bedsheets and towels, printed out the documents for us, and arranged a transfer to the airport at a reasonable price. The apartment was equipped with all necessary things and was quite clean. We enjoyed our stay.

description:
An apartment where you can easily access many districts of Istanbul. Next to the Metro and Bus stops. Close to the grocery store, restaurant and shopping mall. You'll be able to enjoy all the amenities of the house in the comfort of your own home. Kitchenware and 24/7 Hot water. Unlimited Wi-Fi International TV channels Android Smart TV (NETFLIX). You will be able to find answers to any questions you may have instantly.

My guests will have the entire apartment to themselves. Thank you for choosing us.

reviews.text:
I had a pleasant stay at this Airbnb! The place was nice, clean, and exactly as described, making it a comfortable home away from home. The check-in process was smooth, with clear instructions, and the host was responsive and helpful whenever I had questions. I also appreciated the flexible check-in/check-out times, which made my travel plans much easier.
A few things to note:
There’s no elevator, so be prepared to carry your luggage up to the 5th floor—this could be challenging for some.
While the apartment is a bit far from main tourist areas, the nearby tram station makes it convenient to get around.
Overall, I’d recommend this place to travelers who don’t mind stairs and prefer a quiet, local neighborhood with good transit access. Thanks for hosting!

The apartment was in a great location, with the metro about 15 minutes away and a bus stop just 5 minutes away. The neighborhood felt safe and pleasant. The apartment itself was very spacious, clean, and had everything we needed for our stay. It’s also great value for money.
A few things to note: the building is on a hill and the apartment is 5 stories up without an elevator, which can be a challenge with luggage. The Wi-Fi wasn’t the best, and the bath/shower setup was a bit awkward and quite small.
That said, the host was very nice and responsive, which made the stay much easier. Overall, a good option if you’re looking for space and value in a convenient neighborhood.

The host was always very helpful and replied everything I asked in a short time.
The apartament is comfortable and cozy, big living room, the kitchen is good and easy to cook and eat.
The location was nice, about 10min by walking to metro station. There are other bus options near too. There are markets and restaurants in the area, nice places to buy things for your breakfast (I recommend Latifioğlu Unlu Mamuller for poğaça or simit).
It was a very nice stay in a typical Istanbul neighborhood.

Overall had a great time, the host was very helpful and reactive, the apartment was really nice, cozy and clean, accurate to the pictures, there was some small issues with the TV/internet but that was due to the previous occupant, would probably come back there another time in the future!
