reviews.text: Our stay was not what was expected. The location is great as is very central to everything in Old Istanbul. Parking is free in premises which was convenient and the host was very friendly and accommodating (although unable to speak English so unable to offer tips/advice on the area). The wifi did not work in the room and the room itself was noisy as was on back of property on a busy road. walls are incredibly thin and room was hot and stuffy as we needed to keep windows closed due to noise. The bed was also uncomfortable because of springs. Unfortunately this left us with a rather negative experience especially given the price of the room.

First of all, I would like to say that this hotel is great value for money! It was our oasis of peace in big noisy city of Istanbul :) In more details
1) Location. Is not perfect, but very good. The closest tourist spot is Grand Bazaar (5-7 min walk uphill), where we usually took tram or metro to get elsewhere. Sultanahmet is more like 30 min walk on the noisy busy streets, so we only went once by foot. Yenikapi metro station(to go to the airport etc) is 20 min walk, also not easy with the luggage, so mind that.
The area close to the Bazaar has plenty of shops, street food, restaurants etc, no problem with that even at night. The hotel street itself is very quiet.
Sea view - is actually a view on the railway and very busy seaside road with heavy traffic :) Didn't mind that as we were exhausted and slept well regardless of anything :) But actually there's no seaside walk possibility etc.
2) The hotel itself is really new! Recently renovated. The interior is super nice. Extreme cleanliness and everything is new and shiny. The room is really very very small, so no big luggage bags :) The shower - is just hanging on the wall in the toilet, so mind that all the bathroom is wet after having a shower.
Terrace on the 2nd floor is nice, but noisy because of the road below. Common kitchen is super, spacious and convenient.
3) Breakfast - costs 15 TL, is traditional Turkish set (vegatables, boiled egg, bread, butter, cheese, ham). Does include instant coffee only, or tea. We asked for Turkish coffee instead, it costs 5 TL. The breakfast is not what can get you going for the whole day or even half, but there's a possibility to order additional dishes from the menu.
4) Staff. I communicated with Can on the website in English, very quick responses and good experience, but we didn't actually meet in the hotel. We were met by another guy (Timur I think) who speaks good Russian. Overall experience was ok, perhaps it would be good to have more additional information, tips, instructions (which you actually need a lot in Istanbul). Timur gave us the Istanbulkart on the first day, which was very important, many thanks for that!!
Thank you for your hospitality!

Everything was like described in listing. Mert and Can were really nice hosts, friendly and ready for help. This place is really nice and I would gladly recommend it to anyone coming to Istanbul because:
-It's really near to all main turistical areas
-neighbourhood is peaceful
-place is clean and it has everything mentioned.

If we come back to Istanbul we are coming here for sure.

Very Good location Fatih: Sultan Ahmet /Hagia Sofya 15 min walk, To Grand Baazar /Ferry station 25-35 min walk. The hotel totally fits the photo, yes, rooms are compact even phisically they are small, but all the stuff in room, bath organized perfect. Shower works perfect. The kettle in the room with tea bags is advantage always.

The place was good and clean. The location is not prime but not bad as well, it is just 15 mins by foot from the attractions. The bed & the room was smaller than the expectations & than it looks in the photos. The room is fine for 1 person but not for 2. The washroom is strangely smaller. But the rest everything was ok.

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Alparslan and Murat's place was fantastic. It was in a great part of Kadikoy. The place was quiet at night and everything was walking distance - the bus, metro, stores, restaurants, etc.
The Wi-fi was good for getting our work done. The bedrooms were spacious and clean, as well as the bathroom itself. There's a nice patio area where there was even a ping pong table.
The hosts' were very responsive for any questions we had. Their friend Emir was also helpful in getting us checked in. I highly recommend this place, and would be happy to check-in again the next time I am in town.

Alparslan beni ve erkek arkadaşımı çok güzel ağırladı, evi gezdirdi, evde ihtiyacımız olabilecek her şey mevcuttu. İnternet online çalıştığımız için bizim için çok önemliydi ve internet hızı çok iyiydi, Türkiye'de alabileceğimiz en yüksek hıza ulaştık. Ev tertemiz ve pırıl pırıldı, eşyalar yeniydi. Evin dekorasyonu bizi cezbetmişti ve fotoğraflarda gördüğümüzden daha güzeliyle karşılaştık, her şey özenle seçilmiş ve harikaydı. Alparslan'ın bizim için bıraktığı hediye ve ikram için de çok sevindik, düşünceli bir ev sahibi. Evin konumu çok kolaydı, Kadıköy'ün içinde. Sıcaklık konusunda hiçbir sıkıntı yaşamadık ev çok sıcaktı ve Mart ayında camı açtık. Kadıköy'e her geldiğimde önceliğim hep bu mükemmel daire olacaktır. Arkadaşlarımızla harika bir hafta sonu geçirdik. Herkese tavsiye ediyorum.
Ev görselde gözüktü gibi gerçekten temiz ve güzel konum olarak mükemmel yerde her yere yakın ev sahibi de çok yardımcı oldu 10/10
Konumu güzel rahat temiz bir ev.

Akşama doğru rezervasyon yapmamıza rağmen benimle hemen iletişime geçti. Evin içi çok hoş ve sıcak dekore edilmişti. Her şey tertemizdi bu konuda özellikle teşekkür ederim. Konumu da oldukça iyiydi. Tek sıkıntımız sivri sinekler oldu, onun dışında 10/10. Teşekkürler!

description: Experience luxury living with stunning sea views in our modern apartment! Wake up to the sound of birds and enjoy a cup of coffee on your private terrace overlooking the sea. Relax in the en suite bathroom and catch amazing sunsets after a long day.. Flat is equipped with all the amenities you need for a comfortable stay, including a fully equipped kitchen with high-end appliances. With its prime location and luxurious design, our apartment is perfect for a romantic getaway or a family vacation.

reviews.text:
Since I am a photographer and I care so much about details, the moment I posted a photo of the flat on my social media accounts, I received messages from my friends kept asking me which hotel I am staying at.
Let me state some facts:
1- Check in was easy and smooth.
2-The flat was stunning and so clean. It felt like a huge 2 bedroom hotel suite.
3- Location was perfect, everything we needed was within a walking distance distance: gym, market, park, bars,restaurants,etc.
On lazy days, you can actually just enjoy the view without the need to go out.
4- The place is suitable for families and friends.
I would definitely stay here again.

Demir’s place is newly renovated, cosy and situated strategically in Moda. Lots of great restaurants, shops and cafes are in walkable distance. The place is cosy and the kitchen is well equipped. However, we were unable to cook as some essential cooking items are not available. There were two main issues. We had a hot water and heating issue that was later resolved but made our stay uncomfortable. We communicated with Demir from day one and were asked to start up the heating system manually (daily) from the balcony in December which is not fun at 6am. The heating system broke during New Year’s Eve and we had to stay 48 hours without showers - again not ideal. The other issue is a bad sewage smell coming from the bathroom in the main bedroom. You can smell it in the building as well. Overall, good stay and we had a wonderful time in Moda- our fav part in Istanbul.

This is the best choice! We really liked this apartment. Beautiful design and furniture, comfortable. This is a very good area to live, everything you need is nearby. You will not be disturbed by noise from the street. Despite the fact that busy places are just steps away from the house. Near the port, shops and restaurants. Apartment with a large terrace, just renovated and sparkling clean. I really liked the upholstered furniture and interior. Comfortable beds and sofa. Constant hot water. We didn't worry about anything and just enjoyed this place.

Accurately described by the host, Demir and with great communication. We felt very comfortable at this modern fully equipped penthouse apartment with a large terrace and sea views. Located in a quiet part of Kadikoy, walking distance to many ferries to visit other parts of Istanbul. Would definitely stay here again!

For my first time in Istanbul, I couldn't have asked for a better apartment than this. The location is perfect - not too far from the bustling Kadikoy market with its myriad lanes filled with endless restaurants, cafes, and spice vendors. There's even a fish market and very good seafood restaurants situated close to it. The apartment walking distance to the ferry and bus station and its a breeze to get over to the European side of the city.
The apartment itself is exactly as described in the pictures. The view from the extended balcony is beautiful especially in the evenings. The building also has an elevator which was great because I was traveling with my older mother who cannot climb stairs. Demir has very tastefully furnished the apartment and it has all basic amenities for a pleasant stay.
I look forward to booking again with Demir on my next visit to Istanbul.

description: FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION (3 minute distance) – FREE MINI BREAKFAST (Less than 3 minute distance) – 4MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – MARKETS & PATISSERIES VERY CLOSE – SAME FLAT IN THE PHOTO

reviews.text:
This was a nice, spacious apartment with plenty of natural light, and it was worth the price. I would recommend it. Everything was as shown in the pictures, and all the amenities were available as described.
The staff were helpful with everything. Special thanks to Hirad, who helped me resolve a few issues during my stay. Any issues with the apartment were quickly resolved by the staff when reported.
The location is very central, about a 10-minute walk from Taksim and Istiklal Street. The breakfast was also nice and was served at a place about a 7-minute walk from the apartment.
One thing to mention is that the street and the stairs leading to the apartment are a bit steep, but this is quite common in many parts of Istanbul.

Very good accommodation at Walking distance from Taksim square and Istiklal street. Room was super clean and communication with the host was very good. They also accommodated our request for an early check-in, which we really appreciate.
However, I would not recommend this place for people:
- who have mobility issues and problem walking on slopes. The building is located on a VERY steep road the stairs to the apartment can also be a bit tricky.
- who are light sleepers, because the road is noisy and the bed squeaks a bit.
If the above two points don’t effect you, then It is definitely a place worth the money.

This is not an Airbnb from a personal host like you would expect that’s why I will be more strict in my review.
I will start with the price, it’s not worth the place. The price I payed was around 27-29 € for a small room in an old building. The stairs and the entrance of the building are really bad especially when you have big luggage. The room is exactly like in the pictures. The internet is not working at all, always break ups. DONT BOOK if you are digital worker.
The people working there are absolutely perfekt, all of them Mohsin, the Tunesian Guy, the lady in the office, the 2 cleaning maids, the lady in the coffee 5 stars. 🔝 !!
The management should understand that they can’t treat their workers like slaves. No transportation, no Cars for them to transfer luggage etc. Letting them run in the heat around especially not for this low salary.
If I could I would give the management 0 stars. You make enough money, pay your staff a good salary and you will still have enough!!

The accommodation was the same as in the picture. Everything clean, tidy. The room was spacious. The host was nice. Breakfast included in the price was good and sufficient. The only thing I would criticize is the small cockroaches (we found about 10 of them in 3 nights), but you can blame the location for that. It was not an obstacle for us and I recommend the accommodation!

I had a great stay at this apartment in Istanbul! The place is spacious, well-equipped, and offers everything you might need for a comfortable stay. The bed was especially comfortable, and I had excellent rest throughout my time there.
The location is fantastic—just a 2-minute walk to public transportation and around 10 minutes to Taksim on foot. The neighborhood feels very safe, with the main police station located just 50 meters away. There is also plenty of free street parking available nearby, which was very convenient.
The host was extremely polite, kind, and always available to help with anything I needed. He responded quickly to all my questions and made sure everything went smoothly. Highly recommended, and I would definitely stay here again!

description: Enjoy this newly renovated forth floor apartment located in the Old Town Pera district - minutes by walking to Taksim square. Conveniently located just steps away from the Sishane metro station, this is the perfect location for your Istanbul stay. In addition this apartment is one of the few in the area with an elevator- an absolute must if you’ve got luggage to carry.

reviews.text: Really enjoyed our stay here, location was easy to get to by public transport from the airport, and was a good base for exploring all of Istanbul. Apartment was clean, spacious and comfortable - host even provided free water bottles, though there is a supermarket conveniently right downstairs. You should keep in mind that the apartment is located on a steep cobblestone hill which is difficult to walk with luggage. Additionally, there were wifi issues throughout the stay which were not the fault of the host but guests should be prepared with their own SIM card.

This was a great stay. The unit was very clean, wifi worked well, and having the elevator and washing machine was very convenient. Flexible check-in. Good value. It's close to bus stops, restaurants, and there's a good sized grocery store right next door. The place is located on a steep street, so keep that in mind if you have any mobility issues. Mori was very kind and helpful with any questions I had. Overall great stay and I would recommend.

We stayed for 2 weeks at Mori’s apartment and had a good experience. She’s a very kind and friendly host who responds quickly to messages. The check-in process was smooth, and she kindly allowed us to check in early when we arrived before the scheduled time. The apartment looks exactly like the photos; clean, cute, & fairly equipped. It’s located in a great, tourist-friendly area near Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, and Galata Tower, with two big supermarkets nearby, plus lots of cafes, restaurants, and public transport within walking distance. Everything in the apartment worked well and we were comfortable during our stay. A couple of small things for improvement: there were some screws sticking out from under the bed (I scratched my foot but there were plasters). Fixing this would increase safety. And a warmer blanket would have been appreciated… though I didn’t ask for one, and I’m sure Mori would’ve provided it. Overall, we were satisfied and would happily stay here again in future

We liked that the host lived right next door, so we could easily talk to them whenever we needed something.
The accommodation was also in a great location, close to Istiklal Street, and both the bus stop and the metro station were within walking distance.
Even though the place allowed smoking, we thought it would be fine since we do not smoke ourselves. However, there was a small gap in the door, so cigarette smoke sometimes came in and it was a bit difficult for us. Still, we really appreciated that the host and the building caretaker made an effort to reduce the smoke.
We also cooked meat, fish, and shrimp in the accommodation, which probably created some smells, so we are thankful for their understanding. ^^
It was convenient that the building had an elevator, which made it easy to move our travel luggage.
The best part was the view — nothing blocked the front of the accommodation, so it felt very open and the scenery was great.

My family and I had a very comfortable stay at Mori's place:
+ the apartment was spotlessly clean and well-prepared on our arrival date;
+ this studio is bright with a lot of sunshine and warm in winter;
+ it is super centrally located near Taksim;
+ Mori is a very nice, polite and friendly host.
Highly-recommended option in Istanbul!

description: Located on Pendik Aydınlı Road Street, the airport is within 7 minutes. Marmaray 5min walk It is possible to get to neighborhoods such as Kadikoy , Pendik, Tuzla , Bostancı from the front of the house.

reviews.text:
Çok memnun kaldık. Daire temiz,geniş ve rahat üstelik konumu da gayet iyi.
Ev sahibi bizi çok iyi karşıladı. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim. 4-6 kişi rahat kalabilir.

Firstly we are very grateful to Mr Ali and his family for accepting our booking late night . We had a cancelled flight and needed an accommodation last minute. His parents were waiting to receive us and were very warm and hospitable . The house was clean and had everything we needed . There is also a playroom for the kids and my children had a lovely time there. They also accomodated our request for a delayed check out . Mr Ali also helped us book a taxi to the airport at a very reasonable price .To sum up our stay was very comfortable and enjoyable. We would love to stay at their place again next time we are in Istanbul insha'Allah.
The place is big, cozy, clean and really makes you feel at home. Location is the best in Pendik. The hospitality that the greeted us with was amazing! Defined recommending this apartment!!
Güzel ve rahat bir deneyimdi, Ali Bey’in iletişimi gayet iyiydi
Very kind and helpful, let us check in early which was hugely appreciated. Excellent communication, thank you!

description: Our suits are very central in Taksim. It is 300 meters away from Taksim square. Our suits are furnished and have comfortable real bed, full equipped kitchen and equipped bathroom. There is free wireless internet connection and cable tv.

reviews.text: Safa is very friendly and helpful, he was kind enough to check me in earlier than the check-in time and I didn't have to wait outside in the cold. The space is exactly as in the pictures, the set up is almost like a hotel room with nicely equipped kitchen sufficient to handle simple cooking. Noise can be a problem as it is located right at a crossroad and there seems to be some sort of dealings outside all the time. I'm the kind who can sleep through a thunder storm so it didn't bother me much, but if you are a light sleeper, you may want to talk to Safa upfront to see if he can place you in a different room (he manages the whole building). There are several grocery shops that operate 24 hours right outside. All in all, value for money, and strategic location.

Convenient location for a good value of money. Safa is very kind and helpful in communication and check in. But honestly, the photo looks much better than reality. The room was not very clean.
The worst part was that on the third night, some other guests started partying at around 2am and it was super noisy/scary. There was no staff to help solve this issue during the night. Really horrible feeling for solo female traveler.

Safa is a really great host. Excellent communication, he also let us check in early as our flight arrived at 6am. We were offered another apartment that was bigger than 1 bedroom that we booked. The apartment was however a lot older than what we saw in photos. Some part of the wallpaper and the ceiling came off. The apartment was also not very clean, particularly the bathroom sink. Beds were also not comfortable. The main bedroom in the apartment has 2 single beds joined, rather than 1 double bed as per photo. Location was great, close to Taksim square and Taksim shopping / food area. However I would be very careful especially if you are female solo traveller. I’m sure the area is safe it’s just I personally wouldn’t feel 100% comfortable to walk alone at night as a female. In saying that, Safa was really a great host and I hope the accuracy / quality / cleanliness can be improved :)

The place is somewhat modern on the inside and bedding/sheets felt very nice and clean.
But it was not the place in the photos, it was another apartment in that building.
Otherwise, unfortunately, the apartment did not feel clean. Bathroom was dirty -- shower did not seem cleaned and neither was toilet as it wasn't even flushed :( . Half the lightbulbs were out in bathroom so it was also dim.
The floors needed cleaning. It just didn’t feel like it was really thoroughly cleaned.
Beyond that…if you are a light sleeper, this is a noisy location. The apt I was given (#101) is on the ground floor. The bedroom window is right at street level and right next door is a hookah bar where guys sit and talk loudly late at night. Plus other shop guys just hang outside right here sitting and smoking and talking.
Also the front door to the building slams and is near this wall. So I could not sleep much at all.
If it was cleaned better and maintained, it would be a nice apartment.

I stayed at Safa's studio for 17 nights and absolutely loved it. Safa was very quick to answer all of my questions and messages and spoke very good english which was helpful. Right when I checked in he even upgraded my room and I ended up getting a larger studio than anticipated! The room is very clean and had everything I needed to live comfortably for the weeks I was staying in Istanbul. The location was perfect being only a five minute walk from the central Taksim square and the metro there. The street was also very quiet considering it was so close to such a central part of Istanbul. I also felt safe in the neighborhood Safa's place is in and really appreciated the security of the building with a lock to get in and then a personalized key card for the room. I would highly recommend staying in these rooms! If I ever return to Istanbul (which I would very much like to) I would definitely stay here again.

description:
Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.
A comfortable stay awaits you in the luxury residence with many coffee chains and restaurants right next to the CNR exhibition center, Yenibosna Metrobus stop and Yenibosna Metro stop

reviews.text: Ali Bey mükemmel bir ev sahibi,sürekli bizimle iletişimde kaldı,evde her imkan sunulmuştu,çok temizdi,toplu ulaşıma yakın ve otopark konusunda çok rahat.Birdahaki sefere tekrar burada konaklamak isterim.

We had a wonderful stay in Ali’s flat. He is a nice humble person always helpful and easy to reach and communicate. The flat had literally everything needed and was super clean and nicely prepared for us. The bed has a very comfortable mattress and good size. The neighbourhood consists of new apartment blocks. It feels safe and comfortable. There are grocery shops and a few cafes/restaurants on the ground floor, also two shopping malls near by. There are many buses stopping around the corner (Kuleli/Yenibosna stop) and also metro station 10 minutes away, however, we did not use it and have noticed it only in the end. Also taxis are everywhere. I was happy that we were lucky to stay here. Thank you for hosting us!

We had a pleasant stay in Istanbul here. Although a small space, it was very comfortable and had everything we needed.
- Easy access, good location.
- The room is enough for two people, the bed was comfortable.
- There is water, tea, and coffee available for the guests which is very nice.
- Helpful and responsive host.

I can’t recommend Ali’s place enough! Great location with lots of shops, restaurants and pop up food stalls, most of which were open until late. The metro station is also on la couple of minutes away.
The apartment was perfect, exactly like the photos and very clean. Ali also kindly left us some fruit, snacks and a bottle of wine. All necessities such as toilet paper were also provided.
Ali picked us up from the airport even though we didn’t land until midnight which was very kind. When we arrived he showed us around the apartment and the surrounding area.
He checked up on us throughout our stay and was always available if we needed anything. Our flight home wasn’t until the evening, but he allowed us to stay 4 hours longer than the usual check out time which was very kind and made our last day much less stressful!
We would definitely stay here again if we come back to Istanbul and recommend it to anyone🥰
Thank you Ali!😊

Me and my boyfriend stayed at Ali's place for a week. We met Ali and his partner at check in and they showed us around and gave us the keys. The building was very modern and loads of restaurants, cafes and grocery shops were close by. The apartment was clean and looked like the pictures. The only downside was that sometimes there came a smell we suspected was from the water pipes as it came from the bathroom and under the kitchen sink. Overall very happy with the stay, would recommend.

description: A centrally located house where you will have a pleasant stay with your family and loved ones in safety, one minute away from Istiklal Avenue

reviews.text:
This is a great Airbnb if you want to be in the heart of the city with an easy walk between Galata tower and Takism Square.
We loved the full kitchen (lots of supplies to cook comfortably), the couch with tv is nice, dishwasher, hot water in the shower and the air conditioning is a must. It’s pretty spacious as well (except the bathroom). The host was also kind and easy to chat with.
There are a ton of restaurants in the area too. Most are more expensive like 500+ lira for a meal since its touristy. If you can find <250 lira that’s pretty good.
With that said, it’s very very loud here (especially at night) since there are bars on the first floor of the building. So just be prepared for that. You also have to go up 5 flights of stairs to get to the Airbnb.

This place is very comfortable, well equipped, clean and centrally located. Bekir was a perfect host, as well. If you stay on a Friday or Saturday, you will definitely need ear plugs, since the apartment is located right next to an extremely loud dance club. With ear plugs, you will not be particularly bothered.

Bekir was a great host; he responds quickly to messages. We are very satisfied with our rental.
The house was clean and well-furnished, including an air conditioner, washing machine, and dishwasher. The location is perfect, right on Istiklal Street. The only inconvenience was that it was a bit noisy, and the apartment is on the 5th floor without an elevator.
If you’re looking for a place in the middle of Istiklal Street, Bekir's apartment would be the perfect spot to rent.

Bekir is very nice and is very responsive. The apartment was comfortable but the location is pretty loud throughout the whole night. It is difficult to sleep without ear plugs. The restaurants right downstairs are pretty good. I really liked the bar/cafe right outside the entrance. I would say it’s a good place to stay, but it may not be the most restful.

Bakir's place is awesome. It has everything you need and everything is functional. Bakir is a very helpful host and we enjoyed meeting with him for lunch. He also had good recommendations to see around the city. The apartment is cool and has plenty of space. Earplugs solved the noise issue from the club downstairs. There is a mini market 1min walk away. After 5 months of travel this is the best place we've stayed in. Thank you Bakir 👏

description:
You have to climb 3 flights of stairs to reach the apartment, there is no elevator
The apartment is 16 square meters
1 minute to the M7 metro line
6-7 minutes to the M2 metro line
The metrobus station is a 5-minute walk away.

reviews.text: Fiyat performans neredeyse rakipsiz bir yer. Duşakabini yoktu, ufacık banyoda her yeri su yaparak duş alınıyordu fakat temizdi. Amerikan mutfak ve buzdolabı sağlanmıştı ve bunlar evde basit bir şeyler yapmak için gayet yeterliydi. Yatak geniş ve temizdi. Onun harici geniş bir penceresi var. Klima pek iyi çalışmasa da var. Muhit biraz kötü, atölyeler içinde ve pek hoş olmayan bir mahallede daire. Çağlayan ve Mecidiyeköy metro/metrobüse rahat ulaşımı var. Ev sahipleri mesajlara gayet hızlı geri dönùyor. Genel olarak memnun kaldık, bu fiyata beklentilerimizi karşıladı.
Terrible apartment, not worth the money. It smells of cigarettes and mold. The whole place is worn out and does not match the photos. Very noisy, the shower and toilet are disgusting and dirty.
Ev ve konum gösterildiği gibi ve konumu aynıydı. Aracınız var ise etrafta park yeri bulmanız imkansız, otoparklar da çok pahalı. Diğer türlü her şey iyiydi.

olumsuz olarak; fotoğraflarda görülen masa öncesinde özellikle söylememize rağmen yoktu yapacağız deyip yapmadılar. dolapların kulplarının mutlaka biri yoktu, klima çalıştıkça kornişlerden bir şeyler dökülüyodu. havlu asacak yerler yoktu. evin içerisinde giyilebilecek otel terlikleri vb. yok, ayakkabı koyacak yer de olmadığı için ayakkabı ile yattığımız yere giriliyor. yerler yeterli temizlikte değildi. fotoğraflarda nasa vardı gitmeden önce ihtiyacımız olduğunu özellikle belirtmemize rağmen masa çıkarılmış ve söylememize rağmen takılmadı. ayrıca tuvaletin kapı kulpunun çıktığını da söyledik fakat aksiyon alınmadı. 2 kişi geleceğimizi söylememize rağmen tek kişilik banyo malzemeleri vs koyulmuş her şeyi eksta istemek zorunda kaldık.
olumlu olarak, netflix vardı. klima iyi ısıtıyordu, konum olarak iyi bir yerdeydi ve ara sokaklarda park sorunu yoktu.
very clean and comfortable

description:
Enjoy staying at the 40+ floor with amazing Istanbul view and a stylish experience at this -stylish deluxe home in the heart of the city!
.
Welcome to Bomonti,one of Istanbul’s most vibrant and evolving neighborhoods. Perfectly positioned to offer an eclectic mix of historical charm and modern sophistication, Bomonti is the ideal destination for travelers seeking both culture and convenience. With prime location 5-10 minute away from most ist attraction area ensure memorable stay for all guest

reviews.text: Lovely place as described. Clean with amazing views. Anas was very helpful and kind. Will defiantly be back.

In one simple word amazing
The flat in a multi story building (less than 4 year old). Security guards (which I lost count of how many ) 24 hrs in the reception and outside. Helping with everything that you need from shopping, coffee, bags and what ever you need. Taxis are 24hrs parked outside the building. Building + flat clean and building has 8 elevators. Host are helped with all my need and replies in less than 30 minutes even at 2 in the morning . Even arranged for a vip van to pick and drop me off at the airport. Flat clean with amazing fews and felt welcomed all time from buildings staffs, the shopping mall staff at the bottom, cafe staff. I couldn’t ask for more . Thank you you to everybody and I’ll be back again at the end of the year .

very nice place. Clean apartment. good location.
whenever there was a problem, the host fixed it
would definitely recommend!

Ev sahibi sorulara hızlı geri dönüş, ilgi ve alaka konusunda çok iyi. Kendi eviniz konforunda olacak bütün imkanlar sunuluyor, araç için otopark giriş çıkışları çok rahat ayrıca giriş kapısındaki market kolaylık sağlıyor ve diğer siparişler çabuk ulaşıyor. Manzara güzel ve kat tamamen sessiz, geniş ve konforlu bir daire uzun süreli kalışlar için bütün imkanlar mevcud.

Best location and really good stay in Istanbul’s standards . The building is in best place mostly famous people stay there . Close to every good restaurant and etc .i got scammed on booking . Com 3 times in Istanbul so if you want to be sure that you are getting what you paid for choose this place . There is very nice restaurant in first floor we had so much fun there . Also pharmacy right next to you which is crazy because it’s so hard to find what you looking for in Istanbul so it was a gem . Host was very helpful as well he was always there whenever we needed him . Even helped to carry my luggage 🩵 thanks for everything .
